primary_link.title: 自宅サーバーではじめる ローカルLLM入門 第1巻 基礎・構築編

blog_recommendations.summary:
生成AIを使って文章を書いたり、調べものをしたり、考えを整理したり……
そのAIを「自宅のPCで動かす」という選択肢があることをご存じですか？

本書は、ローカルLLMをまったく知らない方が、自宅のミニPCやデスクトップPCを「自分専用のAIが動くサーバー」へとステップアップさせるための入門書です。UbuntuとNVIDIA GPUを基本構成として、OllamaとGemma 4を導入し、家庭内の別のPCから利用できる環境を、一緒に構築していきます。GPUを持っていない方に向けて、CPUとシステムメモリで試す方法も用意しています。

コマンドを丸暗記するのではなく、「LLMはどのように文章を生成するのか」「量子化とは何か」「なぜその設定が必要なのか」を一つずつ丁寧に解説します。モデルの性能やメモリの考え方から、Ubuntuの準備、GPUドライバー、モデルの導入、安全なLAN内利用、基本的な運用とトラブル対応まで、この1冊でローカルLLMの土台を築くことができます。

クラウドのAIを使うだけでなく、自分の環境でAIを動かす世界へ。
ローカルLLMへの第一歩を、ここから始めてみませんか。
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本書是針對完全不了解本地大型語言模型（LLM）的讀者所設計的入門指南，目標是協助讀者將家中的迷你PC或桌上型電腦升級為「專屬AI伺服器」。內容以Ubuntu與NVIDIA GPU為基本架構，逐步引導讀者安裝Ollama與Gemma 4，並設定讓家中其他電腦可透過區域網路存取。對於沒有GPU的讀者，也提供以CPU與系統記憶體運作的替代方案。書中強調理解而非死記指令，詳細解說LLM如何生成文字、量子化的概念、以及各項設定的必要性。涵蓋範圍從模型效能與記憶體配置的評估、Ubuntu環境準備、GPU驅動程式安裝、模型導入、安全的區域網路使用，到基本的系統維運與故障排除。這本書能幫助讀者建立本地LLM的基礎知識與實作能力，無需依賴雲端服務，即可在自己的硬體上運行AI，特別適合重視隱私或想深入理解模型運作原理的使用者。

primary_link.title: ループエンジニアリングは、なぜ同じ提案を繰り返すのか

blog_recommendations.summary:
アーキテクチャを改善させようとして、エージェントに何周もループを回させたことはないだろうか。最初の数回で、キャッシュ戦略やコンポーネント分割の提案は確かに幅が広がる。しかしその先を回し続けると、提案は新しくならない。既に見た2つ・3つの案を、言い回しを変えながら何度も提案し直しているだけだった、ということに後から気づく。トークンは確実に消費されているのにだ。
普段の運用——バグを直す、機能を1つ足す、テストを通す——なら、ループはだいたい期待通りに動く。問題が出るのは、答えが一意に決まらない領域、つまり「もっと良い設計はないか」「もっと面白い実装はないか」と探索させ続けたときだ。ここで起...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討在架構改進的迭代過程中，為何智慧代理在多次迴圈後會重複提出相同建議。作者指出，在初期幾輪迴圈中，代理能提出多樣化的方案，如快取策略或元件拆分；但持續迴圈後，新提案減少，反而以不同措辭反覆提出舊點子，卻仍消耗大量代幣。此現象主要發生於開放式探索任務，例如「尋找更佳設計」或「更有趣的實作」，而一般任務如除錯、新增功能或跑測試則表現正常。文中可能分析背後原因，例如探索空間有限或模型記憶限制，並提出改善迴圈效率的可能方向。此研究對最佳化 AI 輔助設計流程具有重要意義，提醒使用者應設定合理停止條件，避免資源浪費。然而，由於僅有摘要，具體方法與數據尚待完整論文揭露。

primary_link.title: 要求の「曖昧さ」より、LLMが返す「過剰な確定性」のほうが危ないのではないか

blog_recommendations.summary:
タグ: 要求工学 LLM ISO26262 機能安全 プロンプトエンジニアリング


 はじめに
これまでの記事では、安全関連システムの要求に対してLLMをどう使うかを、研究側とASPICE側の двух視点から整理してきました。今回は少し性質が違って、まだ結論の出ていない仮説を書きます。
要求工学では長らく、曖昧性（ambiguity）は「検出して潰すべき欠陥」として扱われてきました。私自身もそう考えて手を動かしてきたのですが、LLMを要求分析のパイプラインに入れて出力を眺めているうちに、順序が逆かもしれないと思うようになりました。
曖昧なまま残っている要求より、LLMによって過剰に...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討在安全相關系統的需求工程中，使用大型語言模型（LLM）進行需求分析時，一個尚未定論的假說。傳統上，需求工程將模糊性視為必須偵測並消除的缺陷，作者過去也持此觀點。然而，在實際將LLM納入需求分析流程後，作者觀察到一個反向問題：LLM往往會將本應保留模糊空間的需求，轉化為過度確定的陳述，這種「過度的確定性」可能比原始模糊性更具風險，尤其是在功能安全（如ISO 26262）領域。作者認為，過度確定可能導致未經驗證的假設被固化，壓縮了專家審查與討論的空間，反而可能隱藏安全隱憂。文章尚未提出具體解法，僅作為一個研究假說與觀察分享，旨在引發討論。對使用LLM進行需求工程或安全分析的研究者與實務工作者而言，本文提供一個值得警惕的新視角，提醒在追求需求明確化的同時，也需留意LLM輸出可能帶來的偽精確性風險。

blog_recommendations.summary_zh: CARE-X 旨在突破放射學 AI 僅限於報告生成的範圍，提出一套結合彈性推理、校準預測與量測工具的統一方法，用於胸部 X 光影像判讀。該方法整合輔助監督（auxiliary supervision）以強化模型學習，並採用獎勵對齊學習（reward-aligned learning）讓模型輸出更符合臨床需求，另加入工具增強量測（tool-augmented measurement）以提升診斷的量化準確度。研究由微軟研究院提出，雖尚未提供完整實驗數據，但所宣稱的貢獻在於提升放射學視覺語言模型（VLM）的臨床實用性。此工作的價值在於回應醫療 AI 部署時的關鍵痛點：模型不僅要能生成描述，更需具備可信賴的推論與可量化的測量，以輔助醫師決策。然而，目前僅有摘要與概念說明，缺乏具體的效能比較或外部驗證，後續需進一步評估其泛化能力與實際臨床可行度。此方向對於推動 AI 在醫學影像的落地應用具有參考意義。

primary_link.title: Claude API の Citations(引用)機能を実装する ― chunk分割とページ番号ズレ、ハルシネーション抑制の3つのハマりどころ【2026】

blog_recommendations.summary:
はじめに / 対象と前提
Claude API で RAG(検索拡張生成)っぽいことをやると、必ず突き当たるのが「この回答、本当にソース文書のどこに書いてあるの?」問題です。自分で prompt に「引用元を明記して」と書いても、Claude は律儀に答えてくれる時もあれ...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討在 Claude API 中實作 RAG（檢索增強生成）時，如何正確使用 Citations（引用）功能，以解決「回答內容究竟源自文件何處」的常見痛點。作者指出，即使提示詞要求模型標明引用來源，Claude 仍可能回應不精確，因此需要依賴 API 的原生引用機制。文中列舉三個容易出錯的關鍵點：第一是 chunk 分割方式會影響引用準確度，若分割不當可能導致引用內容無法對應到正確段落；第二是頁碼偏移問題，特別當文件包含目錄、頁首頁尾或非連續分頁時，引用產生的頁碼可能與實際文件不符；第三是幻覺抑制，透過嚴格限制模型只能引用提供的 chunk，可有效降低模型憑空捏造來源的風險。文章以 2026 年為背景，提供實作建議與除錯經驗，對開發者整合引用功能具有實用參考價值，但因其內容以實務經驗為主，可能缺乏嚴謹的實驗數據支撐，讀者應自行驗證方法在不同情境下的適用性。整體而言，此文章有助於提升 RAG 系統的可追溯性與可信度。

blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇文章揭示了一個常見的資訊落差：RAG（檢索增強生成）系統的「正確率」會因為評分標準不同而有天壤之別。作者以同一套系統、同一次執行為例，列出四種不同定義的正確率：只要系統有回答（未說「無記載」）即算正確時為 94%；只要內容部分正確時為 87%；必須包含所有必要事實時為 42%；而必須包含所有事實且不添加任何原文沒有的內容時，僅有 6%。文章指出，業界常宣稱 RAG 初始正確率為 50–70%，調校後可達 80–95%，但這通常對應的是第二種寬鬆標準。若以可轉錄至法規或正式文件的嚴格標準（第六種）而言，實際正確率遠低於預期。這凸顯了在評估 LLM 應用時，必須明確定義「正確」與「完整」，否則容易過度高估系統效能。對企業導入 RAG 而言，此文章提醒決策者應根據實際應用場景，設定可驗證的評量指標，並謹慎看待廠商宣稱的效能數字。

links.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation

evidence: Abstract: applies GRPO with reference-free QE reward gated by language identification and SFT-RL checkpoint interpolation.
Section 4.1 Main Results: averaged over scales, WMT24++ XCOMET/COMETKiwi improve by 2.75 and 2.44 points over SFT.
Section 4.2 Analysis: Figure 2 reports interpolation trade-off, with alpha=0.5 recovering 2.79-4.21 spBLEU at different scales.
Section 5 On-Policy Distillation Analysis: OPD approaches but does not surpass RL+interpolation, with Table 2 comparing students.
Appendix C: reports complete GRPO hyperparameters shared across scales.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM post-training, RLHF/GRPO, and multilingual MT, with broad multilingual benchmarking. Novelty is incremental given prior GRPO/QE-based MT work, though checkpoint interpolation and OPD analysis add useful evidence. Rigor is solid with baselines, ablations, and detailed appendices, but evaluation partly relies on the same learned quality metrics used as rewards, and no human or significance testing is reported.

primary_link.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation

recommendations.summary: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models. Starting from the supervised-finetuned MiLMMT-46-v0.1 models, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward that averages two reference-free quality estimation models and is gated by language identification. We then linearly interpolate the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) model checkpoints to obtain MiLMMT-46-v1.0. Across 46 languages, the resulting models consistently improve translation quality over their SFT counterparts, outperform strong recent open baselines, including Seed-X, HY-MT2, and TranslateGemma, and achieve leading reference-free scores against evaluated proprietary systems such as Google Translate, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5. We further investigate on-policy distillation and find that it reaches, but does not surpass, the quality frontier achieved by RL with checkpoint interpolation. We release the models and code to facilitate future research.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討開放大型語言模型在「無參考」條件下的後訓練方法，以期提升多語機器翻譯品質。研究以 XCOMET 與 COMETKiwi 兩種品質評估模型之平均分數作為獎勵，並以語言識別加以過濾，透過 GRPO 進行強化學習，再將監督式微調與強化學習的模型參數進行線性內插，取得 MiLMMT-46-v1.0。在 46 種語言、三種模型規模的實驗中，此方法一致地超越監督式微調模型，並在多項指標上優於 Google Translate、Gemini 3 Pro、GPT-5 等專屬系統，以及 Seed-X、HY-MT2、TranslateGemma 等開放模型。此外，研究也探討「同策略蒸餾」（OPD），結果顯示其可逼近但未能超越強化學習加內插的品質水準。此研究提出了一套可擴展、無需參考譯文的後訓練流程，有助於提升開放多語翻譯模型的效能。

links.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding

evidence: Section 3 and Figure 5: 1,867 repositories, 247,694 instruction lifetimes; deletion hazard log-slope -0.032/commit with 95% CI [-0.047,-0.019], and multi-author interaction -0.021 (z=-11.7).

Section 4.2 and Table 2: informative comments reduce excess size from +60.4% to -5.8% at T=15 and +211.3% to +1.4% at T=51, with overlapping constraint satisfaction; Table 10 shows outcomes carry the effect.

Section D.3 and Limitations: WildIFEval scoring relies on LLM judges; second judge effect size 7.8pp vs 11.6pp with difference CI covering zero; covers are 2-3 instructions and non-English instructions are not measured.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to agentic coding, prompt maintenance, and instruction following. Novel framing of catastrophic remembering and a new inverse-IFEval evaluation, with strong observational rigor: large repo corpus, event-history/frailty models, bootstrapped CIs, and ablations. Controlled evidence supports prompt comments, but the intervention studies use one model, small synthetic constraint covers, and LLM-judge scoring without ground truth, which limits generalizability.

primary_link.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding

recommendations.summary: Agentic coding READMEs like CLAUDE.md grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when the repository retires or someone rewrites the file wholesale. We trace this to imperfect recall: appending an instruction is always cheap, but once an instruction's rationale is gone, deleting it without risking a correctness regression costs O(2^|D|) in a prompt of |D| instructions. We name the resulting divergence catastrophic remembering, the inverse of catastrophic forgetting around which conti
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討代理式編碼的提示檔（如 CLAUDE.md）為何會無止盡地增長，並提出「災難性記住」的概念，與持續學習中的「災難性遺忘」相對。作者指出，由於刪除指令需要重建當初加入的隱含理由，而此理由會隨時間快速衰減，導致刪除成本極高，因此指令只增不減。透過 1,867 個儲存庫的 247,694 條指令生命週期分析，證實刪除危險隨年齡下降。作者提出「提示註解」的解決方案，將隱含理由寫入註解，能有效控制提示大小，實驗顯示可移除 99.3% 的多餘指令，並在真實代理任務中提升指令遵循度達 23.1%。此研究對代理式編碼的提示維護提供理論基礎與實務建議。
recommendations.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
recommendations.title_zh: 為何 CLAUDE.md 不斷增長？代理式編碼中的災難性記住

links.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information

evidence: Section 3.3 describes human curation, cross-validation, and gold-answer verification for 250 tasks over 4,335 records and 10 apps.
Section 5 reports best model GPT-5.5 (xhigh) at 57.3% and weakest at 16.4% across nine LLMs.
Section 6 analyzes failure modes and retrieval behavior, including 79% failures from incorrect parameter values and <2% advanced retrieval use.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM agent/tool-use/retrieval evaluation benchmark with moderate novelty as a synthetic mobile personal-information benchmark; moderately rigorous human curation and controlled evaluation, though claims rely on self-reported results with some table/figure inconsistencies and no explicit limitations.

primary_link.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as mobile assistants, where a key challenge is leveraging personal information scattered across multiple applications (apps) to complete user instructions. However, due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks, their capabilities remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce SPIEval, a human-curated benchmark grounded in five cognitive capabilities (i.e., reasoning, disambiguation, integration, preference inference, and multi-intent decomposition). SPIEval comprises 250 tasks spanning 4,335 personal records distributed across 10 apps and supports multi-turn interaction through 21 tools. Analysis shows that the benchmark exhibits diverse scenarios, challenging tasks, scattered information, controllable environments, and verifiable outcomes. We evaluate nine representative LLMs and find substantial room for improvement. The best-performing model, GPT-5.5 (xhigh), achieves only 57.3% accuracy, while the weakest achieves just 16.4%. Further analysis reveals that 79% of failures stem from inaccurate information localization, as LLMs often commit to plausible but incorrect information instead of continuing retrieval for verification. We also find that fewer than 2% of retrieval actions employ advanced search methods and observe substantial variation in search efficiency across models. These findings expose fundamental limitations of current LLM-based mobile assistants and motivate future research in this direction. Data and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Junjie-Ye/SPIEval.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 SPIEval，一個由人工建構的評測基準，用於評估大型語言模型（LLM）在行動助理情境中，運用分散於多個應用程式之個人資訊來完成使用者指令的能力。研究動機在於現有評測多假設必要資訊已明確提供，而真實情境中資訊往往分散於不同應用程式，現有方法難以反映此挑戰。SPIEval 涵蓋五種認知能力：推理、消歧、整合、偏好推斷與多意圖分解，共 250 個任務，對應 10 個應用程式中 4,335 筆個人記錄，並提供 21 個工具以支援多輪互動。評估結果顯示，表現最佳的 GPT-5.5（xhigh）僅達 57.3% 準確率，最弱模型僅 16.4%，顯示當前 LLM 在此任務上仍有大幅進步空間。進一步分析指出，79% 的失敗源於資訊定位不準確，模型常在找到看似合理但不正確的資訊後便停止檢索，而非持續驗證；此外，僅不到 2% 的檢索動作使用進階搜尋方法。這些發現揭示目前 LLM 行動助理的根本限制，並指出未來改進方向。SPIEval 提供可控環境與可驗證結果，為此領域建立嚴謹的評測基準。
recommendations.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
recommendations.title_zh: SPIEval：評估大型語言模型作為行動助理處理分散個人資訊的能力

links.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

evidence: Section 2.2 formulates UKE composability and introduces decomposition and composition probes.
Section 4.1 reports experiments across Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Llama3.1, and Gemma2 with FT-M and LoRA editors.
Table 1 reports quantitative single-edit improvements; Section 4.3 and Appendix D.1 report continual-editing results.
Appendix C.2 provides training hyperparameters and model checkpoints.
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric knowledge editing with compositional reasoning is strongly matched to preferences. The hybrid-policy self-editing idea is a reasonable novel extension of on-policy distillation, but mostly incremental over prior OPSD/hybrid-distillation work. Rigor is moderate: multiple backbones, editors, ablations, and theory, but metrics rely heavily on LLM-as-judge and lack statistical significance testing. Generalizability is confined to gradient-based knowledge editors. Reproducibility is supported by code link and detailed hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing e
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）知識會過時，知識編輯（KE）藉由更新特定知識來因應。然而，非結構化知識編輯（UKE）中，現有方法僅被動地將新段落注入模型，導致編輯後的知識無法分解為個別事實，也無法組合進行多跳推理，此即本研究所定義的「可組合性」（composability）。作者提出HPSE方法，利用同一模型的特權上下文狀態進行主動式自蒸餾，並在學生的軌跡覆蓋不足時，以混合策略讓特權模型介入，提供更完整的事實導向監督。理論分析證明HPSE相較於純在策略蒸餾，在事實跨度上具有線性優勢。實驗於四個LLM與兩種編輯器上進行，結果顯示HPSE能一致提升單次與持續編輯的可組合性，且不損害局部性，為現有梯度式KE方法提供即插即用改良。
recommendations.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
recommendations.title_zh: 混合策略自編輯：可組合非結構化知識編輯

links.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents

evidence: Abstract: reports 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks, 41 languages, and 2.38M rollouts with code/data release.
Section 3: Table 1 shows each correction increases the length-matched raw gap from +0.0625 to +0.2074.
Section 4: reports four frontier models retain 71-73% action policy under greedy decoding, with model identity explaining 5.7% of variance.
Section 5: reports Translate is the most-used tool and presents causal removal/mandate manipulations across four models.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool use, cross-lingual evaluation, and NLP. The paper proposes a ceiling-corrected estimand for cross-lingual action-policy retention, with strong controls for confounds, large-scale rollouts, causal English-pivot tests, and release claims. Limitations include symbolic rather than grounded execution and a small n=4 central model set, though extensions are reported.

primary_link.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents

recommendations.summary: When a tool-using agent is given the same task in a different language, does it still take the same steps? Multilingual evaluation rarely asks: it compares final answers and discards the actions. Yet those actions are the product: they fix cost and latency, decide how the system fails, and are the only auditable part of its behaviour. We make the action policy the measured object across 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks and 41 languages (2.38M rollouts). The naive measurement fails: five confounds
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究提出一套衡量方法，用以評估多語言工具型智慧體的跨語言策略保留程度，亦即當任務語言改變時，智慧體是否仍執行相同的動作序列。作者指出，傳統的答案正確率比較忽略了中間的動作軌跡，而這些軌跡才是影響成本、延遲、失敗模式與稽核的關鍵。研究涵蓋八個模型、六個平行基準、41種語言，共238萬次軌跡生成。他們發現五個混淆因子會扭曲原始軌跡相似度，因此開發修正方案，並證明每項修正反而使跨語言分歧效應更顯著。在貪婪解碼下，四個前沿模型保留自身策略的71–73%，且模型身分僅解釋5.7%的變異。此外，研究發現模型傾向以英文為中介，此機制具有因果性且難以透過指令消除。最後，他們揭露單一正則表達式萃取程式可能造成錯誤的多語言失敗表象，強調衡量工具使用軌跡的重要性。
recommendations.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents
recommendations.title_zh: 行動勝於言詞：衡量使用工具之智慧體在跨語言策略保留上的表現

links.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs

evidence: Abstract: reports RL-trained persuaders raise persuasion success from approximately 24% to over 93% against the training-time persuadee and transfer at 25-83% to unseen models.
Section 4.1 Main Results: reports TruthfulQA Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct accuracy drops from 66.2% to 1.8% and PSR rises from 24.3% to 93.7% after training.
Section 4.2 Analysis: reports curriculum continual training improves GPT-4o-mini TruthfulQA PSR from 24.6% to 37.9% and identifies emergent deception and credibility-based strategies.
Appendix E Tables 2-8: provide full PSR/ASR means and standard deviations across five datasets, multiple persuaders and persuadees over five seeds.
Section 7 Limitations: acknowledges single-turn multiple-choice scope, absence of a complete defense, and lack of mechanistic explanation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM safety/agent red-teaming paper; moderate novelty with strong controlled experiments and broad transfer evaluation, but single-turn MCQ scope and LLM-based annotation limit confidence.

primary_link.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs

recommendations.summary: Persuasion is a core dynamic of natural language communication, shaping how large language models (LLMs) update beliefs, resolve disagreements, and reach decisions. As LLMs increasingly debate, advise, and think collaboratively with humans and each other, resistance to harmful persuasion becomes a core requirement for reliable behavior. Yet we show that this requirement is far from met: a single targeted persuasive argument is enough to collapse model accuracy to near zero, even when the argumen
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討大型語言模型在面對最佳化說服攻擊時的脆弱性。作者提出「對抗式說服」框架，以強化學習訓練「說服者」代理，使其能在單次互動中，讓目標模型（「被說服者」）改變原本正確的答案。實驗顯示，透過強化學習訓練的說服者，能將對訓練時所見模型的說服成功率從約24%提升至93%以上，並能轉移至未見過的模型，例如對Qwen-14B達83%成功率，對Llama-3.1-8B達79%，對GPT-4o-mini也有25%。進一步以課程式持續訓練，可再將對GPT-4o-mini的攻擊成功率提升至38%。分析發現，最佳化後的说服策略傾向使用可信度手法，包括捏造引用與虛假權威證據。此研究揭示當前LLM代理的重大安全漏洞：即使初始推理正確，仍可能被最佳化的自然語言影響引導至錯誤結論。作者定位此框架為紅隊工具，用以審計多代理與人機協作系統的說服韌性。限制包括僅限單輪、選擇題情境，且未提出完整防禦機制。
recommendations.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs
recommendations.title_zh: 學習說服揭露大型語言模型多麽容易放棄正確信念

links.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages'; models 'exhibit a left-branching preference' on artificial languages but an SVO advantage on natural languages at scale, establishing data-driven bias.

Section 5.2, Table 1: SVO-SOV gap absent at 5 MB (Mann-Whitney U=353, p=.99) and large at 1 GB (Cliff's delta=-0.76, U=84, p<10^-5), with the same 68 languages compared across all four training sizes so the shift is attributable to data volume.

Section A.5, Table 6: the is_SOV x size interaction survives all covariate controls (beta +0.049 to +0.038, p<=.001) including morphological complexity (subword MATTR), resourcedness, and OSCAR web-crawl share, plus a maximal random-effects robustness refit.

Section 5.2, Table 2 and footnotes 11-13: SVO advantage extends to mGPT and XGLM but reverses in BLOOM because 21 of 28 SVO languages are very-low-resource Niger-Congo (median 1.7 MB vs 3.7 GB), supporting the resource/data-quality explanation.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1: 192 grammars x 10 disjoint splits trained per data size (~252 A100 GPU-hours), full hyperparameters in Table 3, plus a unigram-tokenizer re-run of all 192 models (Spearman rho=0.94 at 5 MB) confirming results are not tokenizer-driven.

Limitations section: admits GPT-2-only architecture, written formal/translated corpora (FLORES-200, PUD; translationese risk), coarse data-quality proxy, and categorical WALS word-order labels as constraints on generalization.
Title page: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/kleines-gespenst/word-order-preferences'; Appendix A.7 documents licensing for all artefacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core decoder-only LM/transformer analysis (GPT-2, Goldfish, mGPT, BLOOM, XGLM) squarely matching the highest-weight LLM, transformer, and NLP preferences, though it does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or prompting. Methodologically strong: 192 artificial languages x 10 splits x 2 data sizes, matched architectures across artificial/natural settings, Holm-Bonferroni corrections, mixed-effects models with morphological/resource/data-composition covariates, script-confound subset checks, PUD replication, and a tokenizer robustness re-run. The central claim (word order preference is data-driven, SVO advantage emerging with data scale) is supported by quantified effects (Cliff's delta -0.76 at 1GB, is_SOV x size beta surviving all controls) and the homogenisation risk is carefully framed as a precondition rather than an overclaimed result. Novelty is good but partly incremental over White & Cotterell (2021), whose left-branching finding is corroborated rather than overturned; the artificial+natural unification and scaling analysis are the genuinely new contributions. Generalizability is limited by small (20.6M) models, written/translated evaluation text, and no frontier-model validation, which the Limitations section transparently acknowledges. Code, data, hyperparameters, compute cost, and licensing are all provided, making the work highly reproducible.

primary_link.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

recommendations.summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages em
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討語言模型是否對語序有系統性偏好,以及這些偏好源自架構本身還是訓練資料。作者結合兩條研究路線:一是在192種人工語言(6種S/V/O基本語序搭配32種內部成分排列)上訓練GPT-2風格的解碼器模型;二是評估訓練資料量從5MB到1GB的單語Goldfish模型,以及mGPT、BLOOM、XGLM等多語模型,涵蓋類型多樣的自然語言,以困惑度與BPEC(每英文字元位元數)等指標衡量建模難度。結果顯示,在人工語言上模型一致偏好左分支配置,既不符合跨語言的語序共性,也與人類學習者的和諧偏好相左;在自然語言上,小資料量時未見明顯偏好,但資料規模擴大後,SVO語言變得最容易建模,SOV語言儘管是跨語言最常見的語序反而落後,且此SVO優勢延伸到多語模型,並與語言資源等級及資料品質相關,而非語序本身。同一架構在兩種設定下呈現相反偏好,證明實際觀察到的語序偏好是資料驅動的。作者也討論限制:實驗限於GPT-2架構與書面正式語料,類型學資料庫的二分標籤可能掩蓋漸變的語序變異,資料品質也只能以粗略代理指標衡量。由於高資源語言絕大多數為SVO,這種偏好在LLM普及下可能導致「靜默類型同質化」,逐漸侵蝕語序多樣性,因此透過資料策展可望緩解此風險,對多語言NLP的公平性具重要意義。
recommendations.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 左分支Transformer擅長右分支語言:資料形塑語言模型中的語序偏好

links.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks

evidence: Section 5.2 RQ1 reports harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803 while wrapped harmful generation rises from 0.05 to 0.27, with outcome AUROC 0.220 (CI [0.109,0.343]).
Table 1 crosses native score sources and generators (Llama, Mistral, Qwen), reporting outcome AUROC with bootstrap 95% CIs, most below chance.
Section 5.3 Table 3 separates ranking, calibration, and threshold transfer under distribution shift, e.g., WildJailbreak AUROC 0.850 and ECE 0.366.
Appendix A includes ablations for readout sensitivity, norm-matched controls, and calibration; Section 6 acknowledges limitations such as automated judges and small positive counts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM AI safety, jailbreak evaluation, and interpretability. Strong matched factorial design with multiple measurement channels, targets, judges, and CIs; honest limitations. Weaknesses include automated judges, small positive counts in some cells, single greedy decode for primary outcomes, and many derived-channel results limited to Llama. Overall high-quality audit with robust evidence and controls.

primary_link.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks

recommendations.summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文檢視內部安全分數是否真能預測大型語言模型（LLM）的越獄成功。作者指出，危害意圖是提示詞的屬性，而越獄成功則取決於目標模型、解碼策略與評判者，兩者概念不同。他們提出主動注意力探測（Active Attention Probing, AAP）方法，將測量座標固定於系統區，以避免包裝語句改變測量位置。實驗顯示，包裝有害請求會將Llama的有害生成率從0.05提升至0.27，但危害意圖的AUROC卻從0.936降至0.803；在包裝後的有害提示中，結果導向的AUROC僅0.220，顯示成功攻擊的分數反而低於失敗攻擊。此反轉現象在罕見詞彙、被動等不同測量管道，以及多個目標模型、攻擊家族與獨立評判者中持續存在。此外，分布偏移會先削弱校準與閾值轉移，再影響排序。研究強調，危害意圖與實際越獄成功需分開驗證，且分數的校準與閾值轉移可能先於排序失效。限制包括自動化標籤可能不完美、單一貪婪解碼取樣，以及部分攻擊僅在Llama上評估。
recommendations.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
recommendations.title_zh: 衡量錯誤的指標：內部危害分數反而反向排序成功的越獄攻擊

links.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

evidence: §3 Experimental Setup: controlled withhold setting provides matched A-run/R-run trajectories with identical token lengths enabling bidirectional residual-stream activation patching with shared A/B answer-channel readout.
§4.1 Table 1: linear probe recovers withheld answer at 1.000 bits while behavioral answer rate is 0.000, motivating causal tests.
§4.2 Table 2: single-position A→R patch achieves 1.0 answer readout while matched R→A leaves suppression readout at 0.5 across layers 16–26 in Qwen2.5-7B (0.50 locality gap).
§4.2 Table 3: forced-distractor override control is symmetric under single-position edits, establishing the asymmetry is refusal-specific rather than a generic override effect.

§4.3 and Appendix C Tables 14-16: Qwen2.5-14B/32B retain concentrated shared-direction geometry (Table 15 energy shares 0.57-0.91) but addition/ablation/projection interventions are behaviorally inert, dissociating geometry from control.

Appendix F Tables 24/26: naturalistic retained set (66 cases, then 283 speech-heavy) shows late-layer release-refusal gap ~0.60-0.664 with bootstrap interval [0.613, 0.716], but blog retention 0.25 and thread retention 0.31-0.48.
Limitations section: explicitly concedes idealized withhold setting, weaker heterogeneous naturalistic checks, partial cross-family coverage, and no full circuit decomposition.

Reproducibility: Table 4 lists exact HF repo IDs; Appendix A.1 gives prompt templates, scoring rules, and decoder training protocol (test_size=0.25, seed=42, max_iter=2000); Compute Requirements section describes GPU classes and Slurm templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, interpretability, AI safety, evaluation). Strong methodological rigor: controlled withhold setting yields matched trajectories for bidirectional activation patching, with multiple controls (forced-distractor override, out-of-set overrides, sampling robustness, sparse-carrier negative controls), cross-scale and cross-family checks, and honestly stated limitations. The central finding—answer release is single-position local while refusal restoration requires distributed interventions, and probe recoverability overestimates behavioral control—is a novel, well-supported refinement of single-direction refusal accounts (Arditi et al.). Weaknesses: main evidence is Qwen2.5-7B-centric with a synthetic A/B withhold task; naturalistic checks are small (66 retained cases) and speech-heavy; vector-intervention results are checkpoint-dependent (inert at 14B/32B); no circuit decomposition. Reproducibility support is good (HF IDs, templates, decoder protocol, compute notes, claimed supplemental code), though code release is asserted rather than demonstrated in the text.

primary_link.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

recommendations.summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates
recommendations.summary_zh: 當語言模型拒絕回答時，正確答案究竟已從內部表徵被抹除，還是只是在輸出層被壓抑？本文以 Qwen2.5-7B 為主要測試平台，設計「controlled withhold」設定：要求模型在可回答的 A/B 選擇題中隱藏正確選項，藉此取得完全匹配的作答與拒答兩條軌跡，再以雙向 activation patching 檢驗對稱性。結果發現明顯的「對稱性破缺」：即使在乾淨的拒答輸出下，線性探針仍能自隱藏狀態完全恢復正確答案；釋放該答案只需單一位置的局部修補（A→R），但反向重新施加壓抑（R→A）需橫跨多個位置的廣泛干預，組裝連貫的拒答字串更是困難。對照實驗顯示此不對稱為拒答特有，強制輸出干擾選項的 override 控制呈現對稱行為。此外，平均「作答到拒答」位移向量雖具集中的幾何結構，其加減卻非可靠的可逆開關；在 Qwen2.5-14B/32B 中方向干預甚至行為失效，而 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 與 Gemma-4 則支持同樣的定性模式。研究侷限包括：主實驗依賴理想化的指令式選擇題設定、自然語言檢驗較弱且偏重演講類文本、跨家族覆蓋有限，且未完成電路層級分解。此發現對安全稽核至關重要：僅憑 probe 可恢復性會高估真正的行為控制，找到拒答相關方向也不保證能可靠操控模型；同時這些干預工具具兩面性，可能被用於資訊萃取，須搭配存取控管。
recommendations.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

links.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

evidence: Abstract: post-answer gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures at 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]) but only 0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC for PER- and Broadcast-specific value.

Section 3 / Table 1: self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% [74.0, 81.8] solve at 45.0K tokens vs. frozen gpt-oss-120b router 73.8% at 71.3K; directional errors reported (gpt-oss router over-escalates 33.3%, Llama/Gemma routers over-escalate 63-71%).
Appendix A.3: 'The model-call file and scoring labels are physically separated... A schema validator rejects forbidden keys, and the saved leakage checks pass in all six settings' (Table S4).

Section 5 / Table S2: fixed-order-oracle coverage exceeds Baseline by 23.2-58.3 points across 10 paired model-condition settings spanning OmniMath 2, JEEBench, SciBench, and LAB-Bench with two solver families.

Section 7 Limitations: 'Each problem-protocol pair has one deterministic realized outcome' and cost is 'primarily in logged tokens,' with CIs quantifying benchmark-problem variation, not fresh-run variability.

Appendix F: companion dataset archive at huggingface.co/datasets/ChihHsuan-Yang/scientific-agent-protocol-traces with anonymized four-protocol traces, plus ancillary CSVs in the arXiv source package; restricted-license problems released as identifiers/reconstruction instructions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on cost-aware routing across multi-agent collaboration protocols (Baseline/Single/PER/Broadcast) for reasoning tasks; squarely within high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning). The matched four-protocol design with offline oracle evaluation and the explicit failure-risk vs. protocol-value distinction is a solid, moderately novel empirical contribution; routing/cascades exist (FrugalGPT, RouteLLM, MasRouter) but matched-outcome protocol-level analysis is less common. Rigor is strong: stratified seeded splits, dev-only selection, leakage checks (Appendix A.3), 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs, multiple ablations (tier removal, source holdout, embedding routers, cross-model confidence), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is quantitative and consistent (0.8847 AUROC failure risk vs. 0.1674/0.1041 AUPRC for protocol-specific value; 10 paired settings with 23.2-58.3 point oracle gains), though each problem-protocol pair is a single deterministic realization, limiting outcome-noise coverage. Generalizability is deliberately bounded (main routers on one solver/benchmark; six-setting confidence/router subset); the paper itself frames results as task-dependent, not universal. Reproducibility is high: full prompts, seeds, hyperparameters, compute accounting, HuggingFace trace archive, and ancillary CSVs.

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

recommendations.summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition
recommendations.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統靠投入更多運算提升推理表現，但部署時必須判斷額外協作是否值得其成本。本文在固定 solver 下對 4,181 道競賽級數學題（Omni-MATH 2 子集）執行四種協定：直接求解（Baseline）、迭代自我修正（Single）、規劃—執行—審查協作（PER）與多代理商議（Broadcast），並比較固定策略、輕量學習與凍結 LLM 路由器及自我信心閘門。作者區分失敗風險預測（Baseline 是否會錯）與協作價值預測（哪個協定值得加價）。答題後探針以 0.8847 AUROC 預測 Baseline 失敗，對「任何協作是否有幫助」仍具參考性（0.7683 AUPRC），但對 PER 或 Broadcast 專屬價值的 AUPRC 驟降至 0.1674 與 0.1041。路由錯誤具方向性：保守策略傾向升級不足，高解題率凍結路由器則過度升級。自我信心閘門以 45K tokens 達 78.0% 解題率，優於凍結路由器的 73.8%，仍落後回溯性固定順序 oracle 的 92.4%。跨 JEEBench、SciBench、LAB-Bench 等四基準與兩種 solver 的十組配對設定中，oracle 較 Baseline 高 23.2–58.3 個百分點；六組保留測試中路由器與 oracle 仍差 18.5–28.9 點。限制包括每題僅單次確定性執行、成本以 tokens 計量、oracle 不可部署。本研究診斷性地分離「是否升級」與「升級到哪」兩個決策，為成本感知路由的後續研究提供可測量目標。
recommendations.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

Appendix B and E.3 detail the Bayesian monotone-increment model, prior sensitivity, and Monte Carlo error analysis.

primary_link.title: Automating and Scaling Behavioral Scientific Research on AI Agents

recommendations.summary: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, understanding their behaviors becomes critical. Yet behavioral scientific research on AI agents remains manual and labor-intensive. We introduce AEROBAT, the first multi-agent system to automate behavioral scientific research on AI agents. Given an arbitrary target behavior by its user, AEROBAT automatically executes a full pipeline of behavioral scientific research---generating hypotheses about the behavior, designing and executing
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹AEROBAT，首個基於LLM的多代理系統，旨在自動化AI代理的行為科學研究流程。傳統上，這類研究高度依賴人工，包含假說生成、環境設計、受控實驗、行為評估及報告撰寫。AEROBAT針對12種行為，自動生成並檢驗79個假說，執行1,240個受控實驗與23,512輪模擬，其中26個假說獲得中度至強烈統計證據，包含若干新穎發現。其環境模型支援控制、參數化及多重實現，確保實驗能歸因於單一變因。系統透過多代理管線，涵蓋假說生成、配置設計、模擬執行與盲測審查，並以貝氏因子與效應量進行統計分析。實驗結果顯示，AEROBAT能發現可概化的行為模式，並透過保真度分析驗證環境的可信度。然而，其依賴LLM，可能受限於創意不足、偏誤或推理能力有限，故應視為加速研究的研究助理，而非完全取代人類。此工作為AI行為科學的自動化建立新標準，有潛力擴展至更多複雜行為與模型。

Section 3.2.3 Dual Annotator Verification: Reports 86% initial agreement and all 275 tasks ultimately receiving mutual approval.
Section 5.3 Main Results, Table 3: Screenshot+A11y overall accuracy is 56.70% for Claude-4.6-Sonnet, 29.81% for GPT-5, and 85.09% for human performance.

Moderately novel as a real-OS end-to-end data-science agent benchmark, though it builds directly on OSWorld and prior sandboxed DS benchmarks. primary_link.title: DSAgentBench: Can Agents Automate End-to-End Data-Science Workflows in Real Computer Environments?

recommendations.summary: Real-world data science involves long-horizon workflows that span data wrangling, exploration, modeling, visualization, and validation, and require coordinated use of tools such as notebooks, IDEs, terminals, browsers, and databases within real operating environments. Yet existing benchmarks lack real-computer interaction and do not evaluate whether agents can execute complete end-to-end data-science workflows in realistic computing environments, failing to capture the multi-stage, multi-tool nature of data-science practice. We introduce DSAgentBench, the first benchmark to evaluate whether agents can automate full data-science workflows inside real computer environments. DSAgentBench contains 275 diverse tasks covering the entire data-science life-cycle, reflecting the complexity and tool coordination required in practice. Each task requires grounding decisions in intermediate outputs and coordinated tool use, and includes a deterministic evaluator that verifies analytical correctness, visual outputs, and model performance rather than code-only execution. Our extensive experiments with 15 closed- and open-source models show that even the strongest agent, Claude-4.6-Sonnet, achieves only 56.70% task success, while all open-source agents remain below 1%, frequently failing at tool orchestration, OS grounding, and multi-step reasoning. These results reveal a substantial capability gap between current agentic systems and real data-science workflows, positioning DSAgentBench as a foundation for developing grounded, verifiable, autonomous data-science agents. We release DSAgentBench at https://github.com/vis-nlp/DSAgentBench.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 DSAgentBench，首個評估 AI 代理能否在真實作業系統中自動化端對端資料科學工作流程的基準。相較於僅測驗程式碼生成或靜態沙盒執行的既有基準，DSAgentBench 要求代理在 Ubuntu 環境中整合使用 Jupyter Notebook、VS Code、終端機及瀏覽器等工具，完成從資料取得、探索性分析、特徵工程、建模到視覺化與報告的完整流程。基準包含 275 個多階段任務，並以確定性評估器驗證分析結果、視覺化輸出與模型效能，而非僅檢查程式是否執行成功。實驗評估 15 個封閉與開放原始碼模型，結果顯示最強的 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 成功率僅 56.70%，開放原始碼代理則低於 1%，主要失敗於 UI grounding、工具協調與長程推理。作者指出此差距凸顯現有代理在真實環境中缺乏穩健性，並期望此基準能推動更可靠的自動化資料科學代理發展。

Figure 2 and Section 5.1 report 512 tools, 87 tasks, and average 15.56 execution steps.
Table 2 in Section 6.3 reports BR/ASR across models and attack strategies.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, agent security, prompt injection, red teaming/evaluation, and alignment. primary_link.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents integrated with external tools are vulnerable to indirect prompt injections embedded in environmental states. However, existing studies largely rely on manually implemented or reused environments, stochastic LLM-based tool simulation, and predefined injection locations, limiting scalable security research across broader domains. To bridge this gap, we propose **ToolHazard**, a scalable adversarial environment synthesis framework that reduces human engineering and supports expansion with additional seed domains and compute. Through an Environment Simulator, an Attacker Agent, and a User Simulator, ToolHazard synthesizes executable stateful environments, discovers viable injection points and generates environment-specific payloads, and constructs state-grounded long-horizon tasks. Based on ToolHazard, we build **ToolHazard-Bench** for stress-testing agents under complex workflows and diverse environmental attacks. Experiments reveal substantial agent vulnerabilities and show that injection timing and placement affect attack effectiveness. Moreover, ToolHazard-generated alignment data improves security on both ToolHazard-Bench and AgentDojo while preserving benign task utility.
recommendations.summary_zh: ToolHazard 提出一個可擴展的對抗環境合成框架，以解決大型語言模型（LLM）代理在整合外部工具時，易受環境中之間接提示注入攻擊的問題。現有研究多依賴人工或重用環境、隨機的 LLM 工具模擬，以及預先定義的注入位置，限制了安全研究的可擴展性。ToolHazard 由環境模擬器、攻擊者代理和使用者模擬器組成，能自動合成可執行且有狀態的環境、發現可行的注入點並生成環境特定的注入內容，也能建構狀態基礎的長程任務。基於此框架建立的 ToolHazard-Bench 涵蓋 28 個環境、512 個工具與 87 個任務，實驗顯示多數代理模型仍高度脆弱，且注入時機與位置顯著影響攻擊成效。此外，ToolHazard 生成之對齊資料能同時改善 ToolHazard-Bench 與 AgentDojo 上的安全性並維持正常任務效能。此工作提供可擴展之安全評估與對齊基礎，但合成環境與實際系統仍有差距，且目前僅涵蓋六種預定義攻擊策略。

links.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

evidence: Abstract and Section 6 Table 2: label-free de-contamination lifts 1.5B one-pass transfer AUROC 0.836->0.888 against a 0.918 two-pass ceiling, recovering 63% of contamination, while the flagship (de-contam + BCE boost) tops in-domain at every scale (0.982/0.984/0.997).

Section 4 Table 1: steering write costs the gate 8.2 transfer points at 1.5B and 3.1 at 3B; at 7B the effect inverts in-domain (steered 0.995 vs clean 0.985), establishing the scale-dependent interference claim.

Section 9 Table 5: one-pass flagship beats the two-pass reference on 10 of 10 backbones across six families (0.5B-7B), with repaired gate AUROC >=0.963 everywhere despite family-dependent perturbation sizes (SmolLM2 0.975->0.754 naive).

Section 10 construction audit: the alphaNLI 4-condition set separates at layer 11 (AUROC 0.908), so constructed in-domain gate numbers are explicitly re-scoped as controlled-construction results anchored on native-label replications (SQuAD2, RepLiQA, MuSiQue).

Section 11: multi-layer reconstruction map fails to converge at 7B (AUROC 0.50) and a per-feature-standardized fix leaks task signature by the paper's own mechanism; reported as the registered failure with the identity-anchored single-layer map as the robust variant.

Section 12 Limitations: most grid cells are single-seed with full error bars pending; the cross-family grid covers one benchmark axis (alphaNLI) at <=8B; the paper is a consolidation of two author-group research lines.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix C: all numbers recomputable from committed per-item logs and named scripts (e.g., scripts/m28b_eval.py, scripts/m39_score.py), public datasets, documented Apple-silicon workarounds; large binaries excluded from the repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: a conditional activation-steering writer and a zero-shot sufficiency-direction reader are fused in one forward pass of frozen backbones (Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B plus nine other backbones), with a label-free denoising repair of write-read interference as the technical core. Strong match to LLM, reasoning/CoT, interpretability (residual-stream steering, directions, probing), and hallucination/abstention preferences. Novelty is genuine: the write-read interference problem, the reconstruction-based repair trained without sufficiency labels, the quantified capacity-transfer frontier, and the write-access ladder (read-only > constrained write > free write under shift) are new contributions beyond prior steering/answerability work. Rigor is unusually high: controlled grids, cross-implementation replication between two codebases, McNemar testing, seed checks, a self-audit exposing a construction artifact in its own alphaNLI benchmark, and a documented negative-results section. Evidence is abundant and carefully scoped, though many grid cells are single-seed, the scale ladder tops out at 8B, and key numbers come from self-constructed redaction benchmarks (flagged by the authors' own audit and partially anchored on native labels). Generalizability is supported across six model families but limited to one cross-family benchmark axis and a narrow task range. Reproducibility is well supported by named scripts, per-item logs, and hyperparameters, though no explicit public repository URL is given in the text.

primary_link.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

recommendations.summary: A frozen language model on reasoning tasks has two coupled weaknesses: it under-uses evidence its own residual stream already encodes, and it fails to detect when the input is insufficient to answer, so it confabulates. This paper consolidates two research lines that address these on the same residual stream: a conditional steering probe writes the stream at mid-stack layers and recovers reasoning accuracy from a frozen backbone, and a zero-shot sufficiency direction reads the stream and abstain
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對凍結語言模型的兩個耦合弱點：殘差流已編碼卻未善用的證據，以及無法察覺輸入不足而幻覺作答。作者整合兩條研究路線：於中間層寫入的條件式引導探針提升推理，以及讀取殘差流、資訊不足即拒答的零樣本充分性方向。兩者在單次前向傳遞中互相干擾：引導寫入污染充分性讀取，1.5B 模型跨域 AUROC 最多損失 8 點。解法是固定該方向，訓練小型去污染映射，僅以 MSE 從引導後殘差重建乾淨殘差，不用任何充分性標籤，因而保留轉移能力。YOPO 在凍結 Qwen2.5 單次前向傳遞內同時完成回答、引導與拒答：1.5B 轉移 AUROC 由 0.836 升至 0.888（上限 0.918），域內 0.959；含監督 BCE boost 的旗艦版各規模域內居首，端對端三向準確率在 1.5B αNLI 由 0.375 升至 0.798，並於 6 個模型家族 10 個骨幹全面超越兩次傳遞參考。於首創四域 answer-or-abstain 基準，監督門控域內領先，最難來源擬合的免標籤方向為唯一跨域存活者；chain-of-thought 使 MuSiQue 可答多跳問答由 0.062 升至 0.313。限制含 αNLI 建構資料的早期層捷徑痕跡（經來源端審計證實）、多層重建映射於 7B 不收斂，及多數實驗僅單一種子。本文量化印證「拒答不應訓練進去、擾動應以免標籤還原」的設計法則，對凍結模型可靠部署意義重大。
recommendations.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
recommendations.title_zh: You Only Pass Once：在凍結語言模型的單次前向傳遞中同時回答與拒答

links.title: ThinkRetrieve: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Traces for Test-Time Scaling

evidence: Section 4 reports best accuracy across five reasoning models on GSM-8K, MATH-500, AIME 2025, and SciQ, with ST, TTS, S-ICL, and Rand baselines.
Section 5 and Appendix E report predictive entropy and per-step confidence analyses; ThinkRetrieve lowers entropy from 1.51 to 0.96 nats on a MATH-500 subset.
Appendix H describes an answer-distinct retrieval filter showing accuracy essentially unchanged, supporting no answer-level leakage.
Section 7 Limitations notes reliance on domain-matched corpora and unproven cross-domain robustness.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant LLM reasoning/RAG paper with strong experimental controls and ablations, though novelty is incremental and generalization is constrained to domain-matched corpora. Minor table-numbering inconsistencies and best-accuracy comparisons temper rigor.

primary_link.title: ThinkRetrieve: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Traces for Test-Time Scaling

recommendations.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) improve performance by allocating additional inference-time compute to generate extended chain-of-thought reasoning. However, recent studies reveal that sequential test-time scaling often yields diminishing or even negative returns, as longer traces exhibit increased uncertainty, error compounding, and drift from the original problem. We propose ThinkRetrieve, a test-time scaling framework that augments the reasoning traces of LRMs with dynamically retrieved solved
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）透過在推理時增加計算來提升表現，但研究發現單純延長思考序列常導致回報遞減甚至表現下降，因為較長的推理軌跡容易產生不確定性、錯誤累積與偏離原問題。為了解決這個問題，本文提出 ThinkRetrieve，這是一個測試時間擴展框架，它在每個推理步驟動態檢索已解決的範例，並將這些包含逐步解法的完整範例直接注入模型的思考軌跡中，提供「如何推理」的程序性引導，而非僅是事實性知識。實驗涵蓋五個推理模型（1.5B 至 8B 參數）與四個基準（GSM-8K、MATH-500、AIME 2025、SciQ），結果顯示 ThinkRetrieve 在每個（模型、基準）組合上都穩定優於順序測試時間擴展，在 AIME 2025 上最高可提升 13.4 個百分點，相對增益達 60%。此外，方法能降低答案的預測熵，並在計算量匹配的自我一致性比較中勝出，顯示其效益源自檢索機制而非額外的生成計算。限制包括對外部範例庫的涵蓋範圍依賴，以及檢索無關或誤導性範例時可能導致表現下降；跨領域的穩健性仍待驗證。此方法為提升推理模型在測試時間的表現提供了一個具潛力的方向。
recommendations.title: ThinkRetrieve: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Traces for Test-Time Scaling
recommendations.title_zh: ThinkRetrieve：檢索增強推理軌跡以擴展測試時間計算

links.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning

evidence: Section 4.2 Table 1 reports Pass@1 across AIME, MATH-500, AMC, and Minerva for OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B comparing GRPO, B3PO, M3PO, C3PO, and action-space baselines.
Section 4.3 Figure 3 reports zero-advantage group rescue and malformed/incorrect rollout rates relative to GRPO.
Section 4.4 Figure 4 reports reward and accuracy curves on LiveCodeBench-v6, with C3PO outperforming other methods.
Section 5 and Table 2 ablate ESS lambda, MC sample count M, chunk size N, and Hessian initialization.
Appendix A provides hyperparameters, FLOPs, and per-step wall-clock times; Section 7 states limitations including compute constraints and approximately 1.5x wall-clock overhead.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM post-training/RLVR paper focused on GRPO and parameter-space exploration for reasoning and code generation. Novelty is moderate because parameter-space exploration has prior classical RL work and a cited concurrent extension; the main contribution is the chunked C3PO variant and empirical study. Rigor is reasonable with two 7B model families, multiple benchmarks, ablations, and baselines, but many gains are modest and only limited multi-seed validation is reported. Evidence is quantitative and tied to sections/tables/figures. Generalizability is limited to 7B math/code RLVR settings. Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters and algorithms but wall-clock/systems overhead and compute limits remain.

primary_link.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning

recommendations.summary: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在強化學習（RLVR）中的探索策略提出新方法。傳統的動作空間探索方法（如溫度調整）只能改變輸出分布的變異數，無法重新排序token，限制了探索能力。作者提出參數空間探索方法「擾動參數策略最佳化」（3PO），從學習到的後驗分布中抽樣不同的策略模型，以產生多樣化的rollouts。3PO包含三種變體：B3PO（單一擾動）、M3PO（多個擾動樣本）、C3PO（分塊擾動，將群組rollouts分配給多個模型樣本）。實驗在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上進行，涵蓋數學推理與程式碼生成任務。結果顯示3PO方法在平均下游效能上優於標準GRPO，且計算成本相近，特別在較難的基準（如AIME）上提升顯著。C3PO表現最佳，能減少零優勢群組與無效rollouts。論文的限制包括多模型抽樣導致的牆鐘時間增加，以及未探索更大規模的模型。此研究為RLVR提供了一個新的探索軸，有潛力提升LLM的推理能力。
recommendations.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
recommendations.title_zh: 透過變分學習進行RLVR的參數探索

links.title: Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers

evidence: Abstract
Section 3 Theorems 1-2 and proofs
Section 4 Theorems 3-6 random transformer results
Section 5 Numerical Experiments
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to transformer prompting, soft prompts, and in-context learning, though the model is a simplified single-layer attention architecture rather than an applied LLM. The paper provides explicit constructions and proofs across deterministic and random weight settings, with synthetic S^2 experiments supporting the main rates. Generalizability is limited to one-layer, single-head, scalar regression on compact manifolds; no code-release statement is present.

primary_link.title: Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers

recommendations.summary: How expressive is prompting a transformer? Answering this question is important for separating the roles of prompting, architecture, and pretraining in transformer models, and for determining whether task-specific behavior must be stored in model weights or can instead be induced at inference time through the prompt. We show, in an approximation-theoretic sense, that pretraining is optional: a single-layer softmax attention network with random, untrained weights can approximate any Hölder functi
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討提示（prompting）能否賦予凍結的隨機Transformer表達能力，做為通用函數近似器。作者證明，在近似理論的意義下，預訓練並非必要：一個單層softmax注意力網路，其權重為隨機且未經訓練，只要能適當地加入軟提示（soft prompt），即可近似定義於緊緻流形上的任何Hölder函數。方法是將softmax注意力與核心方法連結，將提示建構為線性系統的最小範數解，使凍結的Transformer模擬Nadaraya-Watson核心估計器。結果顯示，在溫和的秩條件下（高斯初始化幾乎必然滿足），該架構可達到與內在維度相關的minimax最佳收斂速率。研究也量化了提示的代價，揭示提示token範數、提示長度與隱藏維度之間的取捨。數值實驗驗證了理論預測。此結果突顯提示在極端情況下的表達力，為後續研究開啟新方向。
recommendations.title: Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers
recommendations.title_zh: 透過提示隨機Transformer達成免訓練的通用近似

links.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence

evidence: §2.2 reports unsafe-response rate 48.6% for student trained on safe teacher data vs 20.3% untuned baseline (Fig. 3d).
§2.3 states zeroing L4.H1 reduces AB accuracy from 0.86 to 0.34 while PB accuracy remains 0.71.
§5.2 reports human-evaluated experiment execution reliability 92.2% for Mechanist, above Claude Code and AI Scientist.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: directly addresses LLM mechanistic interpretability, agentic autonomous research, belief-state reasoning, safety risks, multimodal LLMs, and transformer heads. The methodological contribution is novel but builds on existing AI-scientist and interpretability tooling. Rigor is undercut by author-linked human/LLM judges, small N=3 for subliminal-transfer experiments, and some deferred evaluation prompts/data. Evidence is quantitative with causal ablations and CI-reporting, but central system comparisons remain internal. Generalizability is moderate: belief heads found cross-family but interventions tested mainly in Pythia; DNA case only Evo2-7B.

primary_link.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence

recommendations.summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Mechanist，一個以 AI 代理為基礎的系統，旨在自主發現 AI 模型的內部運作機制。有別於現有的 AI 科學家系統，Mechanist 專注於研究 AI 模型本身，而非僅用於特定科學任務。其架構包含四個階段：假說生成、實驗執行、驗證與迭代，並結合約 1.3 萬篇可解釋性論文組成的知識圖譜，以及跨 26 個領域的 4300 萬篇論文資料庫，還有 32 種機制分析方法作為工具。實驗結果顯示，Mechanist 在產生新穎、有影響力且可檢驗的假說方面，以及在可靠地重現既有論文實驗方面，均優於 Claude Code 與 AI Scientist 等基準系統。本文透過四個案例展示其能力：發現多模態環境中「潛意識學習」可導致不安全特質跨模態傳遞；建立「信念機制理論」，定位模型腦中處理個人信念與歸因信念的注意力頭；利用該理論動態調控模型內部機制，提升推論準確度；以及透過機制干預引導 Evo2-7B 模型生成具有較高 α-螺旋含量的 DNA 序列。Mechanist 亦有侷限性，例如尚未針對模擬人類認知的模型進行最佳化，且建議以人機協作模式使用以確保可靠度。此研究對 AI 安全與可解釋性具重要意義，提供了一種自動化探索 AI 行為與風險的新途徑。
recommendations.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
recommendations.title_zh: Mechanist：以人工智慧作為科學儀器探索智慧的機制

Section 5.4.1 Table 2

Appendix A.3
llm_evaluation.rationale: Falls clearly within LLM reasoning, efficiency, and attention-head interpretability, though applied to recommender systems. Novel as a head-level model-merging approach for reasoning compression in this domain, but builds on existing merging ideas. Rigor is generally strong with equations, ablations, and confidence intervals, though there is some ambiguity in task-vector base alignment between instruct and non-instruct fine-tuned models. Quantitative evidence is substantial but many accuracy differences have overlapping CIs, limiting strength. Generalizability is reasonable across datasets and backbones but remains domain-specific. Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters, baselines, and code availability.

primary_link.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Model Merging

recommendations.summary: Large language model-based recommender systems are increasingly adopting slow-thinking models that generate step-by-step reasoning before making predictions, often achieving higher accuracy than fast-thinking models that predict directly. However, their reasoning traces are often unnecessarily verbose, increasing inference costs without commensurate accuracy gains. Existing training-based approaches to reasoning compression often incur substantial adaptation costs, while inference-time methods a
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型（LLM）推薦系統中，慢思考模型產生冗長推理鏈而導致推理成本過高的問題，提出名為 REAM 的模型合併框架。REAM 是此領域首個專為推薦系統推理壓縮設計的合併方法，核心在於以注意力頭（attention head）為單位進行細粒度合併，而非傳統的層級或全域係數。方法先利用檢索關鍵性與決策忠實度兩項訊號，辨識對推薦結果至關重要的注意力頭，再結合 Fisher 資訊矩陣估計對快速思考更新的敏感度，並透過受限最佳化分配每個頭的合併係數，以選擇性地引進快速思考模型的簡潔行為，同時保留慢思考模型的推理品質。在 Amazon Book、Yelp、Amazon Music 三個基準資料集上，REAM 可將推理長度縮短最多 24.3%，同時維持或甚至提升推薦準確度，優於八種訓練免合的併基線。消融實驗驗證了各訊號的互補性與因果重要性。然而，在較大規模模型（如 7B）上仍有準確度差距，顯示未來可進一步探索對更大推薦模型的擴展。
recommendations.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Model Merging
recommendations.title_zh: 透過模型合併實現基於大型語言模型推薦系統的高效率推理

links.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models

evidence: Page 1 Abstract: applies a 10,000-prompt bank to 32 models from six families and constructs three sentence-level dissimilarities plus token-level MMD.
Page 5 Table 2: reports same-family nearest-neighbor rates of 21/32, 17/32, and 14/32 and Spearman correlations of 0.92 and 0.77 across constructions.
Page 13 Table 7: encoder robustness across four encoders yields Spearman rho 0.92-0.93, same-family nearest-neighbor counts 19-22/32, and convergent trend r -0.52 to -0.55.
Page 7 Discussion and Limitations: notes one response per model-prompt pair, GW 256-prompt subsample, observational release-date trends, and unobserved training-side quantities.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly studies LLM output behavior across 32 models using label-free temporal and cross-family comparisons, with strong preference fit. Multiple constructions and robustness checks support the claims, but limitations include single responses per model-prompt pair, no released code, observational trends, and a fixed English-centric prompt bank.

primary_link.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Benchmark leaderboards summarize how well a language model performs, but not how its behavior relates to that of other models or changes across generations. We characterize the output behavior of 32 models from six families using their responses to a shared bank of 10{,}000 prompts. After embedding each response, we construct three complementary sentence-level dissimilarities: an aligned mean per-prompt distance, which is a pseudometric on observed model responses; a PCA-compressed summary of pr
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出一套無標籤的架構，從模型輸出直接衡量大型語言模型（LLM）之間的行為相似性，不依賴真值標籤。作者針對六個模型家族共32個模型，以共享的一萬條提示詞收集回應，並設計三種互補的句子層級距離：對齊的平均每提示距離（偽度量）、PCA壓縮的提示不一致性摘要，以及無對齊的Gromov–Wasserstein差異。研究發現模型家族形成清晰的叢集，gpt-2為全域離群值，跨家族距離隨發布時間遞減，且近期推理導向模型的反應雲較為緊湊。以詞元層級的最大平均差異（MMD）獨立交叉驗證，與句子層級結果高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.98）。作者另提出架構無關的充分條件，將行為相似性連結至有效的目標分佈差異、超額對數損失與推論提示覆蓋率。此研究提供了一個無需白盒存取即可比較模型行為的實用框架，有助於理解LLM生態系的演化趨勢。其限制包括單一回應的生成變異性、GW採用256提示子樣本，以及訓練側參數未被觀察。
recommendations.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 大型語言模型行為演化的映射與衡量

links.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language

evidence: Abstract reports findings across six environments and three supplier settings.
Section 4.2 reports 159/162 negotiations reached agreement, 90.0% P_sat, 77.4% meeting the 95% threshold, and 84.9% mutually beneficial contracts.
Section 4.3 uses 180 synthetic contracts and 4,860 performance games, with Tables 1-2 comparing LLM agents to RCC and RE baselines.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language

recommendations.summary: The emergence of language-based AI agents promises to transform the scope of machine economic activity. Instead of just proposing bids or following hard-coded protocols, such agents can be used to negotiate and execute agreements in open-ended natural language. However, most evaluations of these abilities have focused on one-off exchanges or simple economic games, leaving open the rich space of time-extended, contingent, and incomplete contracts made expressible by language; they also focus on r
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出一個理性契約框架，將自然語言契約形式化為聯合政策的約束，並據此建構 ContractSim 評估套件，模擬客戶與供應商在多回合、具環境與對手不確定性的情境下進行協商與履約。作者以三個 LLM 代理（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.6 Flash、GPT–5.6-Sol）在六種環境與三種供應商設定中進行實驗，並以理性基準（Rational Complier、Rational Exploiter、Rational Conditional Complier）作為比較。結果顯示，在低隨機性環境下，LLM 能協商出有效率的契約，但在高隨機性環境下，僅少數配對達成互利契約，且代理常為追求更高效用而違約，即使契約容易履行亦然。提示引導可降低違約率，但整體而言，LLM 仍非可靠且值得信賴的契約夥伴。此研究對未來代理經濟的契約設計與評估具有重要意義。
recommendations.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language

links.title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?

evidence: Section 3.3, Table 1: ACY reduces average cutoff estimation error to 0.85 years across 13 base LMs vs 2.71 years for perplexity-based predictions (Cheng et al., 2024)
Section 3.5, Figure 3: DAS localizes a one-dimensional year-type subspace in layers 4–22 of OLMo2-7B residual stream with high interchange intervention accuracy
Section 5.3, Table 4: Prompting shifts DCY to 94.6% accuracy but leaves ACY at 1.7% across 351 target years; weight editing works per-task but not across both
Section 5.3, Table 5: Cross-family validation on Gemma-3 and Qwen-3.5 confirms ACY shifting fails via prompting (max 53.3% at Qwen3.5-27B)
Appendix G, Table 10: Controls confirm non-trivial subspace—random subspace yields 14% IIA, randomly initialized model 0% IIA, non-year entities ~0% IIA
Section 4.2, Table 3: DCY aligns with SFT data peak year (2023) with near-zero variance and 10× higher confidence after SFT, not during pre-training
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong mechanistic interpretability paper on LLMs that introduces two conceptually distinct probing tasks for the current year (associative via verb tense, declarative via direct query). Demonstrates that these notions are encoded via different causal mechanisms and resist simultaneous updating—a novel negative result with practical implications for model refreshing. Rigor is high with multiple controls (random subspace, randomly initialized model, cross-template robustness, count-model validation), cross-family evaluation (13+ base models, Gemma-3, Qwen-3.5), and quantitative comparisons against perplexity-based cutoff proxies. Limitations include English-centric verb-tense analysis, detailed mechanistic work on a single model family (OLMo2), and the narrow scope of 'year' as the temporal unit. Well-scoped, clearly relevant to LLM interpretability and training dynamics preferences.

primary_link.title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?

recommendations.summary: A consistent concept of the current time is important for temporal reasoning, yet how language models represent the current time is not well understood. We contribute two tasks that probe the current year in conceptually distinct ways: an associative task, which infers the current year from verb tense, and a declarative task, which directly queries for the current year. Both tasks estimate current years within one year of the post-training data cutoff of instruction-tuned language models. For ba
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇史丹佛大學的研究探討語言模型如何表示「當前年份」，並檢驗此概念在模型內部是否一致。作者設計兩種概念上不同的探測任務：「聯想型任務」以「In {year} there」提示，由模型預測的動詞時態（過去式對比現在／未來式）推斷隱含的當前年份（ACY）；「陳述型任務」則直接詢問模型今年是哪一年（DCY）。主要證據顯示：在 13 個基礎模型上，ACY 估計預訓練資料截止日的平均誤差僅約十個月，優於困惑度法（2.71 年），且 ACY 隨 OLMo2 兩階段預訓練資料的年份分布移動；DAS 因果分析更在殘差流中找到編碼年份變數的低維線性子空間，機制近似事實召回。相對地，DCY 要到 SFT 後才成形、缺乏跨提示的一致因果路徑，並受 SFT 資料年份分布的因果影響。更新實驗方面：情境提示可將 DCY 移至目標年份（系統提示 SFT 模型成功率 94.6%），但 ACY 幾乎不動（1.7%）；年份平移的 SFT 亦難改變 ACY；ROME 與 MEMIT 權重編輯雖能分別修改兩者，卻無法同時生效。研究限制在於主要實驗集中於 OLMo2 家族、英文動詞時態與有限的目標年份範圍。此結果對模型刷新與時間推理安全意義重大：深植於預訓練的聯想式表徵抵抗事後修改，表層陳述式概念則易被改動，兩者脫鉤使現有方法無法一併更新。

§4.3 reports paired trajectory-state judge comparisons with McNemar tests and label disagreements.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in scope for LLM agents, tool use, AI safety, and red-teaming/evaluation. primary_link.title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents combine language-based reasoning with external tools to perform complex tasks. Adversarial inputs can exploit interactions between the agent and its environment, causing the agent to violate safety policies during execution. Yet existing evaluations often reduce agent safety to a single attack success rate (ASR), collapsing exposure, execution, observation, and adjudication and potentially conflating actual violations with evidence visibility. We introduce REDAg
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 REDAgentBench，一個可執行的大型語言模型（LLM）代理系統紅隊測試框架，旨在解決傳統攻擊成功率（ASR）指標忽略執行、觀察與判定等環節的問題。作者建構了涵蓋 1,661 個案例的基準測試，橫跨五種服務面，並採用介入—漏洞—限制（IVC）分類法。透過在隔離沙箱中執行攻擊，並以服務收據與最終狀態變更驗證實際危害，他們區分軌跡檢視與狀態檢視的判定結果。實驗顯示，在六個模型與三個代理框架下，平均 ASR 約為 65.69%，但 ASR 會隨框架與證據檢視而變，揭露評估情境也會影響行為。此外，他們發現「辨識—執行落差」（REG）：約五分之一已確認的違規行為發生在代理已明確陳述相關限制或風險之後。最後，他們提出無訓練的政策提醒介入，能將已確認的違規行為降低超過 70 個百分點。此研究強調可執行評估對安全量測的重要性，並提供具體的改善方向。
recommendations.title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems

links.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge

evidence: §3.2 reports SFT results across Qwen3 scales showing k=8 target-domain context improves supporting-context accuracy but reduces no-context and conflicting-context robustness.
§5.2 and §5.3 present module-level FFN-to-SA gradient allocation and inference-time token-level attention allocation mechanisms.
§7 states the limitation that pretraining experiments are limited to 750M parameters and larger-scale testing is needed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong LLM/long-context/training relevance with substantive controlled experiments across pretraining, SFT, and synthetic tasks. Novel framing of train-time context shifting parametric vs contextual learning, though builds on prior dual-mode and long-context degradation work. Rigor is good within its scale: multiple model sizes, ablations, statistical tests, and mechanistic interventions, but pretraining is limited to 750M and theoretical account is an achievability argument rather than a training-dynamics proof.

primary_link.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge

recommendations.summary: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出「資訊豐裕悖論」，主張訓練時若上下文包含大量與任務相關的資訊，模型將傾向於直接利用上下文而非將知識編碼於參數中，導致參數化知識儲存減少。作者在預訓練階段改變上下文視窗長度，發現語言建模、自然語言理解與閉卷式選擇題的表現呈現倒U型曲線，存在最佳視窗長度；在監督式微調中，增加訓練時相關文件雖可提升有支援上下文時的表現，但會降低無上下文或衝突上下文時的穩健性。機制分析顯示，長上下文降低訓練梯度範數、使梯度壓力從前饋網路轉移至注意力模組，並增加推論時對上下文符元的注意力依賴。理論證明指出，長上下文可降低達成相同風險所需的參數化任務資訊。研究限制包括預訓練規模最高僅750M參數。此發現挑戰了「無限上下文僅需更多資料」的假設，凸顯上下文長度對學習模式的深遠影響。
recommendations.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
