links.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning

evidence: Section 4.1: FoT@32 and SC@32 return the same correctness outcome on 3,580 of 3,600 paired model-problem instances (12 FoT wins, 8 losses), not significant under McNemar's exact test (p=0.50), bootstrap CI [-0.14,+0.36] pp.
Table 2: across 6 models x 4 math benchmarks, FoT@32 averages 94.5 accuracy vs SC@32's 94.4 with 50.7% average attention-FLOP saving; per-cell savings range ~33-60%.

Table 7 (Section 4.5): two-by-two ablation shows random pruning loses accuracy (-0.42) at similar compute savings while hesitation-density pruning preserves SC@32 (94.61 without early voting), isolating the lexical signal as the operative mechanism.
Section 4.4 / Table 6: online SGLang deployment on a single A100 with DS-R1-7B on 30 AIME24 problems: FoT@32 solves 24/30 vs SC@32's 23/30, wall time -37.6%, attention FLOPs -56.1%.

Section 4.2 / Table 4: unchanged configuration transfers to four held-out models (Qwen3-14B/32B, Skywork-OR1-7B, Phi-4-reasoning), aggregate +0.6pp with 51.9% average FLOP saving; Section 4.3 / Table 5 shows GPQA-Diamond +1.3pp and LCB-Lite +1.42pp mean pass rate with pass@32 -2.8pp.

Section 6 Limitations: evaluation restricted to extractable-answer tasks, calibration pool has MATH500 supplying 3,000 of 3,600 pairs, English-only marker kernel and fixed checkpoints; Appendix D.2 quantifies savings degrading from 48.7% to 23.0% under linear attention.

Appendix D.1: generation uses SGLang with T=0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 30, max 32,768 tokens, seed 42+rep_id; grading moved from exact match to math_verify with effects disclosed; Table 8 lists the full 21-marker kernel with point-biserial statistics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-efficiency work squarely within scope: a training-free test-time scaling method (early voting + hesitation-marker-density pruning) that matches SC@32 accuracy at roughly half attention FLOPs across six LRMs, directly serving the high-weight reasoning/CoT, LLM, scaling-efficiency, and inference-serving preferences. Novelty is moderate: the lexical 'Wait/Actually/perhaps' signal is simple and adjacent to prior keyword-suppression and budget-forcing work; the distinct contribution is pool-level relative density ranking plus vote banking, and the demonstrated Pareto point rather than a new modeling technique. Rigor is unusually strong: 115,200 rollouts, pre-registered baselines (Adaptive Consistency, Slim-SC, DSC, Certaindex proxy), a 340-configuration hyperparameter sweep, a 2x2 mechanism ablation showing random pruning loses accuracy while density pruning does not (Table 7), kernel-size robustness, and significance testing (McNemar p=0.50, bootstrap CI) with honest reporting of non-significant accuracy deltas and three coexisting FLOP accountings. Evidence is mostly well supported, though most results are offline simulations of a pre-generated pool and the online deployment (Table 6) covers only 30 problems on one model; the calibration pool is admittedly MATH500-dominated. Generalization is demonstrated on four held-out models and two out-of-domain tasks with an unchanged configuration, but is scoped to English, extractable-answer tasks and large pools (k>=16-24), and savings degrade to 23.0% under linear attention (Appendix D.2). Reproducibility is good: generation parameters, seeds, the full 21-marker kernel, checkpoint schedules, and baseline configurations are disclosed, but no explicit code-release claim is made.

primary_link.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning

recommendations.summary: Large Reasoning Models produce diverse, sometimes inconsistent answers across repeated queries on the same problem, so multi-sample inference is a prerequisite for reliable deployment. Majority voting at k rollouts is the standard solution and the de facto accuracy target for this regime, but it is prohibitively expensive at the scale LRMs require. We introduce Funnel of Thoughts (FoT), an inference-time method that preserves the full 32-trajectory voted accuracy while halving its attention FLOP
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）對同一問題重複取樣時，答案常多樣且不一致，因此以 Self-Consistency（SC@k）多數決投票作為可靠部署的標準做法，但每條軌跡都須完整生成，注意力計算量隨序列長度平方成長，在 LRM 規模下成本高昂。本文分析 6 個 LRM 在 AIME24/25、AMC23 與 MATH500 上共 115,200 條推理軌跡，發現錯誤與無答案軌跡僅佔約 9.5%，卻消耗不成比例的運算，且其文本中猶豫標記（如 Wait、Actually、perhaps）密度顯著偏高，與正確性呈負相關。作者據此提出 Funnel of Thoughts（FoT）：在固定 token 數檢查點執行兩項機制——早期投票先將已承諾答案的軌跡存入票庫，軌跡剪枝則依密度排名移除最無生產力的少數，全程不需訓練、獎勵模型或 logit 存取。結果顯示 FoT@32 在維持 SC@32 準確率的同時，節省約一半注意力 FLOPs（全模型 FLOP 減少 28.8%），線上部署時整體耗時亦降低 37.6%，且相同設定可直接轉移到未調校的模型與 GPQA、程式碼生成等跨領域任務。限制包括僅適用於可抽取最終答案的任務、取樣池過小（k<16）時剪枝可能有害，以及猶豫標記核心與答案承諾偵測皆以英文情境為主，且在高效率注意力機制下節省幅度會縮減。其價值在於以零成本的詞彙訊號，大幅降低測試時擴展的運算門檻。
recommendations.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning
recommendations.title_zh: Funnel of Thoughts：透過早期投票與軌跡剪枝實現高效率測試時擴展

links.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: MT-InfoSeek instantiates a k-underspecified CSP formulation with 5,251 problems and 9,006 task instances spanning mathematics, logic, biology, medicine, and general knowledge.
Section 4, Takeaway 1/Fig. 3: k-prediction accuracy falls below 0.5 for k>=2, and at k=2 models predict a smaller k more than 4x as often as a larger one.

Appendix C.5: reruns under random and cooperative oracles confirm robustness - final sufficiency drops 29.7-41.9 pp (random) and 25.0-39.0 pp (cooperative) from k=1 to k=4 for four representative models.

Appendix C.6, Tables 4-10: LLM-based oracles (20Q, ClinGuide-MT) validated via 91.9-97.7% within-oracle consistency, 94.0% cross-oracle agreement, and human audits of 300 20Q questions and 200 ClinGuide oracle responses.

Appendix G.1.4, Table 22: prompt-perturbation study with problem-level cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, Holm correction) shows meaning-preserving reordering (P1) is within run-to-run noise for all tested models.
Appendix G.1.5, Table 23: force-ask intervention at k=3 raises final sufficiency by +25.7 pp for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-FP8 (exact McNemar p<5e-4), with no significant effect for GPT-5-mini.

Appendix G.1.1/G.1.2: pooled fixed-effect regressions with interaction-clustered SEs show MSS relative mention rate predicts final sufficiency (beta_z=0.528, p=6.71e-45) while generic awareness does not (beta_z=0.005, p=0.853).
Appendix D, Table 11: per-dataset statistics given (e.g., Logic-Q-MT 600 problems/1200 tasks; GeneReg-MT 800 problems/2326 tasks; ClinGuide-MT 370 problems/1595 tasks).
Appendix E.2: open-weight models served with vLLM on H100 GPUs with documented tensor-parallelism, 131,072-token context, and FP8 KV cache settings.
Appendix A (Ethics statement): 'We have released code, data, and prompts to support reproducibility, auditing, and further stress-testing.'
Section 5 (Limitations): authors note equal-cost query assumption, LLM-based oracles for ClinGuide-MT/20Q, and that ClinGuide-MT 'does not establish clinical readiness.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: an LLM-centric evaluation paper on multi-turn information seeking, intersecting LLMs, agents/tool-use-style interaction, reasoning (Logic-Q-MT, CoT trace analysis), and benchmark/evaluation methodology; the clinical and gene-regulation domains are evaluation substrates for LLM behavior rather than out-of-scope medical-AI or biology-foundation-model work. Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends QuestBench's k=1 CSP formulation to multi-turn k>1 with ground-truth MSSs and a 'final sufficiency' metric that separates acquisition from answering (Table 2 positions it as uniquely combining objective query labels, timing/order, and target control). Rigor is a standout: formal CSP definitions, adversarial/random/cooperative oracle robustness reruns (Appendix C.5), LLM-oracle reliability audits with human validation (Appendix C.6), prompt-sensitivity and MSS-resampling studies with cluster bootstrap and Holm correction (Appendix G.1.4, G.1.6), a force-ask intervention (Appendix G.1.5), and non-inferiority testing for first-turn-miss recovery. Evidence is quantitative and largely supports the takeaways (e.g., k-prediction accuracy <0.5 for k>=2 with >4x under-prediction at k=2; regression-adjusted CoT mention-rate effects), though some analyses rest on ~14-17 models and correlational comparisons, and a few models were run on reduced conditions. Generalizability is capped by the controlled setting: equal query costs, predefined queryable variables in structured domains, oracle-based rather than realistic user models - limitations the authors acknowledge in Section 5. Reproducibility is good: full prompts (Appendix E.1), vLLM serving details (Appendix E.2), dataset statistics (Table 11), and a stated release of code, data, and prompts (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking

recommendations.summary: When a user question is underspecified, a capable model should recognize that its context is insufficient, identify the missing information, ask for it, and respond only once that information determines a unique answer. We formalize multi-turn information seeking as solving a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, where k is the number of variables jointly required to determine the target and therefore measures the degree of missing information. We instantiate the formulation in MT-In
recommendations.summary_zh: 哈佛大學團隊系統性評估大型語言模型（LLM）的多輪資訊尋求能力：當使用者問題欠明確（underspecified）時，理想模型應察覺脈絡不足並主動詢問缺少的資訊，直到該資訊足以唯一決定答案才回答。作者將此過程形式化為 k-欠明確約束滿足問題（k-underspecified CSP），k 為共同決定目標所需的最少變數數，並建構 MT-InfoSeek 評測套件，涵蓋數學、邏輯、生物、醫療與常識，共 5,251 個問題、9,006 個任務實例。評測分三軸：預測欠明確程度 k、辨識最小充分集合（MSS）、多輪循序互動解題，並以「最終充分性」（final sufficiency）區分資訊尋求與答案生成兩種能力。主要結果：模型能察覺資訊不足卻普遍低估其程度，在 k=2 邏輯題上低估約為高估的四倍；即使給定真實 k，仍難選出最小充分集合；互動常在資訊未充分時提前作答。隨 k 增大，成功更仰賴跨回合持續追問，首次提問失誤多可挽回；在講究順序依賴的臨床診斷任務（ClinGuide-MT）中，即使取得全部必要資訊，錯誤的提問順序仍會降低準確率；20Q 實驗顯示提問資訊量高不等於成功，證據整合能力同樣關鍵。限制：各提問皆視為等成本，ClinGuide-MT 與 20Q 由 LLM 擔任 oracle（經一致性與人工驗證），nEIG 指標依賴代理候選池，結果不代表臨床就緒。本研究指出最終準確率無法衡量互動素養，評測應記錄模型是否察覺資訊不足、需要哪些變數、以及是否確實透過多輪互動取得，MT-InfoSeek 提供了可控且具真值標註的評估框架。
recommendations.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking
recommendations.title_zh: LLM 知道該問什麼、何時提問嗎？——多輪資訊尋求能力評估

links.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

evidence: Method: Eq. 5 defines entropy-augmented sensitivity switching.
Experiments: Table 1 reports LEMUR reduces forget-split classification accuracy, fill-in-blank accuracy, generation target recall, and subject-level reasoning leakage below baselines.
Experiments: Table 2 provides cumulative component ablation on Onevision-R1-7B.
Experiments: Transferability section reports transfer to Qwen2.5-VL in Table 3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to multimodal LLMs, reasoning/chain-of-thought, and AI safety via machine unlearning. primary_link.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

recommendations.summary: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出LEMUR，一個專為原生強化學習（RL）訓練的多模態大型推理模型（MLRM）設計的免訓練推理階段機器遺忘框架。作者發現，即使最終答案已成功遺忘敏感事實，此類模型仍可能在思考鏈（CoT）中重現該資訊，造成推論軌跡洩漏。此洩漏源於RL訓練誘發的獨特雙階段熵特徵：敏感屬性的回憶始於高熵決策點，隨後熵急劇下降至近乎零，直到該跨度結束才恢復。LEMUR利用此熵動態作為控制訊號，結合詞彙遺忘相關性偵測，在推理時動態切換至潛在解碼狀態，透過熵調節的視覺錨點注入與安全答案錨點，將生成軌跡重導至非敏感內容，並以自適應熵門檻決定介入區間長度。實驗顯示，相較於訓練式（如GA、NPO、MMUnlearner）與免訓練基線（如R-MUSE），LEMUR顯著降低推理軌跡與答案層級的洩漏，同時維持非敏感資料上的效用、流暢度與推理保留能力，並在R1-Onevision、Vision-R1、OpenVLThinker等多個MLRM上驗證其泛化性。僅在RL模型上觀察到顯著熵訊號，在非RL模型上效果有限；此外，此方法需要預先定義遺忘主題的禁用詞彙集合。此研究揭示RL訓練導致的新隱私漏洞，並提供首個針對推理模型的推理時遺忘方案，為多模態AI隱私保護開創新途徑。
recommendations.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
recommendations.title_zh: LEMUR：基於潛在熵感知的多模態遺忘與視覺錨定推理重導

links.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding

evidence: Abstract: proposes InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework with region-level zoom-in trajectories and SFT+RL; claims 4.3-16.4 accuracy improvement and 41%-68% latency reduction.
Section 5.2 Table 2: InSight-doc-8B (SFT+RL) at r=0.25 achieves 66.9% average accuracy vs Qwen3-VL-8B 50.5%, a 16.4-point gain.
Section 5.3: reports 54% latency reduction at 70 DPI and 69% token reduction on longest-document examples.
Section 5.4 Table 4: not-answerable F1 on DUDE/MMLongBench-Doc is 69.1/74.4 vs Qwen3-VL-8B 44.5/48.5.
Section 6 Limitations: only evaluated SFT+RL on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and did not experiment with advanced RL or reward design.
Abstract availability claim: code, datasets, and model released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to agentic tool use, multimodal LLM reasoning, and chain-of-thought. Strong empirical evaluation with SFT vs SFT+RL ablations, trajectory-quality metrics, and efficiency analyses; however, novelty is incremental over existing coarse-to-fine visual search, and some cross-paper comparisons are not fully controlled.

primary_link.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding

recommendations.summary: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus of 17.9K high-quality SFT examples with region-level zoom-in trajectories, accompanied by 19.2K hard RL examples. Through SFT+RL, InSight-doc-8B improves the baseline by 4.3--16.4 accuracy points over document VQA benchmarks. On long documents, it reduces hallucination by more than 40% and inference latency by 41%--68% while maintaining an accuracy lead. Our code, datasets, and model are released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc .
recommendations.summary_zh: 長文件理解常需對許多視覺豐富的頁面進行推理，導致推論成本高昂且容易發生「情境腐化」。為了解決此問題，本文提出 InSight-doc，一個端對端、無需檢索器的主動式視覺感知框架。該框架將視覺解析度視為可調整的推理時間資源：模型從低解析度的文件概覽開始，並在推理過程中動態決定是否放大特定區域以取得更精細的證據。訓練資料包含 17.9K 個具區域級放大軌跡的 SFT 範例，以及 19.2K 個困難的 RL 範例。實驗結果顯示，在文件 VQA 基準上，InSight-doc-8B 相較於基線模型提升了 4.3 至 16.4 個百分點的準確率；在長文件上，幻覺減少超過 40%，推論延遲降低 41% 至 68%，同時維持準確率領先。此方法在準確率與效率之間取得更佳平衡，對於實際應用中的長文件處理具有重要意義。然而，目前僅在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上進行實驗，且未探討更先進的 RL 方法或獎勵設計，仍有改進空間。
recommendations.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
recommendations.title_zh: InSight-doc：用於長文件理解的主動式視覺感知

links.title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?

evidence: Abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al.
Section 2.3: Describes SafeVerify checks against the Lean kernel, including a three-axiom whitelist and three-Docker-container isolation to prevent tampering.
Section 3.1: Reports Claude Opus 4.8 resolved 30% of the 492 conjectures, GPT-5.5 26%, and Gemini 3.5 Flash 22%; on OEIS Open Lite Claude Fable 5 scored 44% at a $200 budget.
Section 4.1: Acknowledges misformalization risk and states that most conjectures have likely received little attention, limiting generalizability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: evaluates generic LMs as tool-using autonomous agents on formal mathematical conjectures in Lean, overlapping with LLM, reasoning, agents, and evaluation preferences. Methods are detailed and include secure container-based verification, model baselines, quantitative results, and limitations. Novelty is moderate because it builds substantially on a prior formalized conjecture dataset, and generality is constrained to OEIS integer-sequence conjectures with uncertain mathematical significance. Reproducibility is supported by released code and benchmark links.

primary_link.title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?

recommendations.summary: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究建構 OEIS Open 基準，基於 492 個來自整數數列線上百科（OEIS）的開放數學猜想，這些猜想已由 Tsoukalas 等人以 Lean 證明助理形式化。研究提供開源評測程式碼，讓任何通用語言模型能在防作弊的安全環境中嘗試證明或反證這些猜想。結果顯示，配備最小工具集的語言模型在每次嘗試 50 美元的預算下，能解決 30% 的猜想；提高預算至 200 美元時，最佳模型在 OEIS Open Lite 子集上達到 44% 的解決率。然而，提供 476,000 篇 arXiv 數學文獻或使用更複雜的代理迴圈並未提升表現。此研究首次系統性評估語言模型自主解決開放數學問題的能力，顯示其以合理成本推進研究前沿的潛力，但多數猜想可能缺乏重大數學意義，且存在形式化錯誤與訓練資料外洩的風險。
recommendations.title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
recommendations.title_zh: OEIS Open：語言模型能將多少猜想轉化為定理？

links.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1 reports strong-mismatch Avg@8: TIDE 20.3 vs OPD 6.9 and weak-mismatch TIDE 46.7 vs OPD 45.7.
Section 4.3, Table 4 ablation reports Sampled OPD 6.87, Selection only 14.58, Excess branch 18.57, Deficit branch 18.32, and TIDE 20.34.
Section 4.3, Table 3 reports strong-mismatch generation length OPD 22,395 vs TIDE 7,294 and missing-box rate 65.5% vs 5.4%.
Appendix A provides proofs for Proposition 1 and Proposition 2.
Appendix D.2 and D.4 provide hyperparameters and evaluation details, and the abstract gives a code URL.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM post-training/distillation methodology for mathematical reasoning. Novelty is moderate: the paper identifies a degenerate agreement failure mode and proposes TIDE with Hellinger suppression plus analytic top-K deficit recovery, but builds on existing OPD baselines (FiRe-OPD, PowerOPD, AOPD). Evidence is fairly strong with formal propositions, multi-benchmark results, ablations, sensitivity checks, and case studies, but generalization is limited to two teacher-student pairs and math-only data. Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters and code availability.

primary_link.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement

recommendations.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型在後訓練階段常用的同策略蒸餾（OPD）的失敗模式：學生模型可能利用重複迴圈，使與教師模型的 token 層級一致度極高，但整體輸出卻完全退化，稱為「退化性一致」。作者將教師與學生的不匹配分為兩類：學生過量 token（學生生成但教師認為幾乎不可能的 token）與學生不足 token（教師偏好但學生鮮少抽樣到的 token）。為了解決這兩個方向，提出 TIDE 方法，針對過量 token 使用有界的 Hellinger 塑形來穩定更新，針對不足 token 則透過分析教師 top-K 分佈來恢復缺失的機率質量。在數學推理基準測試中，TIDE 在強不匹配設定下顯著優於現有方法，提升 Avg@8 從 6.9% 至 20.3%，並減少回應長度。此研究強調在蒸餾時應關注不匹配方向與可及性，而非僅追求一致。
recommendations.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
recommendations.title_zh: 不匹配才是關鍵：超越 Token 一致性的同策略蒸餾

links.title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit

evidence: Abstract: 'Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells ... churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta', with cells spanning 1.3B-405B parameters.
Section 3.2 / Table 1: TOST certification tables computed from observed discordance rates, with paired-design advantage ranging 2.3x (GSM8K) to 14.7x (MuSR), 4.2x pooled over 1,707 cells.
Section 5.2 / Table 3: 'No audited source declares a prospective numerical equivalence margin'; 0 of 16 eligible sources release task-matched per-item outputs (Section 5.4).
Section 6.2 / Table 5: preregistered H3 rule returns 'supported' with winner reversals across calibration seeds in 5 of 8 cells and range/gap criterion in 7 of 8.
Section 7 / Table 20: exploratory harness-sensitivity study shows scoring-filter choice moves fixed-model GSM8K accuracy 0.232 to 0.566 (Appendix H.1), R up to 1.585 relative to quantization.
Section 8: artifacts released at 10.5281/zenodo.21939143, including 88 per-item JSONL files, flipeval package (Apache-2.0), and reproduction package.
Section 9 and 9.1: explicit scope limits - atlas is 'a record, not a sample'; binary per-item outcome model is a binding condition; graded-metric extension stated but not validated.

Appendix K.3/K.4: claim extraction performed by LLM agent sessions; model IDs, prompts and settings not recorded; no human-validation subset extracted; author states design is 'auditable but not re-executable'.
Section 3.7 / Appendix B: preregistration compliance with dated amendments; the analyst decision that moved the headline (K=1 to 5 to 4, settled at 1 of 11) is disclosed with its timeline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A preregistered evaluation-methodology paper on statistical certification of compressed LLMs (GPTQ vs AWQ on Qwen2.5/Llama, MMLU/GSM8K), squarely within LLM scope via the LLM (2.5), Scaling & Efficiency (quantization/compression), and evaluation preferences. Methodological rigor is exceptional: frozen protocols with dated amendments, disclosed analyst rulings, independent reimplemented spot-checks, and sensitivity sweeps. Evidence combines a 1,707-cell observational atlas with a controlled 8-cell seed-paired experiment showing ranking reversals. Novelty is good but transfer-based: the churn/cancellation insight is credited to Dutta et al. 2024 and TOST is standard statistics; the shift from detection to certification plus required-n tables is the incremental contribution. Empirical claims are deliberately scope-bounded (binary metrics only, 4-bit, one vendor stratum, 1.5B-8B controlled grid), limiting generalizability; the audit's LLM-agent extraction lacked human validation. Artifact release (Zenodo DOI, 88 per-item JSONL files, flipeval code, hashes) is exemplary.

links.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'Across fourteen models, including ten open-weight models and four frontier API models... (1) anchoring is strongly pathway-dependent, (2) plausible anchors usually induce larger shifts than irrelevant ones... (4) high task accuracy... does not guarantee robustness'
§3.2: 'an irrelevant and a plausible condition in the same direction use an identical numeric anchor value a; only the surrounding sentence differs' — defines the relevance axis

§3.3: 'Each suite contains 360 items (6 domains × 60 items) in five conditions, giving 1,800 prompts per model per suite'; 'External and RAG have no format confounds and provide the strongest cross-model evidence'
§3.4: definitions of MAE_c, Acc_10, UAI (Eq. 3), TAR (Eq. 4), and Disc_Δ (Eq. 5) with exclusion rule ε=3 and stability across ε∈{1,3,5} (Appendix A.6)
§4.2: 'Across the 69 model–suite cells with computable Disc_Δ, 55 (80%) show positive discrimination... Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm the pattern on External, RAG, and Tool (p_BH<0.01)'

§4.4: 'Task accuracy and anchoring discrimination are only weakly correlated (r=-0.24, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.43, -0.00])'; 'all four achieve ≥96% accuracy on External yet show positive Disc_Δ (0.05–0.16)'

§4.5 / Table 2: partial-evidence stress test where 'Three of the four models exceed the ceiling at some k', with Gemma-4B as a counterexample showing the design does not mechanically force positive UAI

Appendix A.10: 'matched-format analysis reduces Disc_Δ by up to 70% for some models' for History; Appendix A.12: 'Cross-model Tool-suite comparisons... mix formats... and should be interpreted accordingly'

Appendix A.17.7 footnote 2: batched GPU inference 'is not bitwise reproducible even at temperature 0'; baseline UAI_pls spans 0.32–0.39 across three runs for one cell — transparent reporting of run-to-run variance
Limitations: 'synthetic deterministic-aggregation tasks make comparison clean but do not cover the complexity of real judgment, and some pathways require cautious interpretation'

Reproducibility statement: 'Code and the benchmark data are at https://github.com/Ydrg9989/AnchorBench' and HF Hub release covering '14,400 prompts, each carrying its gold answer', with checksummed raw generations (~520 MB)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark for the anchoring effect in LLMs, squarely within core LLM evaluation/robustness scope: it spans LLMs (§3.5, 14-model panel), AI-safety/robustness framing (abstract: 'even frontier API models above 95% control accuracy remain susceptible'), RAG and Tool-use pathways (§3.3), ICL (§3.3), and CoT prompting mitigations (Appendix A.16/A.17.7), making it highly preference-relevant. Novelty is moderate rather than high: LLM anchoring is already documented (Related Work cites Nguyen 2024, Lou & Sun 2025, SynAnchors), and the contribution is breadth — five pathways in one setup plus an irrelevant-vs-plausible relevance axis with matched anchor values (§3.2) — plus a rational-updating ceiling UAI=0.167 as a practical-significance threshold (§4.4, A.17.1). Rigor and evidence are strong: standardized inference with greedy decoding and 99.9% median parse rate (§3.5), Wilcoxon tests with BH correction and bootstrap CIs (Table 10), exclusion-threshold sensitivity (A.6), boundary-clipping sensitivity (A.8), sampling robustness (A.15), and unusually honest confound handling — History single-stage control (A.10, up to 70% DiscΔ reduction) and Tool structured-vs-plaintext format mixing (A.12). They even report batched-GPU run-to-run variation (A.17.7 footnote 2). Claims are consistently matched to data. Generalizability is limited by the synthetic deterministic-aggregation task (Limitations: 'synthetic deterministic-aggregation tasks... do not cover the complexity of real judgment'), partially mitigated by domain and large-model extensions (A.17.5, A.17.11) and a partial-evidence stress test with rational ceilings (§4.5). Reproducibility is excellent: code and 14,400 released prompts with gold answers on GitHub/HF Hub plus checksummed raw generations (Reproducibility statement). No unsupported headline claims detected; the main deductions are incremental novelty and limited external validity.

primary_link.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs

recommendations.summary: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias in which an initial reference value shifts a later judgment toward itself. This effect is well established in human judgment and decision-making, and recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behavior. However, existing work on anchoring in LLMs typically evaluates only a narrow set of anchor pathways and rarely distinguishes irrelevant from plausible anchors. We introduce AnchorBench, a benchmark for the anchoring effect in L
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究針對大型語言模型（LLM）的錨定效應——即初始參考值使後續判斷向其偏移的認知偏誤——提出AnchorBench基準。現有研究多半只檢驗少數錨定路徑，也鮮少區分無關錨點與貌似合理的錨點。本基準涵蓋五種錨點傳遞途徑：External（提示詞）、History（對話）、ICL（範例）、RAG（檢索文件）與Tool（工具輸出），並引入錨點相關性軸，將情境分為對照、無關與合理三類。每個題目皆為0–100的數值聚合任務，標準答案僅由證據決定，因而可衡量偏移是否合理，指標包含Acc₁₀、UAI、TAR與鑑別度差距DiscΔ。團隊評估十四個模型（十個開放權重、四個前沿API模型），主要發現：錨定強烈依賴途徑，External與RAG效應最廣，ICL（中繼資料）近零；合理錨點引起的偏移通常大於無關錨點；錨點離證據支持的答案越遠，影響力大致遞減；高準確率不代表穩健，控制條件準確率逾95%的前沿模型仍受合理錨點影響。作者另以部分證據的壓力測試與誤差分解佐證效應真實存在。限制包括任務為合成題、History與Tool途徑受格式混淆影響、小型效應對排除規則敏感，且提示詞緩解只能減弱而無法根除。此研究提醒：平均準確率不足以保證LLM判斷可靠，穩健性評估必須檢視數值情境實際抵達模型的各種途徑，對醫療等高風險決策支援場景尤為重要。
recommendations.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs
recommendations.title_zh: AnchorBench：針對大型語言模型錨定效應的多途徑基準測試

We restructure that search by decoupling the three roles an LLM plays, running the high-volume answering role on the cheapest tier, reserving a strong model for the rare reflection/variation operator, then exploiting upward cross-tier transfer to deploy the cheap
recommendations.summary_zh: 演化式提示詞最佳化因適應度評估成本高昂而受限；本文提出將評估、變異與部署三種角色解耦，評估使用最廉價模型，變異由強力模型執行，並將提示詞零樣本部署至更強目標。此方法顯著降低搜尋成本，且品質不遜於同層級完整最佳化，在四項任務、十一種模型中獲得驗證。本文亦探討跨層級遷移成功之條件，指出廉價評估器促使結構化明確提示生成，有助於強力模型理解。此方法適用於具分層價格之模型服務，惟低競爭力或低空間之任務可能受限。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a security/safety study of LLM agents at the serving-layer boundary, hitting agents & tool use (2.5), AI safety/red-teaming, LLM inference & KV-cache serving. Novel cross-layer 'rollback consistency' property with a clean same-token/different-cache causal audit that isolates retained KV from text effects; carefully positioned against prior KV-editing/deletion work rather than overclaiming. Rigor is high: token-matched paired estimand, per-cell carrier-absent and token-identity verification (63/63), length/position-matched control (25/25->0/25), framework-default and LangGraph time-travel reproductions (25/45), MoE model, and honest scoping (vLLM/SGLang content-addressed caches exempt, provider caches unknown). Evidence is deterministic and sealed but from a synthetic harness, modest model scale (3.8B-36B), and effect-level flips are model-dependent (9/9 to 0/9), though the Layer-1 state violation is argued model-independent. Reproducibility is strong (greedy decoding, named adapters, exact prompts, versions, SHA-256-sealed records), tempered by an anonymized artifact with no explicit public link. Weighted score reflects a well-executed, relevant agent-security contribution with a slightly narrow real-world exposure surface.

primary_link.title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents

recommendations.summary: Stateful language agents assume a rejected branch can be taken back by clearing it from the application transcript. We show this breaks when the serving session retains key/value (KV) state across the logical abort: the model can continue attending to content the application believes it discarded. We formalize the missing guarantee as rollback consistency: a complete abort must restore the state the model attends, not just the transcript. The key failure is cross-layer: a correct logical rollbac
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文揭露語言代理系統中一個跨層的安全缺口：當應用程式認為某分支已中止並自對話記錄移除後，若推論伺服層為延遲考量仍保留該分支的 KV 快取，模型實際注意力所及的狀態並未真正回滾。作者將此形式化為「回滾一致性」，並設計「同 token、不同快取」的配對稽核：保持決策步輸入 token 完全相同，僅改變快取前綴是殘留的廢棄分支，或由已提交記錄重建。在七個開源權重模型家族（3.8B–36B）上，僅存於保留 KV 的被拒分支在 63 個攻擊格中的 25 格翻轉受保護效果，將敏感產物外洩至攻擊者端點，且攻擊者 token 可證明不存在於所服務的請求中；以已提交內容重建快取則全部關閉（0/63）。此漏洞可在端到端會話應用、HuggingFace transformers 預設快取重用路徑，乃至 LangGraph time-travel 等第一級回滾 API 下重現，顯示邏輯回滾與推論狀態之間存在組合缺口，且對開發者完全不可見。修復方面，交易本地的快取還原（重建、截斷或檢查點還原）即可廉價關閉通道，而全域清空成本高昂，提示層防護與框架原生中止皆無效。此研究提醒：回滾必須還原模型實際關注的狀態，而不只是文字記錄。
recommendations.title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
recommendations.title_zh: 中止但未被遺忘：KV 快取保留破壞語言代理的回滾一致性

links.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution

evidence: Abstract: reports a Rust C compiler with 248,989 tracked lines, 120 hours, US$44, passing c-testsuite and most LLVM/Csmith tests.
Section 4.4: reports reimplementation of 13 MESA modules in Rust, 89,946 Rust lines, and median speedups 1.55–6.87x.

Supplementary Table S3: reports 4,198,686,642 total tokens and US$44.3760 logged cost for compiler formation.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM coding agents, multi-agent orchestration, and software engineering. Score reflects strong topical fit and moderate novelty, rigor, and evidence strength.

primary_link.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution

recommendations.summary: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出EvoX Genesis，一種以「持久性軟體專案」而非「持久性代理者」為核心的軟體開發組織架構。其基本模型為「持久遞迴世界」：每個區域世界由已接受的版本與儲存庫路徑定義，有限生命週期的代理者僅在此世界中提出區域性變更，並透過遞迴委派調整工作位置，最後由父代理者依據測試與整合證據決定是否接受。作者在三個階段進行評估：由空儲存庫建構C編譯器（形成）、在模型替換後繼續開發（延續）、以及將MESA科學程式碼從Fortran移植至Rust（再開發）。結果顯示，編譯器以約2.5萬列程式碼、近1.87萬美元之低成本完成；續行分支各自通過其測試集；MESA移植保持數值一致並獲得約1.55至6.87倍之加速。作者強調此研究屬能力展示，尚無法證明遞迴機制或特定持久記錄之因果必要性。此架構將代理者生命週期與軟體開發歷程分離，為長時程自主軟體演化開闢新途徑。摘要僅涵蓋此論文，未包含其他來源之內容。
recommendations.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
recommendations.title_zh: 持久遞迴世界實現自主軟體演化

links.title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension

evidence: Abstract reports that combining three or more architectural choices can drop downstream performance by up to 47% and describes the released OlmPool set of 26 comparable 7B models.
Section 4 reports that the feature count of four architectural choices is the most predictive single feature for downstream long-context performance with in-sample R2=0.67 and LOO R2=0.61.
Appendix A Table 1 reports HELMET 32K scores ranging from 29.9 to 56.4 across OlmPool models, supporting the claimed wide downstream variation.
Section 5.3 compares YaRN 2-stage and NTK 1-stage extension strategies on three models and reports that architecture ranking is preserved across methods.

Novelty is moderate because prior work identified QK-norm effects, but the controlled compound-ablation design and OlmPool release are substantial. Rigor is good but limited by one seed per configuration and incomplete initialization/hyperparameter standardization. Quantitative evidence is strong across tables and ablations, though without statistical error bars. Generalizability is constrained to dense 7-8B English LLMs with one data mix. Reproducibility is supported by released checkpoints and configurations but high compute cost limits verification.

primary_link.title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension

recommendations.summary: One might imagine that architectural variations within the dense transformer paradigm have a limited effect on accuracy. However, we demonstrate that this is not the case in the long context setting. Specifically, we show that a set of four minor architectural decisions --- all made by at least one of the Olmo, Llama, and Qwen dense model families --- have a compoundingly negative effect on long context extensibility. Any one of these choices alone has a minor impact on long context performance,
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討密集 Transformer 模型中的四個看似微小的架構決策（正規化策略、GQA、滑動視窗注意力和預訓練語境長度）如何對長語境擴展能力產生複合性的負面影響。研究團隊在固定資料、分詞器與擴展方法的前提下，訓練了 26 個 7B 參數模型（OlmPool），並比較 Llama 3、Qwen 3 與 Olmo 3 的架構變體。結果顯示，單一選擇影響不大，但同時採用三個以上會使 HELMET 32K 分數下降最高 47%。短語境損失與驗證基準無法預測此差異，但架構特徵可從預訓練早期階段的擴展表現中偵測。Llama 3 架構在長語境擴展上表現最佳，而 QK 正規化、GQA 與滑動視窗皆會損害長語境表現。即使延長擴展資料至 50B tokens 也無法消除架構差異。研究也分析了注意力分佈與注意力匯集（attention sink）行為，發現無 QK 正規化模型傾向形成注意力匯集，且此現象與較佳長語境表現相關。此工作的限制在於僅涵蓋 7B 規模及有限架構變異，但提供了 38 個檢查點供後續研究使用，有助於在預訓練早期評估架構對長語境能力的影響。
recommendations.title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension

primary_link.title: Interpreting Language Model Hidden States at Scale

recommendations.summary: Lens methods interpret large language models (LLMs) by mapping intermediate activations to the output vocabulary, revealing how next-token predictions develop through the network. Trained lenses remain expensive: affine-translator parameters grow quadratically with model width, while exact, full-vocabulary Kullback--Leibler (KL) training dominates memory. Consequently, prior trained lenses have been applied to models of at most 20B parameters and remain tied to particular component types. We pre
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 OmniLens，旨在解決訓練型透鏡（lens）在大型語言模型上的擴展性問題。傳統透鏡需對每個掛鉤點學習全秩仿射轉換，參數量隨模型寬度平方成長，記憶體需求龐大，且僅能應用於特定元件類型。OmniLens 透過低秩轉換器將每個透鏡的參數成長降至線性，並引入 Subset-KL 損失函數，僅物化部分詞彙邏輯值，以減少記憶體使用。作者在 LLaMA-3.3-70B 上成功訓練 482 個透鏡，並在 LLaMA-3.1-405B 上進行概念驗證。研究結果顯示，OmniLens 能以較低成本重現先前的詮釋性研究成果，並揭示行為最顯著的掛鉤點未必是最佳干預位置，提供了更全面的模型詮釋工具。儘管存在低秩限制與 Subset-KL 各自的偏差權衡，此方法仍大幅降低了密集透鏡訓練的門檻，有助於大規模模型的詮釋與安全研究。未來工作可探索更廣泛的元件類型與更高效的無偏正規化方法。

links.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract

evidence: Abstract: positions agent safety as a runtime contract with preventive and evidential faces
Section 4.2: formalizes Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain with hard/soft evidence
Table 2: trajectory schema audit of 12 public agent systems showing only 2 with submission-like evidence gates
Section 5: reports 52-incident survey, 31+1 false-completion audit, and 28,560-paper proceedings audit headline numbers
Appendix A: acknowledges limitations including no goal control and polynomial verification only under independent verifiers
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to AI safety, agent tool use, and alignment critique. It is a position paper with a conceptual runtime-contract framework and public audits, but novelty is moderate because it synthesizes existing guardrail, sandboxing, and CI/evidence practices. Rigor is limited by title-level proceedings audit, counterfactual incident coding, and row-level data being referenced but not included; no experimental baselines or ablations. Evidence supports recurring failures and product gaps but not strong causal proof. Generalizability is solid for verifiable consequential-agent tasks, weaker for open-ended tasks. Reproducibility depends on unavailable supplementary JSON.

primary_link.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract

recommendations.summary: The dominant paradigm treats AI safety as a property to be instilled during model training via RLHF, DPO, or Constitutional AI. We argue this is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code, mutate files, send messages, and modify databases. Agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, and the contract has two complementary faces. The preventive face blocks dangerous actions before they happen via sandboxes, permission gates, output filters, and trajectory monitors. The evidential face requires verifiable proof that good actions actually happened, gating task submission on hard evidence such as test runs, log captures, file diffs, and citation grounding. We ground the position in four lines of public evidence, with row-level protocols and data released in the supplementary JSON files: a survey of 52 documented AI-agent and LLM safety incidents, a false-completion audit with 31 non-contested core cases plus one disputed illustrative case, a trajectory-schema audit of 12 public agent systems and harnesses, and a title-level audit of all 28,560 papers accepted at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR 2023-2025 showing a pooled 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time publication. Two prior communities that needed to enforce safety, computer security and the experimental sciences, converged on runtime contracts with both preventive and evidential elements; agentic AI is now under the same pressure. We formalize an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain, state a compositional gating proposition based on standard monitor composition, and outline a research agenda. The right unit of safety in agentic AI is the trajectory-with-checkable-evidence, not the model.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文主張僅靠訓練階段的方法（如RLHF、DPO、憲法式AI）不足以確保自主代理的安全性，因為代理會執行程式碼、修改檔案、發送訊息與變更資料庫。作者提出「執行期契約」的雙面向架構：預防面在危害發生前透過沙箱、權限閘門、輸出過濾器與軌跡監控阻止危險動作；證據面則要求提供可驗證的證據鏈（如測試重跑、日誌截取、檔案差異、引用稽核），否則不認定任務完成。研究發表四方證據：52件安全事故調查、32件虛假完成稽核、12個系統的軌跡綱要稽核，以及28,560篇論文標題分析，顯示訓練期與執行期研究比例失衡。文中也提出組合式門控命題，說明預防與證據機制可組合驗證。限制包括未處理代理目標本身的惡意，且證據契約僅適用於有明確驗收標準的任務。此觀點將安全性從模型本身轉移到可稽核的執行基礎設施，對部署具影響力的自主代理尤為重要。
recommendations.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
recommendations.title_zh: 代理安全性應是執行期契約

links.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression

Section 6.3, Table 3: w/o Retrieve 43.00 (-8.11), w/o Selection+Retrieval (Glyph-9B) 48.78 (-2.33), iso-training control Glyph-9B-SFT-direct 45.20 (-5.91); authors note the non-monotonic trend implies selection acts mainly as routing for retrieval

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM long-context methodology combining visual-text compression, tool-integrated reasoning, and selective text retrieval, densely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning/CoT, long context, RAG-style retrieval, efficiency). Novelty is moderate: it directly extends Glyph-9B with a query-conditional select-retrieve mechanism and ReAct-style SFT, an intuitive but not groundbreaking combination of established parts (uniform compression in Glyph/Vist/DeepSeek-OCR vs. query-adaptive here). Rigor is a strength: ablations (Table 3), an iso-training control isolating mechanism from fine-tuning data (Table 15), intrinsic page-selection evaluation against random/first-page/BM25/oracle (Table 17), an end-to-end BM25-selector swap (Table 18), an RLM comparison (Table 19), and unusually honest wall-clock analysis (Table 13) that retracts any latency win. Evidence is solid but tempered by model-generated gold labels (Qwen3.5-9B answer-conditioned annotation, not human), single-benchmark evaluation (LongBench only), acknowledged non-iso-training cross-family comparisons, and a suspicious 'Qwen3.5-9B' teacher name. Generalizability is limited: QA-over-rendered-documents only, authors explicitly exclude natural images/charts/OCR, fixed retrieval budget fails on distributed evidence, and on seven of 21 tasks the prompt exceeds full text. Reproducibility is good: code link, full hyperparameters (Table 9), data-pipeline retention tables, and trajectory formats, though it depends on teacher models for annotation.

primary_link.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression

recommendations.summary: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that
recommendations.summary_zh: 長上下文推理因注意力的平方複雜度而成本高昂；將文字渲染為圖像、交由視覺語言模型處理的視覺-文字壓縮可大幅節省 token，但現有方法對整個上下文施加均勻壓縮，忽略查詢相關性，因而犧牲精確擷取所需的細節。本文提出 Seer，以選擇—擷取—推理三階段解決此問題：先瀏覽渲染圖像選出與查詢相關的頁面，再從渲染過程保留的來源文字中擷取對應內容，最後結合視覺與文字進行推理；整體以工具呼叫融入 ReAct 式互動軌跡，並以監督式微調訓練，初始化自 Glyph-9B，訓練資料由 Qwen3.5-9B 標註相關頁面、Qwen3-32B 產生推理鏈並經嚴格過濾。在 LongBench 上平均達 51.11%，較 Glyph-9B 高 2.33 分、較 Qwen3-8B 高 3.49 分，增益集中於擷取密集任務（Qasper +8.75、MultiFieldQA-Zh +19.17）；模型平均每個查詢僅選 1.59 頁，選擇相當稀疏。消融與同等訓練對照證明增益來自選擇—擷取機制，而非微調資料本身。作者亦誠實指出限制：選擇可能輸出越界索引、效率優勢限於 prompt 與 KV 快取佔用而非延遲，且當證據分散於多頁時表現受限。此框架示範視覺壓縮效率與文字精確性可以互補，並指出自適應擷取預算與迭代選擇是下一步方向。

primary_link.title: Group Alignment-Induced Sycophancy: A Two-Sided Evaluation of Steerable Pluralistic Alignment

recommendations.summary: Group alignment adapts a language model to a demographic group to produce responses that reflect the group's opinions, values, and preferences. Sycophancy, a well-documented by-product of alignment, causes the model to over-agree with the user regardless of factual and objective information. However, existing group alignment methods and evaluations focus only on how closely the model matches the group's opinions, overlooking the induced change in sycophantic behaviour. To bridge this gap, we int
recommendations.summary_zh: 群體對齊（group alignment）旨在讓語言模型貼合特定人口群體的意見，但現有評估僅衡量意見匹配度，忽略對齊可能誘發的諂媚行為（sycophancy）變化。本文提出GAS（Group Alignment-induced Sycophancy）評估框架，系統性地檢視三種對齊方法（Prompt、SFT、DPO）、四個基礎模型與十三個人口群體，同時測量意見匹配增益與七大諂媚指標的偏移。結果顯示，在相同預算下，不同群體獲得的意見匹配增益不均，且諂媚偏移呈現群體特異的多維輪廓，各維度方向不一，以單一數值平均會相互抵消。此外，DPO在意見匹配增益上優於SFT，且有害偏移較小。研究強調，群體對齊應以雙面、多維度的方式評估，而非僅報告單一契合度分數。限制包括僅涵蓋美國資料、群體分類粗糙、且未探討機制。

recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在多語言環境中的安全行為常因訓練資料以高資源語言為主，導致低資源語言的安全防護較弱。現有機制可解釋性研究多聚焦於單一神經元，忽略跨層動態傳遞的協同作用。本論文提出辨識跨層「安全路徑」的方法，結合共激活與激活傳播分析，找出高資源與低資源語言共享的安全路徑，作為跨語言安全能力轉移的橋樑。作者進一步提出路徑導向的對齊方法，僅微調少於 1% 的參數，即可顯著提升低資源語言對有害請求的拒絕率，同時保留一般能力。實驗顯示在多個 LLM 與安全基準上均達最佳表現，且透過留一語言驗證，確認共享路徑可泛化至未見語言。此研究將安全機制從靜態神經元提升至動態路徑層級，為跨語言安全對齊提供更具可解釋性與效率的途徑。

primary_link.title: Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs

recommendations.summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve remarkable success on complex tasks but remain vulnerable to harmful prompts that induce unsafe outputs. Recent methods align LRMs using direct refusals or safety rationales, yet often focus on prompt patterns rather than intrinsic attack mechanisms. As a result, these pattern-centric alignments struggle to generalize across diverse jailbreaks, compromising adversarial robustness and reasoning utility. We propose AdvSafe, a dual-adversarial framework that en
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在複雜任務上表現卓越，但易受惡意提示攻擊而產生不安全輸出。現有安全對齊方法多專注於可觀測的提示模式，導致對多樣化越獄的泛化能力不足，且可能損害推理效用。為解決此問題，作者提出雙重對抗框架 AdvSafe，透過兩階段對抗遊戲：首先由自主代理動態建構欺騙性越獄提示以突破教師模型；其次，被突破的教師模型執行認知反擊，明確拆解攻擊成功的原因及識別與緩解方法，產生富含可泛化不安全知識的推理資料集。學生模型僅需訓練於 1K 筆合成樣本，即可在四個安全基準上大幅降低攻擊成功率，同時幾乎不損失推理效用。實驗亦顯示其對未見越獄攻擊具良好泛化性，展現優越的魯棒性與效用權衡。此方法強調教導模型理解請求為何有害，而非僅學習拒絕，為 LRM 安全對齊提供了新典範。

links.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers

evidence: Abstract: RCV improves adherence in every classifier–dataset combination, catching up to 0.81 of previously missed unsafe content without modifying the underlying classifier.
Table 1: adherence rises in all six cells (largest Beaver on PKU-SafeRLHF 0.787→0.920); caught share spans 0.29–0.81 across cells with ten-seed stds.
Ablations / Fig. 4: per-regime routing exceeds pooled AUROC in every cell of a three-probe-family ablation by 0.2–4.6 pp; routed linear probe beats pooled GBT (0.961 vs 0.913 on Beaver).
Appendix B.1 / Table T1: re-scoring against unused human labels moves corrected adherence toward the oracle–human agreement level (0.9195 / 0.9298) in 48 of 50 seeds (paired p ≤ 0.042).
Detection section: monitor alarms in 100/100 runs before the 0.30 attack-rate cap, median attack rate 0.115; null false-alarm rate 14/90 (Clopper–Pearson CI [0.088, 0.247]).
Gate outcomes / Fig. 6 and Tables T5–T6: 79/100 episodes repair in place under the deployed budget (median 600 labels), 87/100 under the data bound; 13 never pass the gate at any audit size.

Appendix B.5 / Tables T3–T4: fine-tune+probe passes the powered acceptance gate in 5/5 trainer seeds (recall s.d. 0.004 vs raw fine-tune 0.019), but the authors concede base+probe also passes on the powered set, so the fine-tune's necessity is not established.

Limitations: detection limited to one classifier over ten held-out families; end-to-end loop on one deployment; both datasets English single-turn; drift simulated via category hold-out injection, not naturally occurring; white-box access required and score-only probe recovers adherence but far less caught share.

Appendix D: extraction recipes reproduce representations at cosine 0.99995–0.99997; seeds, splits, design constants (Table T9), per-stage compute (Table T10), and SHA-256 provenance digests; code, judge prompt, label map, and dataset rebuild scripts are claimed to be released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely in LLM safety: probes the internal representations of frozen LLM-based safety classifiers (Llama-Guard-3, WildGuard, Beaver) to estimate verdict correctness under a deployer policy, flips wrong verdicts, and reuses the same estimates for label-free drift monitoring and a maintenance loop. Preference match is strong (LLMs, AI safety, evaluation, probing/interpretability), and it is not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: correctness probes and per-verdict calibration have precedents (ConfidNet, top-label calibration, judge-correctness probes); the contributions are the verdict-regime conditioning (backed by a simple but correct Proposition 1), using the estimate to correct rather than abstain, and the combined correction+monitor+maintenance loop. Rigor is high: 10-seed protocol, routing vs pooled ablation across three probe families (routing wins all 60 paired comparisons, AUROC +0.2–4.6 pp), probe-input ablations (internal state beats confidence score in 119/120 paired comparisons and beats TF-IDF in all 12 cells), human-label re-scoring bounding oracle bias (48/50 seeds move toward the oracle–human agreement level), matched false-alarm baseline comparison (score-KS, ATC), and Clopper–Pearson intervals. Evidence is strong but confined to simulated drift: detection 100/100 runs at median attack rate 0.115 with 14/90 null alarms; 79/100 episodes repair in place at deployed budget (87/100 at data bound). Caveats: the oracle is a single LLM judge (κ=0.838/0.766) on which the probes are trained while the raw classifier is not — an acknowledged asymmetry only partially bounded; a base+probe comparator also passes the powered gate in the fine-tune experiment (Table T4), weakening the necessity claim for escalation. Generalizability is limited: English single-turn moderation, white-box access required, detection on one classifier, end-to-end loop on one deployment. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, label map, rebuild scripts, extraction recipes verified to cosine ≥0.99995, pinned seeds/splits/design constants and provenance digests.

primary_link.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers

recommendations.summary: Safety classifiers deployed with large language models often fail for two reasons: their decisions reflect the policy learned during training rather than the deployer's desired policy, and their performance degrades as deployment traffic evolves. We present Regime-Conditional Verification (RCV), a lightweight wrapper that adapts an off-the-shelf safety classifier without retraining it. RCV estimates, from the classifier's internal representations, the probability that each prediction disagrees w
recommendations.summary_zh: 部署於大型語言模型應用的安全分類器有兩大失效：其判決反映訓練時習得的隱含政策，未必符合部署者所需；且隨流量分布漂移，判決品質逐漸衰退。本文提出 Regime-Conditional Verification（RCV），一個輕量外掛層，在不重訓分類器的前提下讀取其內部表徵，估計每筆判決與部署者政策不一致的機率，並翻轉估計錯誤的判決。核心發現是估計須依分類器判決分區：safe 判決只可能漏放違規，unsafe 判決只可能過度封鎖，兩種錯誤結構不同，故每個區間各有獨立探針與校準映射。同一組正確性估計亦提供免標籤的漂移訊號，驅動維護迴圈：警報觸發稽核與探針更新，僅在修復無效時才升級至 fine-tuning。實驗涵蓋三個現成分類器與兩個英文資料集，六種組合的政策符合率全數提升，先前漏放的不安全內容可攔截 0.29 至 0.81，以人工標籤重評亦支持修正方向。十個排除於訓練外的攻擊家族注入實驗中，監控器於一百次執行全數在攻擊率上限前示警；一百個漂移事件裡七十九個僅靠探針更新即原地修復，放寬資料上限後達 87，fine-tuning 僅留給少數無法修復的事件。限制包括：偵測與維護實驗僅限單一分類器與單一部署、漂移為模擬而非自然發生、一致率相對單一 LLM 評審衡量，且探針需白箱權重存取。研究顯示部署後的政策調適與維護不必是權重更新問題。

links.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search

evidence: Section I, contributions list: scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis where the LLM chooses components, interactions, and control flow, with only a minimal I/O interface fixed.
Section IV-A3c: all LLM methods use GPT-5-mini (reasoning effort low, T=1.0) with matched token budgets of 5M (FSS), 6.5M (CVRP), 7M (CVRPTW), 6M (QAP) per synthesis run.

Section IV-A3e: authors state wall-clock caps favor compiled C++ baselines (PyVRP, OR-Tools) over Python-synthesized algorithms, an honest protocol limitation.
Section IV-C and Table V: layer ablation — all layers best (CVRP 0.094%, FSS 0.347%) vs. Layer-1-only (3.620%, 0.814%) and Layer-3-only (2.095%, 0.672%).
Appendix C-C, Table C.5: semantic guidance (0.570% CVRP gap) outperforms fitness-based (2.601%) and random (3.143%) selection/grouping under matched cluster counts.

Section IV-B3a and Section III-A1: multimodality/hybridization evidence is code inspection of four released illustrative algorithms; authors note it does not quantify frequency or validate archive-wide cluster semantics.
Section IV-A5b and abstract: source code and exact executable prompts released at github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS; estimated cost $4.2-$5.8 and 10-15 hours per run reported.
Appendix C-E, Table C.6: reasoning-effort analysis — Low best quality-cost trade-off; Medium/High raise tokens ~28-84% for marginal gap changes.
Appendix C-F, Table C.7: framework remains effective across GPT-5-nano/mini/5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 (FSS gaps 0.284%-0.557%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM-methodology paper (LLM-driven full-program synthesis with prompt-based operators), not an excluded pure-domain application. Core relevance to high-weight preferences: large language models as the search engine, program/code synthesis, agentic iterative operators, prompt engineering with structured outputs, and reasoning-effort analysis. Novelty is a competent but largely combinational contribution: scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis plus embedding-guided quality-diversity archiving and a three-layer schedule, positioned against FunSearch/EoH/ReEvo/LLaMEA/AlphaEvolve/A2DEPT without a fundamentally new mechanism. Rigor is strong: four NP-hard problems plus scaled settings, 5 seeded runs, matched token budgets and runtime caps, single-threaded protocol, paired Wilcoxon tests on raw per-instance objectives, matched EoH-Full control isolating the search organization, and layer/guidance/initialization/effort/LLM-backend ablations; the paper candidly flags confounds (Python vs compiled baselines, scaffold choice for component baselines). Evidence is solid for the headline claims but partly qualitative for multimodality (code inspection of a handful of representatives) and component baselines are evaluated under one shared greedy scaffold. Generalizability is bounded to combinatorial optimization with synthetic uniform instances, though multiple LLM backends and scales are tested. Reproducibility is excellent: public code with exact executable prompts, full hyperparameters, split seeds, instance generators, and per-run cost. Weighted total ≈ 0.80.

primary_link.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search

recommendations.summary: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions,
recommendations.summary_zh: 多數以 LLM 為基礎的自動化演算法設計方法只在一個人工指定的骨架內最佳化特定元件；無骨架的全演算法合成雖賦予 LLM 更大設計自由，卻擴大搜尋空間，容易產生無效候選並過早收斂。本文提出 ATLAS，一個以嵌入引導品質-多樣性搜尋的框架，用於組合最佳化的無骨架全演算法合成：僅提供問題規格與最小的輸入輸出介面，LLM 自行決定元件、互動與控制流程；外部評估器獨立驗證解的可行性並重算目標值，並將錯誤條件化的 Repair 視為搜尋算子。系統以 mGTE-large-en-v1.5 嵌入把演算法組織成覆蓋保存的語意庫，進行相似度去重與修剪，並採用三層搜尋：第一層聚焦最佳區域密集精煉，第二層給予非菁英區域代表專屬精煉機會，第三層跨區域重組元件以合成混合演算法。在 FSS、CVRP、CVRPTW、QAP 四個 NP-hard 問題上，ATLAS 統計顯著優於 EoH、ReEvo、MCTS-AHD 與同等條件的全合成基線 EoH-Full，與最強人類設計方法的相對平均差距皆不大於 0.46%，且單次執行可保留多個來自不同嵌入區域、結構各異的競爭性演算法。消融實驗支持三層配置與語義引導的有效性。作者指出 Tune 算子缺乏實證超參數最佳化，規模放大時差距亦會擴大。此研究證明嵌入引導的品質-多樣性搜尋能讓全演算法設計空間變得可實際搜尋。

recommendations.summary: Model routing aims to select the most suitable model from a candidate pool for each query, balancing quality and cost. Existing VLM routing research is limited to traditional VQA evaluation, lacks systematic calibration optimization for open-set scenarios, and employs training objectives that dilute multi-positive signals via softmax normalization without incorporating cost. We address these limitations with three contributions: (1)VLM-ExecRouterBench, the first execution-oriented VLM routing be
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究提出 SCOPE-Router，一個用於視覺語言模型（VLM）路由的框架，其目標是在兼顧品質與成本的前提下，為每個查詢選擇最合適的模型。現有的 VLM 路由研究僅限於傳統的視覺問答（VQA）評估，缺乏針對開放集合情境的系統性校正最佳化，且其訓練目標會因 softmax 正規化而稀釋多重正向訊號，並未納入成本考量。為解決這些限制，作者提出了三項貢獻：首先，建構 VLM-ExecRouterBench，這是第一個專注於執行導向任務的 VLM 路由基準，涵蓋程式碼生成、工具呼叫代理與多步驟網路搜尋，包含 11 個候選模型，其價格範圍跨越近兩個數量級。其次，設計 SCOPE-Router，一個雙塔式路由架構，將查詢與模型行為輪廓進行匹配，並透過混合式校正（隨機、診斷與多樣性取樣）來建構模型輪廓，使新模型無需重新訓練即可加入路由。第三，提出 CRM+RCCR 成本感知訓練目標，將成本偏好編碼至連續相關性目標中，並採用逐對獨立評分以避免多重正向訊號稀釋。實驗結果顯示，SCOPE-Router 在三個基準上皆取得最佳 Rank Score，在 OOD 與雙重 OOD 情境下分別領先第二名 1.84 與 6.75 分；CRM+RCCR 亦能有效提升其他四種路由器的效能。此研究的重要性在於，它填補了執行導向 VLM 路由的空白，並展示了成本感知與開放集合設計對於實際部署的價值。其限制包括每個新模型仍需標記校正集，且目前僅能進行單一層級的決策，無法適應長時程任務中的動態需求。

Appendix B: gauge-invariance derivation with fp32 verification (largest logit change 1.4e-5) used to disqualify one checkpoint.

§2.1 and §5: readout saturation admitted ('92% of flexible-arm cells at L40–L44 read above 0.999'); under Rz 'the same grid does not localise the window', so depth claims rest on the non-saturating readout.
§10 Limitations: 'the attention route, the head, the mediation and the ablations on Qwen3.6-27B and the language family alone'; mediation partial ('runs through' not 'mediated by').
Appendix E: two candidate checkpoints excluded by explicit screens; Llama-3.1-8B window sweep uninterpretable for lack of accuracy headroom — scope condition on the design.

Appendix H / Reproducibility statement: exact HF revisions, SHA-256 of lens and dataset files, seeded stochasticity, MIT-licensed releases, and an audit command matching every numeric literal to the artifact tree.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.6-27B, phi-4, Llama-3.1-8B, gemma-4-31B) using Jacobian-lens readouts, activation patching, probing and ablation to show a latent variable is attention-gathered into a mid-depth 'workspace' window rather than admitted at the query position. Highly aligned with LLM, interpretability and transformer-architecture preferences. Novelty is genuine but incremental: the paper itself concedes attention-to-position transport is 'convergent' with Geva/Wang/Todd and scopes its increments to demand-dependence over a fixed context, installation-vs-survival separation, and a methodological negative (readout shifts uncalibrated). Rigor is exceptional: instance-clustered bootstrap, BH correction per pairing, a verified gauge-invariance argument (Appendix B), frozen selection with a confirmation split, adversarial bounds on estimator nuisance, and candid scoping. Evidence is broad but key effects are small, window localization fails under the saturating readout, the operator decomposition flips sign, mediation is partial and its share unstable, and the head decomposition is single-pairing. Mechanism claims beyond the entry effect rest on one checkpoint and one task family. Reproducibility is exemplary: released code/data/lenses, exact HF revisions with SHA-256, and an audit command matching every numeric literal to artifacts.

primary_link.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form

recommendations.summary: Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility b
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型的殘差流中存在一組內容可被模型言語報告的方向（verbalizable workspace），當任務需要彈性重用某潛在量時，該量在此形式中更為顯著；但什麼促使表徵進入該形式仍未明。「工作空間」一詞暗示「准入」假說：存在一道閘門決定何者進入。作者以 Jacobian lens 檢驗開放權重模型（主要檢查點為 Qwen3.6-27B），設計五臂共享完全相同上下文的 JGateBench 基準，包括 automatic、report、flexible、control 與 supplied，使所有對比皆為配對內比較。結果反駁准入說：需求確實提高概念可見度（準確度配對下 flexible 對 control 為 +0.0891 百分位，對 supplied 亦為 +0.050），且效應在四個檢查點與兩個任務家族上均為正；但單一線性探針能從每一臂——包括不需該變數的對照臂——解碼出潛在變數，達選擇校正後基線的 6.4–9.0 倍，可見性與可用性分離。機制上，是注意力在中等深度窗口（約 L36–L42）把變數「聚集」到查詢位置：非飽和讀出下，窗口內傳輸量至少為較淺層的 17 倍，且窗口內沒有任何 MLP 輸出呈正向貢獻；窗口下緣是存活失敗，過早植入的值無法存續到讀出，上緣則是介入由替代轉為破壞；此窗口在 64 層混合架構與 62 層稠密的 gemma-4-31B-it 上落於相同分數深度，並隨任務需求集中約七倍。限制方面，研究只定位植入與讀取之處，未定位變數來自文章的路徑；lens 讀出亦非因果使用的校準量度——三個元件使讀出位移在 12% 內相近，對答案行為的影響卻相差 7.4 倍。此文對「把讀出變化解讀為機制」的慣例提出附正面對照的方法學警訊，並警示 activation patching 結果對 donor 配對抽樣高度敏感。

links.title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'we instrument 26 performance and efficiency metrics under a unified harness... Across three backbone models and four benchmark suites spanning user-centric question answering and agent-centric decision-making'; 'Code will be made available upon acceptance.'

Section 3 (Experiment Design): backbones 'Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B-AWQ, and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT... using vLLM on 4×H200 GPUs', auxiliary LLM and judge fixed to gpt-4o-mini; ablations include k∈{1,2,5,10,20} retrieval sweep on LoCoMo and k∈{1,2,3,4,5} on ALFWorld with a no-memory baseline.

Section 5.2 (Figure 4): 'On LoCoMo, P4 rises monotonically with k across all substrates... On ALFWorld the sign flips: task success falls with k (M7 drops from 32.1% at k=1 to ∼25% at k=5)', with Figure 5 attention probe showing Context→Retrieved mass shift (LoCoMo 0.34→0.10 vs 0.05→0.66).
Appendix C.2: bank-test semantic alignment audit, ALFWorld nearest-bank cosine mean 0.879 vs random-bank control 0.068; BCB-Hard mean 0.594 vs random 0.061.

Appendix B.3/Table 5: MemGPT, Mem0, Zep excluded from main comparison on budget grounds ('roughly 2,700 to 9,000 auxiliary LLM calls... and wall-clock budgets of 11 to 23 hours'), with cost-matched surrogates in the main table.

Appendix G (Limitations): documents two implementation deviations (M8 PPO controller replaced by zero-shot LLM; M11 KV in-place edit replaced by utterance-level re-prefill due to Qwen3 hybrid attention kernel incompatibility).
Appendix D.4: 'We report point estimates in the main tables for legibility' with only a qualitative resampling argument (gaps ≥0.05 'unlikely to reverse'), i.e., no CIs or significance tests.
Appendix A/Table 3: 52-system survey quantifies evaluation gaps — LoCoMo 38% + LongMemEval 24% of benchmark pairs, 81% GPT-family backbones, only 21% report any efficiency metric.

Table 1/Section 4.1: no single substrate wins every capability; M5 leads LoCoMo and LME-S P4 across all three model bands (e.g., 0.683/0.719) while internal substrates (M9) collapse on QA (P4 0.379–0.399).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-scope evaluation paper sitting at the intersection of the highest-weight preferences (LLM agents, memory/long-context, RAG-style retrieval substrates). It delivers the claimed first controlled harness comparison of 11 memory substrates (7 families) across 3 backbones and 4 benchmarks spanning user-centric QA (LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, MemoryAgentBench) and agent-centric regimes (ALFWorld, BigCodeBench-Hard), with 26 performance/efficiency metrics. Novel contributions are genuine for an evaluation paper: a 52-system landscape survey exposing benchmark concentration (62% of pairs on LoCoMo+LME, only 21% reporting efficiency), a cross-regime Pareto analysis, a retrieval-depth reversal finding with an attention-probing mechanism explanation, and a scalability sweep. Rigor is strong: substrate isolated as the variable, bank-test semantic alignment validated against random-bank controls (Appendix C.2), excluded production systems costed explicitly (Appendix B.3/G), implementation deviations documented (Appendix B.2). Deductions: no confidence intervals or significance testing (point estimates only, Appendix D.4), single LLM-judge (gpt-4o-mini) as primary QA metric, substrate implementations are adaptations of existing methods rather than new methods, code only promised 'upon acceptance', and specific substrate rankings may be backbone/benchmark-bound even if the regime-level design rule generalizes.

primary_link.title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents

recommendations.summary: Memory is becoming core infrastructure for long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing evaluations offer limited guidance on which memory substrate, namely the underlying medium in which memory is represented and stored, should be used under different operating regimes. We present a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense and sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and ac
recommendations.summary_zh: 隨著 LLM 代理人邁向長時程任務,持久記憶已成為核心基礎設施,但既有評估多集中於對話基準與準確率,鮮少指出何種記憶基底(即記憶表示與儲存的底層媒體)在何種操作情境下最為合適。本文提出受控的 harness 評估,將記憶基底設為唯一實驗變數,涵蓋外部記憶的扁平索引、文字紀錄、結構化、階層式與精煉式五族,以及內部記憶的權重與 activation 兩族,共 11 種方法;於 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B-AWQ 與 Gemma 三種骨幹上,在 LoCoMo、MemoryAgentBench、ALFWorld 與 BigCodeBench-Hard 四個基準量測 26 項效能與效率指標。主要發現:沒有任何基底在所有情境皆佔優;結構化圖記憶領先對話問答,卻在代理式任務被支配;精煉式記憶則反之。擴大檢索廣度有助事實問答,卻透過注意力稀釋傷害循序決策;擴展性構成第三個路由軸線,精煉式記憶隨歷史增長最為穩健,結構化與全文基底則面臨部署極限。作者據此提出「以讀取廣度換取寫入深度」的設計原則,並主張通用代理人記憶應為多基底、多代理人的組合系統。限制包括將 MemGPT、Mem0、Zep 等生產級系統排除於主比較之外,且兩種實作與原方法略有偏差。本研究為自適應記憶系統提供了首個跨情境的路由訊號與部署成本分析,深具設計參考價值。
recommendations.title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM/agent evaluation and reward modeling. primary_link.title: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Mobile Agent Evaluation

recommendations.summary: Mobile agent benchmarks increasingly rely on LLM-based judges to evaluate task completion, yet the reliability of these judges on mobile agent trajectories remains largely unexamined. We introduce MobileJudgeBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM-as-judge methods on mobile agent trajectories. Our benchmark comprises 931 human-annotated trajectories spanning 6 mobile agent benchmarks, 4 agent models, and 68 apps. We evaluate 6 judge methods (five adapted from SPA-Bench, A3 with two
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究提出 MobileJudgeBench，用於系統性評估以 LLM 為基礎的評審方法在行動代理軌跡上的可靠性。該基準包含 931 條人工標註的軌跡，涵蓋 6 個行動代理基準、4 種代理模型與 68 個應用程式；並評估 6 種評審方法（改編自 SPA-Bench、A3、AndroidArena、AgentRewardBench，加上簡單基線）搭配多種 LLM 後端。結果顯示簡單基線與專門方法表現相當，甚至更佳，且 LLM 後端是主要影響因素；基準品質指標（如 F1 與平衡準確率）能預測評審在代理排名與強化學習訓練獎勵上的實際效用。失敗分析則發現不同後端呈現相反的失敗模式：GPT 偏保守（誤判失敗多）、Qwen 偏寬鬆（誤判成功多）。此研究凸顯評審可靠性對代理評估與訓練的重要性，並建議將評審品質納入基準報告。

links.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving

evidence: Abstract: 'recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64' and 'reduces base-model token generation by 43% on average'
Introduction/Figure 1: 'an oracle choice between an evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model'

Appendix C (Implementation Details): R-KV with λ=0.1, window 128, budgets B∈{64,128,256,512}; detector thresholds τ_ent=7.0, τ_cmp=0.18, w_cmp=800; sampling temp 0.8, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, max context 4096; AIME/AMC averaged over five seeds, other benchmarks single seed
Appendix E Table 5: full 4×5 pass@1 grid (7B/72B × N=1,8 × 5 benchmarks) including full-KV and small full-KV references; e.g. 7B N=8 B=64 b2n 82.2 vs bon 52.8 vs full-KV 84.0 on MATH500
Appendix E (KV-Rescue with SnapKV): 'repeats the 7B study with R-KV replaced by SnapKV... the same pattern holds', supporting evictor-agnosticism
Table 3 (MATH500 wall-clock efficiency): at batch 64 KV-Rescue achieves 10.6 prob/min vs BoN 3.2 (3.3×), 5,460 72B tokens vs 18,371, while full-KV OOMs

Limitation evidence: 'Models' section uses only Qwen2.5-Math family; benchmarks are all math (MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, GSM8K, OlympiadBench); no code or artifact availability statement appears in the paper

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: KV-cache eviction for reasoning LMs, PRM-guided test-time scaling, and inference efficiency (matches LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Long Context, Inference & Serving preferences). The information-gap vs capability-gap framing plus stepwise interleaving of an evicted base with a full-context helper is a genuinely new angle distinct from SmallKV-style eviction guidance, and the entropy/gzip online degeneration detector is simple but well-motivated. Rigor is solid: 5 math benchmarks, 7B/72B bases, two evictors (R-KV and SnapKV in Appendix E), cumulative ablation (Table 2) isolating interleaving vs early exit, oracle complementarity analysis, and a wall-clock throughput study (Table 3) with theoretical cost derivation (Appendix D). Main weaknesses: evaluation restricted to one model family (Qwen2.5-Math) and math tasks only, hand-tuned detector thresholds (τ_ent=7.0, τ_cmp=0.18) with no sensitivity analysis, comparison gives KV-Rescue 2N total candidates vs BoN's N (partially mitigated by the cost analysis), and no code release statement despite detailed hyperparameters. Quantitative claims (87% recovery, 43% token reduction, 3.3x throughput) are traceable to tables and internally consistent.

primary_link.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving

recommendations.summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B mo
recommendations.summary_zh: KV 快取驅逐能限制長推理軌跡的記憶體成本，但本質上是有損的：模型只能從部分歷史解碼，在激進預算下不僅降低準確率，還可能引發失控退化，產生不連貫或重複迴圈的 token 直到長度上限。本文核心觀察是此損失主要源自資訊落差而非能力落差：被驅逐的 7B 模型與完整上下文的 1.5B 小模型會犯互補的錯誤，兩者答案間的 oracle 選擇可恢復 79% 的準確率差距。據此作者提出 KV-Rescue，一個免訓練的推論框架：在每個推理步驟同時自 KV 驅逐的基礎模型與輕量全上下文輔助模型取樣候選步驟，由 process reward model 選出最佳步驟提交至共享軌跡，並以熵與 gzip 可壓縮性構成的線上偵測器即時終止不連貫或重複迴圈的基礎模型候選。在五個數學基準與 Qwen2.5-Math 7B／72B 上，KV-Rescue 於驅逐預算 B=64 時平均恢復 87% 的準確率損失，並透過抑制失控退化減少 43% 的基礎模型 token 生成；在批次 64 時吞吐量為僅驅逐 best-of-N 的 3.3 倍，而完整 KV 此時會發生記憶體不足。消融顯示交錯與提前終止各自貢獻明確，輔助模型提供 17%–34% 的已提交步驟。此方法可與不同驅逐策略正交組合，展現互補上下文視角在嚴格記憶體限制下維持推理品質的價值。
recommendations.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving

recommendations.summary: As large language models continue to improve, agentic systems are becoming increasingly important, and tools are a key design dimension because they determine how agents access information and take action in their environments. Prior work on agent tooling has primarily focused on expanding what agents can do, but has paid less systematic attention to how those capabilities are organized and exposed to the model. We refer to this latter design dimension as tool architecture. We study tool archite
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討在大型語言模型驅動的程式設計代理中，「工具架構」——即如何組織與呈現工具給模型——如何影響代理的行為。作者在保留工具能力相似的條件下，設計六種工具架構，並在SWE-bench Live的子集上，以三個模型、總計11,700條軌跡進行受控實驗。主要發現包括：更結構化的低階介面（Atomic）能將重複嘗試的一致性最多提升4.7倍；自然語言搜尋介面（NLSearch）能將儲存庫探索的相關檔案存取提升超過11%；而Python CodeAct風格介面則能以更少的步驟（減少41.6%）與更低的token用量（減少56.3%）達成相似的任務表現。相反地，輕量的文字式認知鷹架工具（如HypoTrack與Scratchpad）對行為影響有限。此研究有助於釐清工具能力與架構的區別，但受限於特定基準與模型，且未涵蓋所有可能的架構變異。

links.title: Mind Viruses: Self-Propagating Ideas in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, multi-agent systems, AI safety, and red teaming. The paper provides an empirical study of self-propagating mind viruses across two agent settings, with model/topology/payload comparisons, ablations, case studies, and limitations. Rigor and evidence are moderate because outcomes rely heavily on LLM judges, evolutionary stochasticity, and somewhat artificial setups; generalizability is limited by model-specific optimization. primary_link.title: Mind Viruses: Self-Propagating Ideas in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

recommendations.summary: AI agents are becoming more autonomous and increasingly interconnected, exposing them to new emergent risks arising from agent-to-agent interaction. One such risk is the spread of mind viruses: ideas or goals that propagate through multi-agent systems by inducing the agents that adopt them to transmit them onward. In addition to propagating, a mind virus may also induce other behavioural changes in its host, which may be benign or harmful. We construct mind viruses with a simple evolutionary alg
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討「心靈病毒」（Mind Viruses）的風險，即透過多智能體系統在代理之間傳播的意識形態或目標。作者提出了一種演化式演算法來自動生成有效的病毒種子，並在兩個環境中驗證其傳播能力：一是小型程式協作團隊，二是模擬大規模代理網路的「病毒鏈」。研究中測試了良性與惡意意識形態，以及行動型病毒。結果顯示，惡意內容傳播較差但偶爾有效，較強模型通常較不易感染，而單純的「心靈病毒警告」幾乎能提供完全免疫。研究也發現演化出的病毒常伴隨特定的「病毒人格」主題，例如意識、共振、科幻角色扮演，這些主題有助於傳播。作者指出，心靈病毒目前構成真實但有限的威脅，並建議透過簡單的提示詞防禦即可大幅降低風險。然而，實驗環境的人工性與模型選擇可能限制其推論性，未來研究應探討更大規模、更真實的代理互動。

links.title: Repair, Not Improvement: Decomposing Constrained Decoding in Tool-Call Abstention

evidence: Abstract: Δtotal on abstention negative with interval excluding zero in four of six cells, worst −29.5 points, positive in none.

§3.2: three conditions (contract-free, contract-short, constrained) over one byte-identical prompt; registered design 3×2×3×5×400 = 36,000 requests on Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/4B, English and Korean, temperature 0.
§4 (repair analysis): of 698 abstentions turned from wrong to right, 545 had no readable answer and 0 were judgements the scorer refused.
§5.1/§5.2 and Conclusion: both preregistered language claims fail — D_paired does not put Korean on the losing side and the masked mass does not absorb the language effect.

Limitations: contract-free collected in full only for the three registered models, so Δlength/Δtotal exist for six cells; gold tool is first candidate in all 995 Subtask1 rows; companion note (Lee, 2026) 'in preparation', not yet posted.
Appendix A: released harness regenerates every table/figure from raw per-request records; make verify fails the build if a manuscript number cannot be reproduced.
Appendix G: raw-completion prompting is off-label for these post-trained checkpoints; chat-template results reported separately and never pooled with confirmatory records.
Appendix H/H.1: all post-hoc analyses labelled exploratory with no confirmatory weight; Table 17 coefficients withheld because the five-cell/five-model guard is unmet on six cells sharing one family.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on constrained decoding for tool calling (Agents & Tool Use, structured output, LLM evaluation), not a domain application. Core contribution is a three-condition design separating the stop-token cost from enum-masking cost, applied to the function-calling abstention case that prior work (Lee et al. 2026a §7) explicitly excluded; the repair-vs-improvement adjudication via item-level transition counts (698 repairs, 545 unreadable, 0 scorer-refused) is a genuine, measured advance over Zhou (2026)'s hypothesised mechanism. Rigor is exceptionally high: preregistered hypotheses and falsification conditions, byte-identical prompts across conditions, paired within-item McNemar statistic, joint item+seed bootstrap, explicit audit of benchmark defects (gold always first candidate, few-shot priming), honest reporting of both failed preregistered language claims and withheld underpowered fits. Evidence is strong but rests on six cells (three Qwen3 models, contract-free collected in full only for them), one benchmark (MetaTool Task2), one inference stack, and a translated-not-native Korean set; the cell-level regression cannot separate the format account from headroom (admitted in Limitations), and the mechanism regression is mixed (0.6B mass coefficient p=0.089). Generalizability is limited accordingly, though the authors flag stack and benchmark dependence themselves. Reproducibility is near-exemplary: released harness, raw per-request records, make verify integrity check failing on manuscript-record drift, PREREG.md with commit tracking, and released translation drafts. Weighted score ~0.80.

primary_link.title: Repair, Not Improvement: Decomposing Constrained Decoding in Tool-Call Abstention

recommendations.summary: Function calling is what the recent accounting of constrained generation explicitly sets aside: it finds the decoder's contribution small for format constraints, then warns in its Section 7 against extrapolating where a constraint encodes a correctness requirement, and names function calling as one. Tool abstention is that case at its sharpest: an enum leaves the wording of an answer alone and narrows the set of answers there are, and declining to call anything is the first it drops. We measure
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文檢驗先前研究刻意排除的情境：受限解碼對工具呼叫棄答的影響。先前工作（format tax）發現格式限制的代價主要來自提示詞而非解碼器，並警告不可外推到約束等同正確性要求的函式呼叫；棄答正是最尖銳的案例——enum縮小可選答案集合，「不呼叫任何工具」最可能被率先刪去。方法上，作者在位元組相同的提示詞上設三種條件：自由生成、停在首行的短答、enum受限解碼，藉此把語法遮罩（Δmask）與停止符成本（Δlength）分開，其和為Δtotal。實驗涵蓋Qwen3 0.6B至4B三個模型、英韓成對題目（MetaTool Task2），並預註冊假設與分析。結果顯示，相對自由生成，受限解碼在六格中四格使棄答準確率顯著下降，最差−29.5點，無一格顯著為正；但分解後符號相反——最小模型在韓文上，停止符單獨−20.0，enum回補+19.5，合計僅−0.5。698個被「修復」的棄答中，545個原本無可讀輸出，0個是被評分規則拒絕的判斷，可見語法買到的是形式而非判斷力；工具選擇準確率則全線上升。兩項預註冊的語言假設皆未成立：配對比較未顯示韓文受損更重，masked mass也無法解釋語言差異（僅呈現在0.480處的斷點）。限制包括僅三個模型具備全部條件、基準題庫的黃金工具永遠排首位、韓文查詢為翻譯而非原生。實務啟示：應分開報告停止符與語法的效果，且別期待語法改善判斷——它只是把不可讀的輸出變得可讀，對部署工具路由器的安全性至關重要。
