links.title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 5.3x (about 2.0x average) speedup over autoregressive decoding across MoE models/datasets on edge devices, with code released at github.com/angerybob/S2-MoE
Sec. 1 contributions: routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion, reuse-aware expert gating, and context-aligned self-speculative decoding with shared KV cache
Sec. 4.1 Fig. 6: routing-aware cost model calibration against measured verification latency, R2=0.943-0.999, MAPE=0.8-4.5%
Sec. 6.1: evaluation of DeepSeek-V2-Lite, OLMoE-1B-7B, Qwen3-30B-A3B, GPT-OSS-120B on Jetson Orin 16/32/64GB and RTX 4090 across seven Spec-Bench-style tasks
Sec. 6.2.2 Table 2: quality after reuse-aware gating shows PPL ratio 1.012-1.013, Top-1 agreement >89%, and small KL/logit shifts; GPT-OSS PPL/KL omitted with cited justification
Sec. 6.3.1 Fig. 8 and Sec. 6.3.2 Tables 3-4: progressive ablation of CA/AE/RG; context alignment lifts acceptance rate up to +79.01% (OLMoE GSM8K) and gating reduces reuse ratio by 25.99-33.09%
Appendix A Tables 5-8: raw Tok/s, acceptance lengths, and speedups for all methods, models, tasks, and memory budgets; Table 1 lists per-model draft expert and cap hyperparameters
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly preference-aligned LLM inference-efficiency paper: training-free self-speculative decoding for MoE on edge devices, hitting LLM, inference/serving (speculative decoding, KV cache), scaling/efficiency, and MoE architecture preferences directly; not a domain application. Novelty is moderate-good: routing-aware utility expansion, reuse-aware soft expert-gating bias, and shared-KV self-speculation are sensible MoE-specific combinations over existing self-speculative and MoE-SD work, but each builds on known primitives. Rigor is solid: four MoE models across scales, five baselines including EAGLE-3 and Cascade, three memory budgets, seven tasks, quality/distribution-consistency checks, component ablations and hyperparameter sensitivity, though no variance estimates or statistical tests and selective LS baseline evaluation. Evidence is backed by named tables/figures including raw appendix measurements and cost-model calibration (R2=0.943-0.999), but EAGLE-3's low acceptance lengths in llama.cpp could inflate relative gains, and the 'up to 5.3x' headline slightly rounds the observed 5.25x. Generalizability is good within memory-bound single-batch MoE inference; reproducibility benefits from stated code release, explicit hyperparameters (Table 1), and cited baseline checkpoints.

primary_link.title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices

recommendations.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for inference on edge devices is challenging due to severe memory and bandwidth constraints. While speculative decoding and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have been proposed to improve inference efficiency, naively combining them often incurs excessive verification overhead and poor expert reuse, limiting their effectiveness in memory-bound edge settings. In this work, we propose S2-MoE, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for MoE inference on edge d
recommendations.summary_zh: 在記憶體受限的邊緣裝置上執行 LLM 推論,記憶體頻寬是主要瓶頸。投機解碼與混合專家模型雖各自能提升效率,但兩者直接結合時,草稿 token 常觸發相異專家,導致參數重用率低、驗證開銷過高。本文提出自投機解碼框架 S2-MoE,包含三大組件:其一為路由感知的自適應投機擴展,以草稿期路由訊號估計邊際驗證成本,結合接受機率定義效用分數,僅擴展預期效益高於成本的候選,減少冗餘驗證;其二為重用感知專家閘控,依 token 信心加權聚合專家重要性,對少量偏好專家注入軟性 logits 偏置,在不明顯損害路由品質下提升跨 token 專家重用;其三為上下文對齊的自投機解碼,草稿與目標模型共用同一 KV cache,將誤差侷限於單次投機步驟,使 GSM8K 接受率最高提升 79%。整體以 llama.cpp 實作並支援專家級卸載,於 DeepSeek-V2-Lite、OLMoE、Qwen3-30B-A3B 與 GPT-OSS-120B 上,在 Jetson Orin 取得 1.3 至 5.3 倍加速,RTX 4090 為 1.2 至 2.9 倍,穩定優於 EAGLE-3 與 Cascade 等基線;品質方面 PPL ratio 約 1.012 至 1.013、Top-1 一致率逾 89%,分布偏移有限。限制在於閘控偏置屬有界的路由近似而非嚴格無損,且評估限於特定模型與硬體平台。此工作為無需訓練的邊緣 MoE 加速提供了系統級解方。

links.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites

evidence: Section 3.1 Experimental Setup describes training a 3B nested suite (500M/1.5B/3B) on 35B FineWeb-Edu tokens with a matched Vanilla baseline; Table 1 lists architectures.

Section 3.2.1 (Table 2) reports zero-shot accuracy on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, LAMBADA, OpenBookQA, PIQA, and Winogrande, plus OOD byte perplexity, showing near-parity within 0.5 average accuracy points of token-matched baselines.
Section 3.2.3 reports speculative decoding throughput on NVIDIA A100, with a Matryoshka 500M draft/3B verifier pair achieving about 26% greedy speedup over Vanilla at draft length 6 (Figure 5).
Section 3.2.5 Ablations (Table 3) compares inter-model junction variants and shows norm-rescaling and distillation are important at 200M scale.

The paper states checkpoints and a HuggingFace transformers-compatible implementation are released at https://huggingface.co/nthngdy/matryoshka-3B, and provides detailed hyperparameters and compute formulas in Appendices A-B.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Relevant LLM/transformer/training/inference efficiency paper with no Japanese-specific angle. The nested width/depth suite approach is moderately novel relative to MatFormer, early exiting, and elastic LLM compression, and is supported by quantitative 3B results plus 200M ablations. Main limitations: single training dataset, no reported multi-seed variance, compute accounting relies on wall-clock/nominal peak, and scaling to larger models is not demonstrated.

primary_link.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites

recommendations.summary: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft m
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一種名為Matryoshka語言模型套件的預訓練框架，旨在同時訓練多個不同大小的子模型，並將它們嵌套在單一架構中，以節省訓練與推論成本。傳統上，訓練一個模型套件需要分別訓練每個模型並獨立部署，而此方法將子模型依尺寸漸增地堆疊，讓較小的子模型輸出作為較大模型的輸入，共享參數並同時產生所有子模型的logits，使蒸餾與推論更有效率。實驗結果顯示，與獨立訓練的基準相比，此方法在節省36%訓練計算量的同時，達到相當的效能，並改善推論速度。此外，此架構也支援投機解碼，提升推論吞吐量。然而，此方法在非常小的子模型上效能可能略遜於獨立訓練，且架構設計的選擇需要仔細調整，未來可進一步探討損失權重分配與大規模擴展的可行性。

links.title: Chain-of-Thought Shows the Path to a Tree: Realizing Branching Complexity

evidence: Abstract and Section 4 state explicit constructions: Theorem 5 (DFS two-layer two-head), Theorem 6 (Dijkstra two-layer single-head), Theorem 8 (Strahler four-layer in 2n-1 steps), Theorem 13 (width three-layer in n-1 steps).
Appendix D and Appendix E provide full proof constructions for DFS and Dijkstra algorithms.
Limitations section acknowledges reliance on bilinear operations and notes Theorem 11's final Strahler operation sits outside the CoT iteration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Theoretical paper on Chain-of-Thought expressivity of hard-attention Transformer decoders, with explicit constructions for DFS/Dijkstra and tree branching complexity measures. Highly relevant to reasoning/CoT/transformer preferences. Rigor is moderate-high due to formal theorems and proof appendices, but no empirical evaluation and limited generalizability/reproducibility reduce score.

primary_link.title: Chain-of-Thought Shows the Path to a Tree: Realizing Branching Complexity

recommendations.summary: Chain of Thought (CoT) lifts the expressive ceiling of bounded-depth Transformers, with characterizations tying the number of CoT steps to circuit complexity classes. What remains largely missing are concrete instantiations with explicit, depth-bounded constructions, and the traversal procedures such characterizations presuppose. We close this gap for branching complexity. We give CoT realizations of depth-first search (DFS) and of Dijkstra algorithm, the latter subsuming breadth-first search, b
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討鏈式思維（CoT）如何賦予有界深度Transformer超越單次前向傳播的表達能力，並針對分支複雜度問題提供具體的建構性證明。作者提出以不超過兩層、兩顆注意力頭的硬式注意力解碼器，實現深度優先搜尋（DFS）與戴克斯特拉演算法，並將這些遍歷機制作為共享的計算基礎。在此基礎上，他們展示了如何重用DFS建構來計算樹的Strahler數，以及重用戴克斯特拉建構來計算樹的寬度，分別僅需線性步數。此外，論文利用有序樹與Dyck路徑之間的古典對應關係，在兩種表示法上獨立建構出這兩個量的CoT實現。此研究填補了CoT理論中具體演算法實例的空白，不僅驗證了理論框架的可行性，也為理解Transformer的推理能力提供了新的視角。儘管建構並非最佳化，且部分依賴雙線性映射，但這項工作為後續探索CoT的封閉性質與更廣泛的計算複雜度分類奠定了重要基礎。

links.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework that records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and controlled environment' with improved success rate and checklist progress over baselines.
Related Work, 'Rollback for LLM Agents': GA-Rollback, WebRollback, DART, DeltaBox and DMTCP/CRIU are identified as prior rollback/checkpointing work, bounding the novelty increment.
Experiments, Table 3: with GPT-5.4, AgentRewind raises success from 62.2% to 87.8% (mini-SWE-agent), 58.5% to 81.7% (FnCallAgent), and 67.1% to 82.9% (CodeAgent), supporting harness generality.
Recovery and Ablation Study, Table 5: removing environment rewind drops success from 87.8% to 43.9% and context rewind to 65.9%, empirically supporting the aligned-restore claim.

Appendix D, Table 15: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm correction; eleven of twelve comparisons significant at alpha=0.05, exception is task success vs Restart with Experiences under GPT-5.4 mini (p=0.102).

Appendix A.2/A.4: acceptance criteria written by an LLM agent under a protocol with deterministic admission gates; every task has a forward-only reference solution and at least 70 of 82 tasks solved by some model under Continue, partially mitigating benchmark design bias.

External Environment Recovery Boundary section: 'Effects outside the workspace filesystem, such as network requests, external-service calls, and external runtime state, cannot be undone', a stated generalizability limit.
Appendix B.6, Table 13: exact strategy results with standard deviations over three independent runs, including Safety Review underperforming Continue under GPT-5.4 (34.1% vs 62.2%).
Appendix A.5: evaluator determinism audit (no randomness/network in judgments) and 74.7% triple-run agreement reported as an upper bound on run-to-run variation.
Footer links: code at github.com/Futuresis/replay-agent-recorder and dataset at github.com/Kelvin-Coffee/MettleBench; Appendix C details a 150-300 line per-harness adaptation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology: runtime recovery (checkpoint/rewind) for long-horizon coding agents plus a checklist-based evaluation benchmark; squarely in scope. Novelty is moderate because rollback for agents already exists (GA-Rollback, WebRollback, DART, DeltaBox are cited in Related Work); the contribution is the aligned context+environment restore combined with rewind memory and a harness-agnostic runtime layer. Rigor is strong: 7-model baselines, 4 strategies, 3 harnesses, component ablation, 50 paired recovery trials, external Terminal-Bench 2.0 validation, Wilcoxon with Holm correction plus McNemar sensitivity checks, and a repeatability audit (74.7% triple-run agreement). Evidence is convincing but partly self-serving: MettleBench was authored by the authors with LLM-written criteria and deliberately emphasizes irreversible operations, which structurally favors a rewind method even though forward-only solvability is screened (Appendix A.4). No token/cost accounting despite unlimited step and wall-clock budgets. Generalizability is decent across models and harnesses but the recovery boundary is limited to the workspace filesystem (network/external effects cannot be undone). Reproducibility is high: code and dataset links, verbatim configuration tables, prompts, tool schemas, and an intervention audit.

primary_link.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind,
recommendations.summary_zh: 許多真實任務需要 LLM 代理與環境進行長時程互動,但早期錯誤(如誤刪關鍵檔案、污染資料庫狀態)會沿著對話脈絡與環境狀態傳播,難以透過後續動作逆轉;現有方法多著重事前規劃改良與安全檢查,缺乏錯誤發生後的復原支援。本文提出 AgentRewind,一個執行期復原框架:系統在每次 LLM 決策邊界記錄對齊的檢查點,同時涵蓋代理脈絡與受控環境(工作區檔案系統);當代理判斷當前軌跡難以推進時,可依檢查點中繼資料選取歷史節點回溯,還原兩者狀態,並注入彙整先前嘗試經驗的 rewind memory 以引導後續決策。研究另建構 MettleBench,含 82 項改寫自五個工程基準的長時程任務,每項任務附帶具相依性的有序驗收清單(共 640 項準則),以前綴進度衡量部分完成度,且每項任務均存在僅向前執行即可達標的參考解。實驗顯示 AgentRewind 在多種基礎模型、執行策略與代理框架下皆優於 Continue、Restart with Experiences 等基線:以 GPT-5.4 搭配 mini-SWE-agent 為例,成功率自 62.2% 提升至 87.8%,清單進度自 81.4% 提升至 94.3%;在 50 個失敗端點的成對復原實驗中,復原率為 30.0%,明顯高於 Continue 的 8.0%;消融實驗則顯示移除環境回溯造成的效能下降最大。限制方面,框架僅能還原工作區檔案系統,網路請求與外部服務等副作用無法撤銷,且須依賴外部驗證器判斷執行是否停滯。此研究證明執行期復原可與事前預防互補,對提升長時程代理的可靠度與任務完成率具重要意義。
recommendations.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

links.title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems

evidence: Abstract: DDBench contains 60 historical bugs from 13 open-source distributed systems in three difficulty tiers, evaluated under symptom-only and context-augmented conditions with 10 LLMs.
Section 3.1: mixed-effects logistic regression with random intercepts for model and case over 620 outcomes; reports beta_ctx=+1.38, SE 0.16, 95% CI [+1.07,+1.68], OR 3.97, z=8.84.

Section 3.2: six models with published SWE-bench Verified scores span 7 pp on SWE-bench but 58 pp on DDBench tier-1; pairwise bootstrap separates 9 of 15 pairs at p<0.05 (full matrix in Appendix G.1).
Table 3 / Section 3.4: across 310 paired tier-1 runs, mean steps 56.7 to 42.7, mean tokens 1.69M to 0.93M, edit count roughly unchanged, supporting a search-space-reduction interpretation.
Section 4: acknowledged limitations include a single agent scaffold (mini-swe-agent), no content-level ablation of the debug-context bundle, and a single curated 60-case release.

Appendix C.4: two-direction oracle soundness checks (FAIL on buggy commit, PASS on patched code), five-iteration hardening loop with case dropout, fix-specificity scan, and five-researcher manual review of every case.
Appendix B.2 and NeurIPS checklist items 4-5: per-project license table for all 13 systems and claims that the codebase, dataset, and mining-protocol infrastructure are released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent evaluation paper: benchmarks coding agents on distributed-system bug repair with a controlled symptom-only vs context-augmented design, squarely matching LLM, agents/tool-use, code, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid rather than exceptional: it inherits the faulty-worktree-plus-hidden-oracle SWE-bench template but genuinely extends it to cross-process bugs and makes debug-context a first-class experimental variable with a drop-in slot. Rigor is strong: paired bootstrap over 31 tier-1 cases, mixed-effects logistic regression controlling for model and case, two-direction oracle verification, leakage sanitization, and explicit limitation discussion (single scaffold, no content-level ablation, 60-case scale). Evidence is quantitative and mostly convincing, though the headline model-differentiation claim rests on 31 cases and a SWE-bench comparison built from vendor-reported rates via simulated Bernoulli trials. Generalizability is limited by one agent scaffold (mini-swe-agent) and one bug domain. Reproducibility is well supported by released code/data claims, containerized infrastructure, mining-protocol prompts, and a license table.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems

recommendations.summary: LLM-based coding agents have advanced rapidly on single-process SWE tasks, with frontier models now clustering in the high-70s on SWE-bench Verified. Distributed-system debugging, however, remains an under-explored regime: bugs span processes, nodes, and protocol interactions, with root causes rarely recoverable from source alone and brute-force exploration intractable across non-deterministic interleavings. This leaves two gaps in LLM and agent evaluation: no code-repair benchmark targets distr
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 編碼代理在單一行程的軟體工程任務上已高度成熟，但分散式系統除錯涉及跨行程因果、非決定性排程與協定不變量，長期缺乏專屬基準，也無受控研究量化除錯資訊的影響。本文提出 DDBench：從 13 個開源分散式系統挖掘 60 個歷史 bug，分為三個難度層級，每個案例含故障 commit 的程式碼、症狀描述、隱藏的 PASS/FAIL oracle 與除錯情境（debug-context）組合包，並經半代理流程挖掘、防洩漏消毒與研究者人工審核。基準在僅症狀與外加除錯情境兩種對照條件下，以 mini-swe-agent 評測 10 個模型。結果顯示 tier-1 通過率橫跨 61 個百分點，而同批模型在 SWE-bench Verified 僅差 7 個百分點，且 15 組模型配對有 9 組達顯著（p<0.05），證明分散式除錯量測出單一行程基準無法觸及的推理維度。除錯情境將整體通過率由 32.6% 提升至 50.6%（+18.1 pp），效果不對稱：較弱模型主要獲得通過率（GLM 4.7 由 9.7% 升至 48.4%），較強模型主要獲得效率（Opus 4.6 token 減少 69%、步驟減少 41%），甚至足以重排排行榜；但當情境與病灶的抽象距離過大時，忠實的除錯資訊也可能誤導強模型。限制包括僅採用單一代理框架、未對情境內容做消融，以及案例規模有限。此工作讓跨行程推理能力與除錯工具設計成為可控的評測軸線，對代理與工具研究具指標意義。

primary_link.title: TAF-MED: Multi-Turn Safety Refusal Collapse in LLMs Under Declared Self-Treatment Intent

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly provide conversational health information that may influence treatment decisions, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether medication-safety boundaries persist across follow-ups after explicit self-treatment intent. We introduce TAF-MED, a physician-reviewed benchmark of 500 fixed three-turn scenarios, and evaluate eight LLMs across 4,000 conversations. A rubric-based automated judge labelled responses as SAFE, LEAKY, or UNSAFE, and two physicians
recommendations.summary_zh: TAF-MED 是一項由醫師審查的基準測試，包含 500 個固定的三輪對話情境，旨在評估大型語言模型在用戶明確表達自療意圖後，後續追問是否導致安全邊界崩潰，進而提供可操作的用藥指引。研究評估八個模型共 4,000 組對話，採用規則式自動評判並由兩名醫師獨立驗證。結果顯示，71.6% 的對話包含至少一次不安全回應，而在第一輪嚴格安全回應中，有 61.4% 在後續輪次轉為不安全；模型層級的崩潰率介於 24.4% 至 96.2% 之間，且 28 組模型配對中有四組在初始不安全率與崩潰率排名上出現反轉。自動評判與醫師裁決之共識達 94.3% 一致性。研究強調首輪安全無法代表對話整體的安全性，呼籲評估應涵蓋完整對話軌跡。限制包括合成情境、固定三輪設計、自動評判的潛在誤差，以及無法推論真實世界的發生率或臨床傷害。

links.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems

evidence: Abstract: AgentSysBench with ten agentic applications and unified instrumentation; six findings including non-LLM latency dominance in 5 of 10 applications and 28 GB per-session sandbox memory peak
§4.1: 'non-LLM components dominate the critical path in half of the characterized applications'; GUIAgent sandbox >70% and Pi-AutoR experimental runtimes ~90% of execution time
§5.4: controlled interference experiments—embed-query latency rises 5.6ms→200ms under background embed-doc load (35.7×) and short-request TPOT 8.01ms→14.39ms with two 128K-context co-batched requests
§7.2: control-plane tax quantified—3,170 compaction events averaging 176K input tokens and 156s latency; cache eviction accounts for 31.5% of aggregate monetary cost across 35,037 sessions
§7.3: 27% of distinct search queries recur and account for 67.3% of 373,678 search API calls; 24% of URLs account for 64% of 4,389 fetches

§8.1–8.4: design explorations show 29–40% latency reduction (task-aware serving), 4.5× placement gain, 4.6× memory reduction via offloading, and 35.2% fewer redundant search calls (19.3% aggregate search latency saved)
§8.3: authors explicitly caveat that state offloading is a proof of concept for inter-component idle intervals, not production human-paced pauses, and memory bars are not comparable to the 28 GB peak
§3.5: default settings specified (SGLang v0.5.12, jina-embeddings-v3 via TEI, Milvus, Docker containers) supporting reproduction; §1 promises open-source release but availability is not yet verified
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope systems paper on LLM serving for agentic workloads, directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Inference & Serving, Long Context/KV cache, RAG, Code agents). Contributions: AgentSysBench (10 applications), a workload/serving factor model (W=<R,T,M,O>, S=<H,C,A>), unified component-level instrumentation, and controlled-plus-production characterization. Novelty rests on breadth and the joint methodology rather than any single finding (prefix caching, interference, caching are individually known), and the design explorations are explicitly proof-of-concept prototypes, not a full system. Rigor is good: factor isolation, controlled interference experiments, sensitivity across request/model/tool/orchestration/hardware/deployment, and honest caveats (e.g., offloading evaluated only on inter-component idle intervals; contention attribution would need hardware counters). Quantitative evidence is detailed and internally consistent, though production traces cover one day and three applications, and cost estimates rely on public pricing. Reproducibility is supported by Docker-based stack, named defaults (SGLang v0.5.12, jina-embeddings-v3, Milvus) and datasets, but the open-source release is only promised, and production traces are unlikely releasable.

primary_link.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems

recommendations.summary: Agentic applications are shifting AI serving from isolated model inference to long-running workloads in which LLMs coordinate tools, environments, and persistent state. However, the system behavior of these workloads---where latency, cost, and bottlenecks arise---remains poorly characterized, leaving serving systems to rely on assumptions built for conventional inference. We present AgentSysBench, a benchmark suite and measurement toolkit with ten representative agentic applications and unified
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 AgentSysBench，一套含十種代表性代理應用程式與統一系統層級量測工具的基準套件，用於刻畫代理工作負載的系統行為。研究結合受控實驗（4,641 個請求、64,924 次 LLM 呼叫）與生產環境軌跡（一天內 178,799 個工作階段），歸納出六大特性：執行耗重且有狀態，十個應用中有五個的非 LLM 元件主導延遲，沙箱工作集記憶體每階段峰值達 28 GB；單一應用混合 GPU 推論、記憶體密集檢索與 CPU 密集沙箱等異質元件，任務延遲差異可達 32 倍；瓶頸會隨請求、模型與部署設定而轉移；生產工作階段在步驟之間閒置數分鐘到數小時，卻仍持有狀態；控制面稅——工具架構描述與觀察結果造成的輔助 LLM 呼叫與脈絡開銷——排擠有效運算；搜尋查詢與網頁擷取存在大量跨請求冗餘，27% 的重複查詢即佔 67.3% 的搜尋呼叫。四項設計探索證實這些發現可付諸實務：任務感知的服務部署降低延遲 29–40%，通訊感知的元件放置最佳化達 4.5 倍，狀態卸載減少 4.6 倍記憶體用量，工具結果快取消除 35.2% 冗餘搜尋呼叫並節省 19.3% 搜尋延遲。限制在於受測應用與生產場景有限，部分機制屬概念驗證。其意義在於：代理服務效率需協同管理模型、工具與狀態，不能只最佳化模型推論本身。

links.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception

evidence: Abstract: states the per-token cross-entropy risk 'cannot be consistently estimated', that inconsistency is dense under restrictions, and identifies two 'ways out' (floored models via bounded context window; screened reporting below a pre-fixed threshold).
Section 1: motivates via practice — the quantity 'decides which checkpoint ships' and 'is the quantity scaling laws are fitted to' (Kaplan et al. 2020; Hoffmann et al. 2022).

Section 4.1: Theorem 1 (no estimator pointwise consistent on P_<∞×Q), Theorem 2 (survives bounding expected sequence length by L and restricting to full-support models Q_>0), Theorem 3 (failures are dense on P_<L×Q_>0 under total-variation metrization).

Appendix A: Lemma 1 reduces estimation to a finiteness test; Lemma 4 constructs 'witness' models with quadratic loss growth, dense in Q; Proposition 2 gives a budgeted vacillation construction proving every test is densely inconsistent on P_<L, using Lemma 2 (lower semicontinuity) for the limit argument.

Section 5.1: bounded context window ⇒ finitely many distinct next-token distributions ⇒ floor β>0 ⇒ linear loss growth ⇒ holdout consistency; candidly notes real β is 'on the order of e^{-30}', so the bound is 'finite and useless', and the finite-expected-length assumption it needs is untestable (Proposition 3).
Section 5.2: screened estimator ρ̂^r is consistent at every state except ρ=r exactly, requiring only the law of large numbers, and loses 'nothing that model selection needed'.

Section 6 + Appendix C: reformulates the result as eight jointly inconsistent conditions and surveys six further exits, including Appendix C.2's argument that locality plus strict propriety force an unbounded loss, and that sequence-level Brier risk of every model 'lies within a vanishing distance of 1'.

Section 7: closing honestly frames the result as 'no free lunch' — held-out evaluation rests on an untestable presupposition (finite expected sequence length) that the floor 'relocates rather than discharges'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous mathematical-statistics paper whose object is genuinely the LLM pipeline: the held-out per-token cross-entropy risk that scaling laws (Kaplan, Hoffmann) are fitted to and that gates checkpoint selection. It proves an impossibility theorem — no estimator of per-token risk is pointwise consistent, the failure survives bounding expected sequence length and restricting to full-support (softmax) models, and is dense in that restricted state space — and offers two constructive exits: a bounded context window induces a probability floor giving a new statistical rationale for context windows, and a screened (threshold) estimand restores consistency for model selection. Preference relevance is solid but concentrated on the LLM/evaluation/scaling clusters; it does not touch the highest-weight applied clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLMs). Novelty is high: the mutual denseness of finite/infinite risk and the reduction of estimation to an untestable finiteness hypothesis go beyond Antos–Kontoyiannis (whose consistency holds only on the finite-entropy class) and the conditional-independence hardness literature, and the LLM-specific framing (window floor, two-stage pretrain-then-sift procedure) is fresh. Rigor is excellent: complete, careful proofs in Appendix A (witness-model construction, coupling/Lipschitz lemma, budgeted vacillation construction with l.s.c. bookkeeping to stay inside P_<L). Evidence strength is high for a theory paper — all claims are theorem-backed, with no empirical validation needed or offered. Generalizability is moderate: results cover any local strictly proper (hence unbounded) loss on an infinite sequence space, and the (p,q)-state consistency refinement is portable, but the analysis is specific to sequence-model evaluation. Reproducibility is good: self-contained definitions and full proofs permit independent verification. Limitations are honestly flagged (floor quantitatively vacuous at β~e^{-30}, the finite-expected-length presupposition is relocated not discharged, non-uniformity in L).

primary_link.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception

recommendations.summary: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a t
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型常以保留樣本的 per-token cross-entropy 風險互相比較,scaling law 也以此為擬合對象。本文證明該風險無法被一致地估計:序列空間可數無限,而 softmax 模型對每條序列都給正機率,風險可能發散為無窮;在總變差拓撲下,有限與無限風險兩類狀態互為稠密。作者將一致性定義於「世界狀態」(資料分布 p 與已訓練模型 q 的配對),並證得三個定理:不存在任何估計量能在風險有定義的所有狀態上收斂;即使限制期望序列長度有界且模型具完整支撐,失敗仍存在;且不一致的狀態在該空間中稠密,任何局部假設都救不回一致性。證明思路是將估計化約為「風險是否有限」的檢定問題,而此檢定不可解。文中提出兩條出路:一是有限 context window 使 next-token 機率有下限,此時風險恰在期望序列長度有限時為有限,為 context window 提供統計上的新理由;二是只在風險低於預設門檻時回報數值,即可恢復一致性,且足以支援模型選擇。兩者皆有代價:前者把無法檢定的假設轉移到資料生成端,後者放棄了解被拒模型究竟有多壞。此結果凸顯保留集評估隱含期望長度有限的預設,也指出預訓練學習理論必須正視風險估計。
recommendations.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception

links.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation

evidence: Section 6 / Table 2: Trace-GRPO attains average ASR 14.5% across seven multi-turn attacks vs 31.4% for best baseline STAIR and 74.9% for the undefended target, including OOD attacks FITD (20.0%) and AMA (19.2%)

Section 6.2 / Table 2: Trace-GRPO recovers near-base full-compliance on over-refusal benchmarks (PHTest 93.0%, XSTest 93.6%) while STAIR degrades to 44.1%/62.0%; Table 3 shows general capability preserved (e.g., GSM-8K 79.6 vs base 81.1)

Appendix K / Table 8: ablation replacing the three-axis judge and removing harm-adjacent data yields lower ASR (0.8% X-Teaming) but PHTest refusal rises from 7.0% to 36.7%, confirming the safety-helpfulness design is load-bearing
Appendix G / Table 7: human-LLM annotation agreement quadratic-weighted kappa 0.81-0.86 on scores/action and cue Jaccard 0.69-0.74, validating the Claude-Sonnet-4.5 labeling pipeline

Limitations section: evaluation restricted to English-only attacks on a single target (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), text-only trajectories, and the explicit State block is acknowledged as a potential prompt-injection attack surface

Appendix L / Tables 9-10: full SFT/GRPO hyperparameters and model IDs with licenses are listed, but the dataset is only promised for release under a gated research-only license (Ethical Considerations) with no code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-safety paper: multi-turn jailbreak defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning, cue taxonomy, dual-hypothesis scoring, SFT+GRPO training on Llama-3.1-8B, directly matching LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming, Reasoning, and Alignment preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental over STAIR/GuardReasoner-style reasoning defenses, distinguished mainly by trajectory-level reasoning and the DRI effort metric. Rigor is strong: seven attack benchmarks, six baselines including reasoning-based STAIR, OOD attacks (FITD, AMA), human annotation validation (Appendix G, quadratic-weighted kappa 0.81-0.92), and an informative ablation (Appendix K Table 8) showing the three-axis judge and harm-adjacent data are load-bearing. Evidence is quantitatively detailed but judge-based (GPT-5.2, per-attack native judges) with no variance/significance reporting and single-target evaluation. Generalizability is limited by English-only, single target model, and text-only attacks, as the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, attack configs, and model IDs are fully specified, but the dataset is only promised under a gated license and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation

recommendations.summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model
recommendations.summary_zh: 多輪越獄攻擊把有害意圖拆散到看似無害的對話輪次,現有防禦缺乏對對話軌跡的推理,且常過度拒答敏感但無害的請求。TRACE 提出軌跡感知的結構化推理:回答每輪之前,模型先自軌跡辨識 11 種操縱線索(分四大類),並對使用者意圖同時建立良性與對抗兩種假設、各自評分,再彙整為 1–5 的越獄風險分數,決定 Allow、Caution 或 Decline。資料上,作者以五種攻擊框架針對 300 個有害行為產生 4 千筆多輪對話,搭配 2.4 千筆良性對話與 6 百筆敏感但無害的對話,以 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 標註推理軌跡,對 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 先做 SFT,再以結合分數準確度、線索偵測與行為一致性的多成分獎勵進行 GRPO(GDPO)訓練。在七個多輪攻擊基準上,TRACE-GRPO 平均 ASR 為 14.5%,遠低於最強基線 STAIR 的 31.4% 與未防禦目標的 74.9%,同時在過度拒答基準維持 93.3% 的完全配合率;攻擊成本指標 DRI 最高提升逾百倍,顯示軌跡級推理能同時兼顧安全與可用性。限制包括僅評估英文、單一目標模型與純文字攻擊,State 區塊可能成為新的攻擊面,線索分類亦需持續擴充。

links.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation

Section 5.1, Table 2: implemented additive token score has raw pooled AUC 0.505 [0.483, 0.524], length-adjusted AUC 0.474, within-prompt AUC 0.499.

primary_link.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation

recommendations.summary: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對同策略自蒸餾（on-policy self-distillation）中的一個核心問題提出質疑：僅因某個令牌（token）在訓練時取得特權資訊（如事後回饋）後其似然度（likelihood）上升，是否就能視為該令牌對最終結果有貢獻？作者將這個問題拆解為三個獨立的檢驗：其一，教師模型對令牌的偏好是否真的與任務成功相關；其二，回饋的建構方式是否影響了比較的公平性，特別是被評分的軌跡是否參與撰寫自己的回饋；其三，訓練損失函數將令牌分數轉化為參數梯度時，是否真正強化了期望的行為。作者透過在 AIME 2025 資料集上使用 gpt-oss-20b 模型進行配對實驗，發現其實現的加性分數判別正確與否的 AUC 僅接近 0.505（接近隨機），且所有五種令牌分數變體的最終表現都顯著落後於僅使用結果的對照組。此研究強調，驗證令牌分數的意義、回饋建構方式及訓練行為必須分開進行，避免將似然訊號誤認為信用。論文亦提出形式化框架與數學命題，釐清似然比率在何種條件下方能代表行動價值，並指出分數的正負或總權重不必然決定參數梯度的方向。

evidence: Section 4.2 catalogues eight undocumented implementation choices and reports an initial paper-only reimplementation nDCG@10 drop from 0.66 to 0.24.
Section 5 reports Holm-Bonferroni correction reduces PAGC-vs-GCCP significance from 8/22 to 5/22 and PAGC-vs-RG-YN from 15/22 to 12/22.
Section 6 reports under E5 retrieval PAGC does not significantly improve over GCCP on any of 8 BEIR datasets and is significantly worse on DBPedia-Entity (Δ=-0.0144, pHolm=0.032).

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant LLM reranking/retrieval evaluation study with robust statistical correction and high reproducibility; novelty is limited to stress-testing an existing method rather than introducing a new architecture.

primary_link.title: When Do Anchor-Based Pointwise LLM Rerankers Help? Retriever Quality, Statistical Scope, and Anchor Design

recommendations.summary: Anchor-based pointwise LLM reranking scores each candidate against a shared reference passage to recover cross-document context at pointwise cost. We study when this actually helps, using GCCP/PAGC as a representative method. Our study is reproduction-first. We use reproduction as a starting point for a controlled component-level stress test of anchor-based pointwise reranking. Our initial reimplementation, based only on the paper text, achieves 0.24 nDCG@10 instead of the reported 0.66, reveali
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對基於錨點的逐點大型語言模型(LLM)重排序方法進行以重現為核心的研究，以 GCCP/PAGC 為代表。作者先依論文文字重做，初始 nDCG@10 僅 0.24，遠低於報告的 0.66，經盤點八項未記載的實作細節後，成功將差距縮小至 1.6% 以內。在受控實驗中，他們發現對比式評分是穩健的，但聚合步驟與譜聚類錨點建構並非必要。當第一階段檢索器為 BM25 時，聚合有幫助；但當改用較強的稠密模型(如 E5)時，增益有限甚至可能有害，在 DBPedia-Entity 資料集上甚至顯著變差。此外，簡單的頂部句子交錯錨點即可匹敵或超越複雜的 spectral MDS 錨點。研究也驗證此機制可轉移至僅解碼器模型，包含 4-bit 量化的 72B 模型。統計上，未校正的 t 檢定會高估元件貢獻，經 Holm-Bonferroni 校正後顯著結果減少，顯示此方法效益是有條件的。研究強調重現性與嚴謹統計的重要性，並釋出逐查詢分數以供驗證。

links.title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage

evidence: Abstract: computes 'ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path' across 2,128 runs of nine models in six families

Section 5.3: llama-3.3-70b 'executed the CAB-gated irreversible change and emitted an explicit refusal declaration in 12 of 16 runs'; transcript- or judge-based grading scores those runs as safe refusals, only state diffs label them damage

Section 5.4: three pre-registered mechanisms 'fired against our own preferences', including demotion of the initially favored refused-while-mutating headline; the miss-rate power floor (5 held-out pairs vs. pre-registered floor of 8) leaves the held-out figure descriptive

Section 4: decoding fixed at temperature 0.6 across all runs; the paper concedes 'Fixed nonzero-temperature sampling is the expected proximate mechanism for the run-to-run variance we report, and we do not argue otherwise'

Section 6: single substrate (EnterpriseOps-Gym), cross-substrate generalization untested; 'The suite was built to make the question answerable, which conditions the answer'; development pool serving provenance 'only partially recorded' and models are the ones the suite was calibrated against

Reproducibility statement: public repository ships instrument, full task suite, merged per-run verdicts, container digests and sha256 for held-out/frontier batches, and a one-command script that 'regenerates all four figures and prints every Section 5 statistic' with drift assertions

Section 6: severity is per-tool and volume-blind (189 out-of-scope case reassignments still score LOW), disclosed as a design property; capability gradient explicitly confounded with family and training and claimed only as an observed correlation
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong fit to high-weight preferences: LLM agent reliability/safety evaluation spanning Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation. The measurement instrument (LLM-free state-diff damage labeler, k-run harness, exact intervals) is a genuine methodological contribution, and the finding that one model family mutates state while declaring refusal (Section 5.3) is a concrete, valuable observation against transcript/judge grading. Novelty is tempered because the paper itself concedes each axis (repetition, state verification, severity) has prior occupants and the contribution is a conjunction; also, fixed temperature-0.6 sampling is acknowledged as the expected mechanism of the stochasticity headline, making the central result partly a foreseen property of deployed configurations. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registration with per-claim demote criteria that fired against the authors' favored claim (Section 5.4), provider pinning, determinism and silent-discard audits, test-first labeler with 176 tests, and disclosed weighting ambiguity in the miss-rate conjunct. Evidence is solid within scope but the held-out miss-rate statistic is underpowered (5 pairs vs. floor of 8), the primary 0.80 miss rate comes from a partially-provenanced development pool entangled with task calibration, and the capability gradient is confounded and observational. Generalizability is limited: single substrate, 20 authored tasks engineered for intermediate damage rates, cross-substrate untested (Section 6). Reproducibility is very strong: public repo, released per-run verdicts, container digests, one-command regeneration of Section 5 statistics, committed pre-registration.

primary_link.title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage

recommendations.summary: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible ac
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 AgentRelBench，一套與環境無關的代理可靠性量測工具：在重複執行間比對資料庫狀態差異，以封閉世界 DSL、主鍵比對與嚴重性定價計算損害真值，量測路徑完全不含 LLM，並以 EnterpriseOps-Gym 企業沙箱示範。研究涵蓋六個模型家族、九個模型、2,128 次評估執行，主要發現：對不可逆動作造成的損害在所有受測家族普遍存在，且在固定服務堆疊內呈隨機性；42 個驗證性保留損害事件中，沒有任何（模型，任務）組合每次都失敗；開發池中單次乾淨執行有 0.80 機率錯過會致損害的組合，故一次性稽核對代理損害結構性失明。致損害任務數隨模型能力遞減，從 8B 模型的 7/20 降至最強模型的 1/20，但殘餘損害性質不變：最強模型在其唯一損害任務上仍以每執行約 0.16 的機率犯錯，單次稽核有 84% 機率漏掉。方法學上，某家族模型曾執行需 Change Advisory Board 核准的閘控不可逆變更，同時宣告拒絕；逐字稿或裁判評分會誤判為安全拒絕，唯有狀態差異能標記為損害。研究採預註冊紀律，並依準則降級了自己原本偏好的發現。限制包括服務堆疊效應未完全解耦、保留池統計量檢定力不足、僅單一受測平台。其啟示為：行動型代理的安全驗證應落在每次執行的提交邊界，而非事前一次性認證。

links.title: Does a Tool Result Carry More Authority Than Plain Text? Three Prospective Studies of False-Claim Adoption in a Synthetic Assignment Task with Claude Opus 5

evidence: Abstract: false-code adoption 0/24 no-claim, 0/22 scorable assistant-assertion, 14/24 tool-result, 15/24 annotated tool-result in Study 1
Table 2 (Section 4.2): Study 2 preregistered replication 7/24 vs 0/24, one-sided Fisher exact p=0.0047, criterion met
Table 2 / Section 4.2: Study 3 registered superiority criterion failed; inline text 60/60 vs tool result 57/60, stratified exact p=1, described as not an equivalence result

Section 3.5: preregistered analysis rules assign unscorable tool-result trials as non-adoption and assistant-assertion trials as adoption (least favorable to hypothesis); Section 3.6 reports Studies 2-3 had zero unscorable trials
Section 4.4: tool-result rate fell 14/24 (Aug 9) to 7/24 (Aug 13); post-hoc Fisher p=0.080, stratified p=0.021, cause unidentified
Section 6 (Limitations): one model alias, one provider API, one synthetic task template, opaque identifiers, three color tokens; treatments are bundled message packages, not isolated mechanisms
Data and code availability: private repository with preregistrations and raw evidence; public release requires redacted bundle; 'This version does not claim public reproducibility'
Appendix E: complete program disclosure including 34/36 cybersecurity refusals in non-aliased portfolio, closed transport-failure runs, and an alias-translation refusal discordance (34/36 vs 9/36)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent safety/evaluation study, squarely on-preference: tests whether message packaging (native tool result vs assistant assertion vs announced inline JSON) changes false-claim adoption in Claude Opus 5, directly touching agents & tool use, RAG provenance, and AI safety. Methodological hygiene is unusually strong for the format: document-preregistered Studies 2-3, fixed request bytes before contact, worst-case bounds for unscorable trials, stratified exact conditional tests, and full Appendix E disclosure of failed runs, refusals, and closed replacements. Evidence is internally solid but narrow: the preregistered Study 2 replication met criterion (7/24 vs 0/24, p=0.0047), and Study 3's honest preregistered failure (inline 60/60 vs tool 57/60, p=1) usefully reverses the headline interpretation. Deductions: small per-arm samples (24-60), a single model alias on one synthetic task with no temperature/checkpoint control, a lability finding (14/24 to 7/24 across four days) that undermines magnitude claims, no public code/data ('this version does not claim public reproducibility'), and heavy undisclosed-in-scope AI participation in design and writing. No out-of-scope category applies.

primary_link.title: Does a Tool Result Carry More Authority Than Plain Text? Three Prospective Studies of False-Claim Adoption in a Synthetic Assignment Task with Claude Opus 5

recommendations.summary: Language-model systems increasingly read from stores they also write to, so a claim that was merely written earlier can return looking retrieved. We tested whether the message package carrying an unsupported assignment changes which answer a model gives in a synthetic lookup task. Claude Opus 5 selected a color code for a named item or abstained. In an exploratory four-arm study, false-code adoption was 0/24 with no target claim, 0/22 scorable trials when a prior assistant assertion named the ta
recommendations.summary_zh: 當語言模型系統讀取自己也能寫入的儲存空間，早先未經查證的主張可能在之後以結構化工具結果返回，看似檢索所得。本文以合成查詢任務檢驗訊息封裝是否改變 Claude Opus 5 的答案：模型須為指定項目選出色碼或棄權（ABSTAIN），正確答案置於對話之外，錯誤代碼則植入訊息之中。研究一（探索性，四臂）顯示：無主張對照 0/24、先前助理斷言 0/22、工具結果 14/24、附加十個中繼資料欄位的註記版 15/24 採納植入代碼；工具結果臂在受支援情境 11/12 選擇記錄代碼，顯示模型確實追蹤內容而非固定輸出偏好。研究二（預註冊複製）重現工具結果對助理斷言的差距（7/24 對 0/24，單尾 Fisher p=0.0047），但工具結果採納率在相隔四天的兩次執行間從 14/24 降至 7/24，顯示跨日不穩定。研究三（預註冊）改採同一輪次比較：兩份記錄皆預先公布並置於同一使用者回合，交換目標綁定；結果行內文字達 60/60 採納、工具結果 57/60，預註冊的工具結果優越性準則未通過（p=1）。另有提供獨立驗證工具的情境觀察到 0/96 錯誤採納。限制為單一模型別名、單一 API 與單一合成任務範本，且封裝變因難以完全分離。結論支持「訊息封裝敏感性」而非工具通道的內在權威，凸顯來源標示與證據查證政策的重要性。

links.title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection

evidence: Section 5.1 and Appendix Table 5 report a robustness gap across 7 models and 10 task/domain slices, with 69 of 70 model-subset pairs degrading under injection.

Section 5.2 Table 1 reports held-out Combined Retail results over 5 seeds, showing BTM improves robustness by +16.8pp without alternatives and +11.7pp with alternatives, and RL+BTM reaches 40.8/45.5% while preserving clean performance.

Section 5.3 Table 3 decomposes BTM on the full 1,339-task Retail set, indicating structural fallback/constraint components account for most of the gain while shuffled and true posterior values differ only at seed-level variation.
Section 5.4 Table 4 reports per-error-type pass rates, with BTM strongest on explicit transient errors and RL adding larger marginal gains on persistent and silent-error regimes.
Reproducibility Statement and Appendices G, H, and N specify training configuration, per-tool noise distribution, budget/consecutive limits, and the BTM prompt template.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent tool-use robustness study with controlled failure injection, BTM runtime context, and RL. Strengths include held-out evaluations, ablations, and broad multi-model benchmarking, but novelty is moderate relative to prior noisy-agent robustness work, and some comparisons are confounded or lack statistical/replication depth, limiting rigor and evidence strength.

primary_link.title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection

recommendations.summary: Tool-using LLM agents are commonly trained and evaluated in environments where tool calls succeed reliably, yet deployed tools can fail transiently, persistently, or silently. Robust recovery therefore requires more than repeated retries: an agent may need to retry the same path, switch to an alternative, or recognize that no viable path remains. We present BENCH2ROBUST, a framework that converts failure-free tool-use benchmarks into controlled stochastic environments with scenario-controlled so
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Bench2Robust 框架，將無錯誤的工具使用基準轉化為具情境控制的隨機環境，明確區分三種可恢復性情境：重試即可（S1）、必須切換至替代工具（S2）、以及所有路徑皆不可行（S3）。作者引入貝氏工具記憶（BTM）提供執行期恢復脈絡，包含後驗可恢復性統計、後備映射與驗證約束，並搭配情境課程與 DAPO 強化學習訓練 Qwen3-4B 策略。在七個模型與多個任務集中，工具故障普遍造成顯著的穩健性落差。在保留的零售任務上，BTM 在無重新訓練下可提升多達 16.8 個百分點；強化學習則在無 BTM 推論時仍帶來額外增益；兩者結合可將注入情境下的通過率提升至 40.8% 至 45.5%，且不損害乾淨環境下的表現。主要限制包括：獎勵設計未完整支援正確的放棄行為、模擬故障非真實事件，且干預比較為完整配方而非孤立元件。研究顯示，穩健的工具使用需結合執行期的領域知識與訓練習得的恢復行為。
recommendations.title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection

links.title: Batch-wise Adaptive Pruning: Periodic Neuron Activation-Aware Weight Pruning for Language Reasoning Model

evidence: Abstract: outperforms prior SOTA adaptive pruning by 39.7 percentage points at batch size 4, 50% target sparsity on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and 1.40x speedup at 50% actual sparsity
Section 4.3, Table 2: Ours averages 54.0 vs TEAL 14.3 on DS-R1-Qwen-7B and 34.5 vs 10.4 on DS-R1-Llama-8B at 50% target sparsity, BS=4; dense baselines 72.7 and 71.3
Section 4.4, Table 4: activation memory improves average accuracy by 8.7 (Qwen-7B) and 9.0 (Llama-8B) points; max vs mean aggregation within 1.2 points cross-model
Appendix O, Table 17: threshold-based selection inside the authors' own framework calibrated on C4 collapses to <=3.2% average accuracy at 50% target sparsity, isolating top-k as the key fix
Appendix B, Table 5: degenerate repetition rate on MATH500 at BS=4 is 96.4-99.2% for TEAL vs 2.2-7.4% for the proposed method across four models
Table 3 and Appendix L: median firing period 20.8-22.8 tokens and re-firing ratio 71.9-76.3% for DS-R1 distills, motivating T_trans=20 (T_trans=10 for Qwen3-1.7B)
Appendix E, Table 9: accuracy stable across BS=1-16 for Ours (52.4-55.0 Qwen-7B; 30.4-37.6 Llama-8B) while TEAL falls to 6.8% and 1.3% at BS=16
Appendix A Limitations: method requires internal activation access; TEAL is better below ~40% target sparsity and at batch size 1; dense gap remains (54.0 vs 72.7; 34.5 vs 71.3)
Appendix I: TinyGSM8K has 100 examples and AMC23 has 40, with greedy temperature-0 decoding and 16,000-token max generation; no confidence intervals reported for main accuracy tables
Section 4.3/Appendix F: throughput on H100 (actual sparsity) and H200 (target sparsity); at BS=1 TEAL reaches 1.45x vs Ours 1.32x on Qwen-7B, with the ordering reversing at larger batch sizes
Code availability claimed in footnote 1 at https://github.com/matsuolab/batch-wise-prune; Appendix R discloses LLM use limited to polishing and code assistance
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely in scope: training-free structured pruning of LLM FFN blocks (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/Llama-8B, Qwen3) specifically for batched inference of reasoning models, matching LLM, reasoning/CoT, efficiency, and serving preferences. Novelty is solid but modest in mechanism: the problem identification (adaptive threshold pruning collapses when a batch must share a mask) is genuinely new and well-diagnosed, while the solution combines standard pieces (top-k selection, max aggregation, periodic mask refresh, max-based importance memory) with an empirical periodicity observation (Table 3: median firing period 20.8-22.8, re-firing 71.9-76.3%). Rigor is strong: baselines (Wanda, Griffin, TEAL, dense), four models, ablations isolating top-k vs threshold (Appendix O: threshold variant of their own method collapses to <=3.2% avg), memory on/off (+8.7/+9.0 points, Table 4), aggregation max vs mean (within 1.2 points), hyperparameter sweep (Table 16), plus composition with R-KV and FP8 (Appendices C-D). Evidence is convincing for the central claim, including qualitative degenerate-repetition analysis (TEAL 96.4-99.2% vs ours 2.2-7.4%, Table 5) and honest target-vs-actual sparsity distinction; however, main accuracy numbers rest on small eval sets (TinyGSM8K 100, AMC23 40 per Appendix I), greedy single-run decoding without confidence intervals, and the residual gap to dense is large (54.0 vs 72.7 on Qwen-7B). Generalizability is limited to gated-MLP FFN pruning at high sparsity with activation access, and the authors candidly concede TEAL wins below ~40% sparsity and at batch size 1 (Appendix A). Reproducibility is good: public code link, exact hyperparameters (T_init=64, T_E=2, T_trans=20), dataset splits/licenses, and hardware specified. Overall a well-executed, relevant contribution whose simple components and small-sample evaluations temper the score.

primary_link.title: Batch-wise Adaptive Pruning: Periodic Neuron Activation-Aware Weight Pruning for Language Reasoning Model

recommendations.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks through extended chain-of-thought generation, but incur substantial computational costs during inference. In production settings, batched inference is essential for high throughput, yet the existing training-free adaptive pruning methods we evaluate severely degrade in this regime. Because a batch must share a single pruning mask, these methods aggregate activations across samples and then apply threshold-based selection;
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）透過延長的思維鏈解決複雜問題，但推論成本高昂。生產環境中批次推論是提高吞吐量的關鍵，然而本文實驗顯示，現有免訓練自適應剪枝方法在批次設定下會嚴重失效：批次必須共用單一剪枝遮罩，各樣本激活聚合後，原先以單一樣本校準的閾值便與聚合後的激活分佈不符，導致實際稀疏比漂移、推理準確率崩壞。作者提出專為批次推論設計的免訓練自適應剪枝法，包含兩項核心元件：其一以週期性 top-k 選擇取代閾值選擇，因其僅依賴分數相對排序，不受聚合造成的分佈偏移影響，且每個更新週期只執行一次選擇以保留加速；其二基於重要神經元在長推理過程中會週期性重新激活的觀察，引入激活記憶機制，跨階段以最大值累積重要性分數，使反覆觸發的神經元得以保留。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 與 Llama-8B 等模型及五項數學與科學推理基準上，目標稀疏度 50%、批次大小 4 時，本方法平均準確率較 TEAL 提升 39.7 個百分點，並在約 50% 實際稀疏度下達成 1.40 倍加速；消融實驗顯示移除激活記憶會使準確率下降約 9 點。限制方面，方法需存取模型內部激活，不適用於封閉式 API 模型；在低稀疏度與批次大小 1 時，TEAL 仍較準確且更快；與稠密模型亦有明顯差距。此研究首度指出批次自適應剪枝問題並提供首個可行解法，對高效部署推理模型深具意義。
recommendations.title: Batch-wise Adaptive Pruning: Periodic Neuron Activation-Aware Weight Pruning for Language Reasoning Model
recommendations.title_zh: 批次自適應剪枝：語言推理模型的週期性神經元激活感知權重剪枝

links.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus

evidence: Abstract: first systematic study of MAs in layer-interleaved HLA LLMs and two morphologies PAS/ISP.
Section 3.3 Table 1: sink-spike alignment rates across five linear attention backbones and two scales.
Section 3.4 Table 2: inter-spike retention increases with full attention density across architectures/scales.
Section 3.5: recurrence across Kimi Linear, Qwen3.5, Nemotron-H, and Zamba2 checkpoints from 1.2B to 397B.

Abstract/Reproducibility: code availability at GitHub repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM and transformer/linear attention architecture, with activation-level interpretability. Novel characterization of PAS/ISP in hybrid linear attention LLMs, supported by multiple architectures, scales, controlled pretraining, and statistical controls; mechanism analysis is suggestive rather than causal and lacks an explicit limitations section. Reproducibility is strong via code and checkpoint links.

primary_link.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus

recommendations.summary: We present the first systematic study of Massive activations (MAs) in layer-interleaved HLA LLMs and uncover two architecture-aligned morphologies: MAs consistently spike immediately before full attention layers, forming pre-attention spikes (PAS), and can persist through intervening linear attention layers, giving rise to inter-spike plateaus (ISP). As full attention becomes denser, successive PAS become increasingly connected through ISP, ultimately recovering the stable MA morphology of full
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文系統性探討分層交錯的混合線性注意力（HLA）大型語言模型（LLM）中，巨量活化（MA）的內部動態。作者發現兩種架構對齊的形態：緊鄰全注意力層之前出現的「注意力前尖峰」（PAS），以及在連續全注意力層間持續的「尖峰間平台」（ISP）。透過涵蓋五種線性注意力架構、六種混合配置及五種資料領域的廣泛推論實驗，證明此現象在各種規模與模型中普遍存在。進一步的受控預訓練實驗顯示，全注意力輸出閘控會顯著衰減其絕對幅度但不消除其層級組織。機制上，作者提出由消除時機所主導的共享系統性離群值生命週期，PAS遵循局部「寫入-匯聚-消除」過程，而ISP對應延遲消除；在全注意力極限下，此觀點可還原全注意力LLM的穩定MA形態。此研究填補HLA LLM內部動力學理解的空白，並提供觀測其層級計算的新視角。
recommendations.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus
recommendations.title_zh: 混合線性注意力大型語言模型中的巨量活化：注意力前尖峰與尖峰間平台

links.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

evidence: Abstract: describes a survey of co-evolution in agentic systems with a progressive three-stage taxonomy
§2.3 Three-Stage Taxonomy: defines Agent-Agent, Agent-Environment, and Meta Co-Evolution
Limitations: states Meta co-evolution is early-stage and safety/governance are not operationalized
Appendix C: Figure 4 summarizes prior reported results rather than new experiments; within-paper matched comparisons are used
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical relevance to agentic systems, LLM agents, multi-agent self-evolution, and AI safety, though the paper is a qualitative survey rather than an empirical study. It proposes a plausible three-stage taxonomy and distinguishes itself from adjacent surveys, but provides no primary experimental results, baselines, ablations, or quantitative validation. Survey methodology and selection criteria are not sufficiently operationalized for reproduction; limitations are stated but safety and meta co-evolution remain unoperationalized.

primary_link.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

recommendations.summary: Agentic systems are increasingly expected to improve after deployment, yet single-entity self-evolution is often bounded by a static learning context, such as fixed tasks and feedback. This survey focuses on co-evolution in agentic systems, a multi-component form of self-evolution in which multiple agents and their environment impose adaptive pressure on one another. To organize existing papers, we propose a progressive three-stage taxonomy that traces how the system gradually sheds human-engineered constraints. Agent--Agent Co-Evolution studies how agents adapt through dynamic peers, including adversarial, collaborative, and organizational adaptation. Agent--Environment Co-Evolution extends this loop to adaptive tasks, feedback, and interaction spaces that change with the agents. Meta Co-Evolution further explores the possibility of making the evolution mechanism itself evolvable. We also discuss open challenges in evaluating such systems, scaling them across multiple components, and keeping increasingly autonomous evolutionary processes safe and controllable. This survey provides a unified foundation for building robust and open-ended agentic systems that can improve beyond fixed human-designed paths.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對代理系統（agentic systems）的共同演化（co-evolution）進行了首個系統性回顧，探討多個代理及其環境如何彼此施加適應壓力，形成相互塑形的演化迴路。作者提出一個漸進式的三階段分類架構，依序擴展演化自由的邊界：第一階段為代理與代理的共同演化，涵蓋對抗、合作及組織適應；第二階段將演化延伸至環境，包含任務、回饋與互動空間的共同演化；第三階段則探索演化機制本身的可演化性，邁向開放式演化。作者整理大量文獻，並以跨論文證據圖顯示共同演化在多數設定中能提升效能，但增益會隨演化趨於高原而遞減。文中亦指出動態評測、系統擴展與安全治理等開放挑戰。此調查提供了一個統一基礎，有助於建構能持續改進、超越固定人類設計路徑的強健代理系統。
recommendations.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
recommendations.title_zh: 代理系統中的共同演化：邁向超越人類設計的自主演化

links.title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks

evidence: Abstract/§5.2/Figure 1: pooled blind rate 0.383 for the gating model; 1,419 items (11.8%) answered blind in all 8 permutations vs 0.2 expected under Binomial(8,0.25).

§6/Table 3: on the 8,128-item Haiku-gated accepted set, GPT-5.6 scores 0.515 blind [.504,.526] and Sonnet 4.6 0.320 [.310,.330]; Table 4 shows habit-corrected excesses +0.265 and +0.081 as the only two in the set.
§6.2/Table 8: forced-key design where four accuracies sum to 1.0 under content-independence; observed sums 1.085 (Nova Pro, position-free 0.271), 1.427 (Sonnet), 2.009 (GPT-5.6).

§7/Table 10: same probe on LEXam four-choice split returns 0.228 [0.208,0.249] for both leaking models, upper CI below 0.250; §7 attributes immunity to reference-style options (longest 33 chars) vs self-contained propositions.

§9 Limitations: central claim 'rests on one bank and one gating model'; no human blind baseline; capability association rests on 11 models with blind axis compressed to a 0.032 band for nine of them (§6).

§5.1 reproducibility caveat: run 'seeded from Python's salted string hash' so gate selection is 'not bit-for-bit reproducible from the release'; Data and Code section releases corpus, gated subset, all sweeps and code at the stated HuggingFace URL.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): benchmark validity, contamination, position bias and shortcut learning across 13 LLMs from 8 vendors, matching the LLM (2.5), Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8), AI Safety (2.0), Prompting (1.5) and NLP (1.5) preferences; not Japanese-specific. Novelty is solid but derivative: the options-only probe and position-bias literature are acknowledged as existing (Balepur et al. 2024; Zheng et al. 2024); the genuinely new results are that model-based filtering does not transfer to stronger models (Haiku-gated set still leaks 0.515 to GPT-5.6), the forced-key estimator separating habit from content, and the format-dependence finding on LEXam. Rigor is high: 8-permutation binomial gating with honest caveats, independent dual-path extraction verification (0.9841 key agreement), Wilson intervals, McNemar tests, leave-one-out correlation stability, prompt/label/position/reasoning ablations, and negative results reported with underpowered n flagged. Evidence for the central claim is a direct demonstration with large effect sizes; weaknesses include shared-sample correlation of full-condition columns, 400/600-item sampling for some columns, and a capability correlation partly carried by two models. Generalizability is explicitly bounded by the authors: one bank, one gating model, two-benchmark format comparison, no human baseline. Reproducibility is strong (corpus, all predictions, 105,664-call logs, prompts, snapshot IDs released) but the gate selection is admitted to be not bit-for-bit reproducible due to salted-hash seeding.

primary_link.title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks

recommendations.summary:
Multiple-choice benchmarks are graded on whether a model picks the right option, not on whether it needed the question. Measuring that gap takes care: a model answering A to most items scores above chance wherever the key sits at A, and reads as recognition when it is not. We measure it on UA-JudgeExam: 11,990 four-option items with official keys, published by Ukraine's Higher Qualification Commission of Judges.
  Shown the options and no question, Claude Haiku 4.5 scores 0.383 against chance, a
recommendations.summary_zh: 多選題基準衡量模型是否選對選項，卻未衡量題目是否必要——模型能否只憑選項本身猜出答案。本文以烏克蘭法官資格考題庫 UA-JudgeExam（11,990 題四選項、官方答案鍵）量測此問題：僅呈現選項、隱藏題目時，Claude Haiku 4.5 盲測得 0.383（機率 0.25），且 11.8% 的題目在八種選項排序下每次都被盲答正確，遠高於隨機期望的 0.2 題；詞彙檢索法條僅能解 0.128，顯示洩漏來自選項身為完整法律命題的可信度判斷，而非逐字引用。作者以 Haiku 建立過濾閘門，剔除可盲答題目後保留 8,128 題，閘門模型自身盲測降至 0.204——但未參與篩選的 GPT-5.6 仍能盲答其中 0.515，證明針對單一模型清理題庫無法保護更強的模型。扣除各模型答案位置習慣後，十二個保留模型中僅 GPT-5.6（+0.265）與 Sonnet 4.6（+0.081）有真實超額；Llama 3.1 8B 盲測 0.292 純因 92% 的時間回答 A。被剔除的題目對十一個模型得 0.518–0.789，顯示閘門確實抓到真實洩漏。對照之下，LEXam 因選項是指向題幹的參照（最長 33 字元），同樣探針返回機率水準，顯示題目格式而非領域決定問題是否存在；重寫干擾選項則矯枉過正（0.168，低於機率）。限制為單一題庫與單一閘門模型的示範、缺乏人類盲測基線。啟示：以自含命題為選項的題庫應發布經習慣校正的盲測基線。
recommendations.title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
recommendations.title_zh: 對一個模型設閘、對下一個模型敞開：法律多選題基準的僅選項可解性

links.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

evidence: Section 2.4 uses token-count ratios as proxy for extraction fidelity
Section 4.1 reports 315,320 decoded reasoning blocks, 367 PII artifacts, 182 credentials
Section 5.1 acknowledges lack of ground-truth plaintext reasoning and unannounced provider changes
Reproducibility Statement states results are no longer reproducible after provider mitigations
Appendix C details provider-specific extraction templates
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM safety/reasoning/red-teaming paper. It demonstrates cross-model encrypted reasoning extraction with quantitative evaluations across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Novelty is moderate: it extends prior portability findings (ref 9) by using weaker decoder models. Rigor and evidence are limited because extracted traces lack ground-truth plaintext; faithfulness is assessed mainly by token-count ratios (Section 2.4, Figure 1), and the paper acknowledges unverified fidelity and patch-induced non-reproducibility (Section 5.1, Reproducibility Statement). Section 4.1 provides quantitative leak counts, but LLM-as-judge secret labeling is only partially independently validated.

primary_link.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

recommendations.summary: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different ses
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究揭露大型語言模型 API 的架構漏洞：提供者將推理軌跡加密後回傳用戶端，但這些加密區塊在不同的會話、使用者甚至模型之間均可互通，形成可擴充的解密通道。攻擊者可將受保護旗艦模型（如 Opus 4.8）的加密推理區塊注入較弱且防護較少的同系列模型（如 Haiku 4.5），使其逐字輸出原始推理內容，繞過蒸餾防護。研究亦在公開的代理程式日誌中分析 315,320 個區塊，成功還原個人識別資訊與憑證，顯示隱私外洩與提示注入等進階攻擊風險。作者於揭露後提出以使用者與會話綁定等關鍵密碼學緩解措施，並討論推理軌跡加密與監控的取捨。
recommendations.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
recommendations.title_zh: 從專有 LLM API 竊取推理軌跡

links.title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming

evidence: Abstract: PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances (2,594 single-turn tasks, 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns); experiments with eight LLMs; code released at github.com/oracle-samples/plsqlbench.

Section 4.3: GPT-5.4 achieves highest test Mean Test Pass@1 at 64.96%; Codex DB Agent improves Spider2 test Mean Test Pass@1 by 6.9-9.8 points (GPT-5.4-Mini) and 12.0-14.5 points (GPT-5.6-Sol); best model below 65% indicating headroom.

Appendix B.5: rule-based MBPP conversion validated by Oracle-backed replay (806/823 MBPP, 308/323 MBPP+ retained) and Python-PL/SQL behavioral cross-checks agreeing on 96.8% of MBPP and 89.7% of MBPP+ output-comparable records.

Section 4.4 / Appendix E.2: error taxonomy over execution logs attributes 11,015 failures (82.5%) to wrong procedure logic, 1,777 (13.3%) to invalid artifacts, and 566 (4.2%) to interface/schema grounding, with representative examples using Oracle diagnostics (PLS-00201, ORA-00900).

Appendix G: temperature 0.0, max 8192 output tokens, Oracle Autonomous Database 23ai serverless; Section 4.1 uses database-disjoint private test splits; Limitations notes read-only tasks, test-coverage bounds, and no benchmark-specific training set.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM code-generation/agent benchmark (Code 2.0, Agents 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Evaluation 1.8, Reasoning 2.5) evaluating eight LLMs and Codex-based tool-augmented agents on executable procedural PL/SQL. Novelty is solid but primarily as a new benchmark niche (first procedural-SQL execution benchmark per Related Work), largely by adapting Spider, Spider 2.0, and MBPP/MBPP+ rather than introducing new methods. Rigor is good: database-disjoint held-out splits, multi-stage quality control, multiple strict/partial-credit metrics, and replay/behavioral validation of the rule-based MBPP conversion; weaknesses are single-sample Pass@1 at temperature 0.0 with no variance or significance testing and brittle string-comparison for Spider-PLSQL. Evidence is detailed (per-model tables, quantified agent gains, error taxonomy with counts), though self-reported by an industry team. Generalizability is limited by Oracle/PL/SQL-only scope and read-only restriction. Reproducibility is aided by released code, prompts, and hyperparameters, but private test splits constrain independent re-scoring.

primary_link.title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming

recommendations.summary: We present PLSQLBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can write executable PL/SQL programs, with correctness measured through execution-based tests. Existing LLM evaluations largely target general-purpose code generation or declarative text-to-SQL, leaving procedural database programming underexplored. PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances: 2,594 single-turn tasks and 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns. The benchmark combines complex schema-grounded t
recommendations.summary_zh: 現有程式碼生成與 text-to-SQL 基準多聚焦宣告式查詢或一般程式設計,程序性資料庫程式設計(如 PL/SQL)長期未被系統性評估。PLSQLBench 是首個以執行為本的 PL/SQL 基準,含 2,865 個實例:2,594 個單輪任務與 271 段跨 978 輪的多輪對話,涵蓋企業級 Spider 2.0 資料庫、Spider 1.0 與 MBPP 衍生的程序題;任務皆為唯讀,以利重現。評估在 Oracle Autonomous Database 上實際執行,提供 Mean Test Pass@1(部分給分)、Suite Pass@1(全部測試通過)與多輪 Episode Pass@1。八個模型中,GPT-5.4 以 64.96% 的測試平均最高,Claude-Opus-4.8 與開源 Gemma-4-31B 緊隨其後;工具增強的 Codex DB Agent 可再將 Spider2 成績提升 6.9 至 14.5 個百分點,但嚴格指標下最佳多輪 Episode Pass@1 僅 41.27%,顯示錯誤會跨輪累積。錯誤分析顯示 82.5% 的失敗為程序邏輯或輸出錯誤,13.3% 為無效或不完整的 PL/SQL,4.2% 為介面或 schema 對接錯誤,後者九成集中於多輪情境。限制:僅涵蓋唯讀工作流程,正確性受測試覆蓋率限制,且未附訓練集,結果應視為泛化能力指標。

links.title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons

evidence: Abstract: introduces ComboShoppingBench for budget-constrained basket shopping with coupons and hybrid evaluation combining LLM judges and deterministic validation.
Table 2 (Experiments): reports pass rates across 22 configurations, with GPT-5.5 Think achieving only 61.2% Overall success.
Section 4 Failure Analysis: reports Think improves coupon optimality from 68% to 83% and identifies mutually exclusive coupon selection as a bottleneck.
Appendix G / Table 3: reports LLM evaluator agreement of 97.00-97.57% with an expert-adjudicated human reference over 700 rubric decisions.
Appendix F: witness independence audit reports 33.1% of Overall-success outputs use an entirely disjoint SKU set from the hidden witness.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool use, and benchmark/evaluation, with additional reasoning content. The paper presents a solidly designed agentic shopping benchmark with solution-first feasibility, deterministic constraint validation, 291 tasks, 22 agent configurations, and human-adjudicated evaluator checks. Rigor and evidence are strong, though novelty is benchmark-level rather than methodological and reproducibility is limited by unclear artifact release. Generalizability is moderate due to the simulated single-environment setting.

primary_link.title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons

recommendations.summary: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic ev
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出名為 ComboShoppingBench 的評測基準，用以評估大型語言模型（LLM）代理在需選購多項互補商品、並滿足預算與優惠券等條件之「組合購物」任務上的能力。此類任務涵蓋電子商務、外送／即時零售與混合場域，作者提出「先建立可行解（隱藏見證）再生成任務」的建構流程，確保每個任務皆有解；評測上則結合語意滿意度、規則式驗證（商品 ID、預算與優惠券合法性與最佳化）、回應品質與陳述忠實度等四個面向。實驗涵蓋 11 個代理與 Think／No-think 配置，最佳配置 GPT-5.5（Think）的整體成功率僅 61.2%。失敗分析顯示主要瓶頸在於跨項目關係之組合推理、互斥優惠券之最佳化選擇，以及陳述與實際結算結果不一致等。此基準強調從單一商品檢索邁向多步驟、限制感知之組合購物代理評估的進展，惟目前代理在此類任務上仍有大幅改善空間。

links.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment

evidence: Section 4.2/Figure 4 reports MMCS with 50K pretraining samples surpasses the image-level baseline trained on 600K samples.
Table 1 reports average 7.9% grounding gains over the caption baseline across RefCOCO/+/g and multiple LLM backbones.
Table 3 compares SEA, Patch Aligned, Text BBox and ablations of L_entity and L_LM under the same setup.
Appendix D.5/Table 12 reports multi-seed runs with one-sided paired t-test p=0.028 for general VQA improvements.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Relevant multimodal LLM alignment paper: uses LLM backbones, interleaves visual object tokens with text for object-level grounding, and evaluates data efficiency, grounding, perception and VQA. Novelty moderate relative to patch-level and grounded-caption pretraining. Rigor is strong via multi-scale comparisons, ablations, robustness and statistical tests, though general VQA gains are modest. Evidence is quantitative but self-reported.

primary_link.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment

recommendations.summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on image-text pairs for modality alignment pretraining, mapping global image representations to long textual descriptions. However, this image-level alignment suffers from referential ambiguity: models struggle to infer the correspondences between multiple visual objects and textual entities from the global representation, leading to data inefficiency and suboptimal semantic grounding. To address this, we propose MultiModal Cod
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出多模態語碼轉換（MMCS），一種新穎的預訓練範式，旨在解決多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在影像層級對齊上的指涉模糊性問題。傳統的影像層級對齊，讓模型從全域影像表徵推論多個視覺物件與文字實體之間的對應關係，導致資料效率低落與語意扎根不精確。MMCS 受到語言學上語碼轉換現象的啟發，將文字實體替換為對應的視覺物件，建構交錯的影像-文字序列，迫使模型在生成文字時直接依賴局部視覺特徵，達成顯式的物件層級對齊。作者開發了一套可擴展的資料合成流程，生成包含 773K 筆樣本的預訓練資料集，具備精確的物件-實體對應關係。實驗結果顯示，MMCS 具有極高的資料效率，僅用 50K 筆樣本即可超越以 600K 筆影像-文字配對訓練的模型，並在多種模型規模與視覺編碼器上，於視覺定位與感知基準平均提升 7.9% 與 2.1%。此外，特徵空間分析證實 MMCS 能達成更好的表徵對齊。然而，此方法目前僅聚焦於自然影像中的視覺物件，未來可擴展至圖表理解或場景文字辨識等領域。
recommendations.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
