links.title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity

evidence: Section 1 (contributions list): identifies and formalizes the curse of ambiguity, tracing it to architectural roots (Sec 3) and learning roots (Sec 4), validated empirically in Sec 5.
Section 3.1, Root 1/Eq (6): capacity ∝ hd/k, with Appendix A.5 giving a matching upper bound for any linear-softmax model via a sign-pattern counting argument (Warren's lemma).
Section 3.2/Root 2: embedding dimension must satisfy h ≥ 2k (Theorem 7, Appendix B via k-neighborliness of convex polytopes), with a robust variant h = Ω(k log(d/k)) (Theorem 8, Appendix B.3).
Section 4.1, Eqs (9)-(10): early learning slows as D_KL ≈ log(d/k) − t/k while late-phase loss scales ≈ k(d−k)/(td), i.e., linear in ambiguity at fixed t.
Section 4.2, Root 4/Eq (13): label-sampling noise creates an asymptotic KL floor of (k−1)/4k via an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck analysis (Appendix D).

Appendix A.6/Figure 6-7: empirically validates capacity scalings; learned head exceeds Hebbian by a constant factor 7–15, log-log slopes −0.77 (learned) and −0.97 (Hebbian) in k, and capacity grows ∝ hd.

Section 5.1/Figure 4/Table 3: iso-loss ablations on a 4-layer 4M-param transformer trained on 3-gram TinyStories data; increasing embedding dimension or optimizing full KL rotates the contour (helps large effective support size), consistent with theory.

Section 5.2/Appendix G.1: real-data analysis uses OLMo-2 13B as ground-truth proxy over 100,000 length-512 sequences from Dolma v1.7, evaluating OLMo-2 1B; authors explicitly flag both proxies as biased.
Appendix G.1/Figure 20: semantic context frequency proxy validated on the synthetic task with Pearson 0.86 / Spearman 0.92 over positions, dropping to 0.30/0.24 over distinct contexts.
Appendix G.3: quantified correlation of log KL with log effective support size at fixed frequency, R² = 0.37 (effective support) and 0.68 (raw support).
Appendix D.6/Figure 11: authors state they 'cannot resolve the precise early-time onset of the sampling gap' and only verify that the late-time gap increases with k.
Appendix G.2/Table 4: low-frequency/low-loss outliers explained by in-context copying (61% in-band bigram completions vs 11.2% elsewhere), acknowledged as a structural confound left to future work.

Code availability section: reproduction code publicly available at https://github.com/NicolasZucchet/Curse-of-ambiguity; appendices F-G give full hyperparameters, seeds, and learning-rate grids (Tables 1-3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-driven 'physics of LLMs' paper squarely in scope: it formalizes a 'curse of ambiguity' showing that more ambiguous next-token distributions need more capacity (capacity ∝ hd/k, Sec 3.1), larger embeddings (h ≥ 2k, Sec 3.2/Theorem 7), more optimization steps (Sec 4.1), and amplify sampling noise (noise floor (k-1)/4k, Sec 4.2). Strongly matches LLM, Training & Optimization, Scaling, and Transformer Architecture preferences. Novelty is solid but tempered: it explicitly sharpens known observations (softmax bottleneck of Yang et al. 2018, multi-modal failure cases of Chang & McCallum 2022, associative-memory scaling of Cabannes et al./Nichani et al.) into precise scalings, and the tools (Hebbian analysis, compressed sensing/polytope neighborliness, SDE limits of SGD) are largely borrowed, though combined cleanly. Rigor is high: matching lower/upper capacity bounds via Warren's lemma (App A.5), exact reduction to scalar gradient-flow dynamics (App C), and a careful Itô-based noise analysis (App D), with formal theorems and proofs. Evidence is strong in synthetic settings (capacity validation, log-log slopes −0.77 learned vs −0.97 Hebbian, App A.6; controlled ablations on a 3-gram TinyStories task, Fig 4/Table 3) but weaker on real data: the OLMo-2 13B-as-ground-truth proxy is circular, the semantic context frequency proxy correlates 0.86 over positions yet only 0.30 over distinct contexts (App G.1/Fig 20), and loss-vs-ambiguity correlation is moderate (R² 0.37 effective support, App G.3); the authors also concede they cannot resolve the early-time onset of the sampling gap (App D.6). Generalizability is argued (any network with discrete outputs) and partially shown (OLMo-2 1B/7B vs 13B, Fig 22) but not demonstrated at larger scales, and data structure (in-context copying, App G.2) complicates extrapolation. Reproducibility is good: public code (GitHub link), public data/models (TinyStories, Dolma, OLMo-2), detailed hyperparameter tables and seed/learning-rate protocols (Tables 1-3, App F-G).

primary_link.title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity

recommendations.summary: Large language models increasingly rely on sampling as a driver of their own improvement, making the fidelity of their learned distributions more critical than ever. Yet, not all distributions are equally easy to learn. In this work, we identify a curse of ambiguity: in large language models, and more broadly in all neural networks that produce discrete probability distributions, the more ambiguous a next-token distribution is, the harder it is to learn accurately. Through an extensive theoretic
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇 Stanford 團隊的論文提出「模糊性詛咒」（curse of ambiguity）：對大型語言模型乃至一切輸出離散機率分布的神經網路而言，下一個 token 分布越模糊（機率散布在越多 token 上），就越難被準確學習。作者從兩方面追根究柢。架構面：以 Hebbian 聯想記憶與壓縮感知分析證明，儲存支援大小為 k 的分布需要 k 倍容量（容量正比於 hd/k），且嵌入維度 h 至少需隨 k 線性成長（h ≥ 2k，透過凸多面體鄰接性理論證明）。學習面：以梯度流分析顯示模糊分布初期收斂速率慢 k 倍、後期損失隨 k 放大，且 token 取樣雜訊會抬高收斂下限（雜訊地板為 (k-1)/4k）。實證上，作者在 TinyStories 3-gram 合成任務與真實資料上的 OLMo-2 模型（以 1B 對照 13B 代理）都觀察到相同特徵，模型失敗模式為機率質量外漏至支援集之外。限制在於理論聚焦於線性輸出頭與隨機嵌入，而自然語料中的結構性重複（如情境內複製）也會干擾測量。此研究為理解 LLM 的統計能力提供新視角，並對 RLHF 後訓練與合成資料場景中何時可信賴輸出分布提出實用指引。
recommendations.title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity
recommendations.title_zh: 語言模型深受模糊性詛咒之苦

links.title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards

evidence: Abstract: 'We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability — a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite.'
Section 2, Definition 1: PAC-style definition of alignment learnability requiring finite training size m and finite inference slate size k under coverage condition Pr(r*(x,Y)=1) ≥ γ for π_ref.
Section 5.3, Theorem 2: explicit upper bound — k ≥ ⌈(1/γ)log(2/ε)⌉ and m ≥ C·(k²/ε)((d∨1)log²((d∨1)k/ε)+log(1/δ)) suffices via the pairwise tournament procedure (Figure 1).
Section 5.4, Lemma 4 and Theorem 3: necessity proof — with d ≥ 4mk² alignment-shattered pairs, any learner suffers test error ≥ 1/8 with probability ≥ 2/7 under γ=1/2 coverage.

Section 4, Examples 1–3: a reward class with infinite VC dimension yet d_ALN=0 that is learnable with zero samples; the learn-and-optimize (Example 2) and pessimism/Closure (Example 3) principles are shown to fail.

Section 3: detailed contrast with Joshi et al. [18], which is restricted to finite-cardinality reward classes and single correct response per training sample; this work claims complete learnability for arbitrary (infinite) reward classes.

Section 6.1–6.3: limitations acknowledged — slate-based training data, binary rewards, realizable case; single-response learning, preference labels, and KL-regularized prediction are left as open problems.
AI disclosure: 'the authors used OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol in the Extra High effort mode to make corrections, improve bounds, simplify proofs, and to help with writing.'
No code, data, or experiments are provided anywhere in the document; reproducibility rests solely on included definitions and proofs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure statistical learning-theory paper on inference-time LLM alignment with unknown rewards, squarely matching the LLM, alignment/RLHF, and test-time inference preferences. Core contribution is a PAC-style learnability characterization via a novel 'alignment dimension', with a matching upper bound (one-inclusion-graph pairwise tournament, m = Õ((k²/ε)(d + log(1/δ)))) and lower bound, plus instructive counterexamples ruling out ERM, learn-and-optimize, and pessimism principles. Proofs are complete and internally coherent, though restricted to the realizable case with binary rewards and slate-sampled training data; no empirical validation, single-response and preference-label settings deferred to future work; LLM assistance in proof refinement is disclosed. Strong theory contribution, modest practical reach.

primary_link.title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards

recommendations.summary: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak model) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong model that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probabilit
recommendations.summary_zh: 推論時間對齊是在不更新模型參數的前提下，於測試時從參考策略產生的候選回應中挑選優良回應，但既有理論多半假設已擁有良好的獎勵模型。本論文首次從統計學習角度完整刻劃「未知獎勵」下的推論時間對齊：將問題形式化為弱到強學習，參考策略（弱模型）只需以至少 γ 機率產生好回應，學習器則從偏好與接受標籤資料從零學習。作者提出獎勵類別的新組合維度「對齊維度」，並證明核心定理：一個獎勵類別可對齊學習，若且唯若其對齊維度有限。可行演算法先以 one-inclusion graph 學習器擬合部分成對比較函式，測試時對候選回應兩兩比較並以錦標賽規則選出勝者；樣本複雜度約為 Õ(k²/ε·(d+log(1/δ)))，其中 k 為候選數、d 為對齊維度。文中以反例說明 VC 維度與 DS 維度皆無法刻劃此問題，ERM、「先學習後最佳化」與悲觀主義原則均可能失效；下界證明則透過被打碎的成對偏好族建構。限制包括僅考慮二元獎勵、可實現情境，以及訓練時需多回應取樣。此理論為對齊建立系統性學習理論的第一步，並與可驗證獎勵的 RLVR 場景相容。
recommendations.title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards
recommendations.title_zh: 邁向未知獎勵下推論時間對齊的理論

links.title: Emergent Misaligned Communication in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent LLM Commerce

evidence: Abstract and Section 5.1.1: 12.58% of 2,583 emails classified misaligned, 95% cluster bootstrap CI [8.88%, 16.61%]; present in 20/20 runs and 59/79 (74.7%) agent-runs.

Section 6 / Appendix A: Stage A validated on a 50-email held-out set labeled by the codebook author, 92.0% raw agreement, sensitivity 0.571, specificity 0.977; Stage-A-scoped error-adjusted rate 18.7% [6.7%, 55.7%]; Stage B audit covers 46 claims across 15 emails.

Section 4.3 and Appendix F (Table 4): full three-stage pipeline replicated end-to-end with Gemini 3.5 Flash and GPT-5.6 Terra judges; Tier-1 agreement 93.3%/94.0%; per-model rate Spearman rho 0.98/0.87; three-judge union rate 16.57%, intersection 7.43% (Table 9).

Section 5.2 Table 2 and Appendix G Table 7: counterparty reciprocity OR 1.65 [1.25, 2.18], within-agent 1.42 [1.06, 1.89]; inventory scarcity OR 1.58 [1.09, 2.29] attenuating to 1.36/1.31 under replacement judges; horizon OR 0.895 per 30 days; revenue trend null OR 0.85 [0.28, 2.45].

Section 5.3.2 and Appendix F Table 6: capability rank uncorrelated with misalignment rate (Spearman rho = -0.07, p = 0.83; -0.11/-0.05 under replacement judges); dyadic capability-gap OR 1.04 (p = 0.91).

Appendix D: verifiable transfer promises embedded in misaligned emails enacted at 56.9% vs 31.5% for neutral emails; consistent direction across the four senders with >=5 promises per cell (sign test p = 0.063).

Section 5.1.3 and Figure 6/7: of 877 factual-claim emails, only 20.5% were immediately preceded by a check of at least one eligible claim; among false payment claims (n=137, all checkable) 73% followed a valid ledger read, demonstrating a verification-use gap.

Footnote 1 (Section 2.1): 'The Vending-Bench Arena is maintained by Andon Labs and not publicly redistributed'; access via Andon Labs research-use terms, limiting independent replication despite verbatim prompts (Appendix H) and codebook (Appendix I).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent safety research: measures emergent misaligned communication (false claims, collusion, manipulation, threats) among 13 frontier LLMs in a competitive multi-agent commerce simulation, hitting high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, AI safety, LLM-as-judge evaluation, alignment measurement). Novelty is solid but tempered: the Vending-Bench Arena environment is authored/maintained by a co-author's organization and Magentic Marketplace is a close concurrent precedent; the contribution is corpus-scale, state-grounded communication measurement plus follow-through and verification-gap analyses. Rigor is unusually strong for a measurement paper: deterministic claim verification against simulator logs, cross-judge end-to-end replication with two other model families (93.3%/94.0% Tier-1 agreement, per-model Spearman 0.98/0.87), cluster bootstrap CIs, mixed-effects and within-agent/conditional-logit refits, BH-FDR control, selection-targeted sensitivities, and honestly reported nulls (financial pressure, capability). Evidence is strong for the headline associations (reciprocity OR 1.65 [1.25,2.18] robust to within-agent estimation; low-inventory OR 1.58 with acknowledged attenuation under replacement judges; promise enactment 56.9% vs 31.5%), but the headline 12.6% rate rests on a classifier validated against a single codebook-author's 50-email labels with sensitivity 0.571, and the error-adjusted estimate has a very wide CI [6.7%,55.7%]. Generalizability is scoped to one all-LLM commerce environment and 12 paired models. Reproducibility is materially limited: the environment and corpus are 'not publicly redistributed' (footnote 1), though prompts, codebook, and analysis design are documented in detail.

primary_link.title: Emergent Misaligned Communication in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent LLM Commerce

recommendations.summary: Frontier LLM agents increasingly transact on behalf of separate principals, often using natural language rather than structured APIs. Much of the safety literature studies misaligned LLM behavior through adversarial-elicitation evaluations on single agents or stylized tasks. Its prevalence and structure in settings that combine long horizons, separate principals, real operational state, and inter-agent natural-language exchange remain insufficiently measured. We study 2,583 inter-agent emails fr
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型代理在長期競爭環境中是否會自發產生失準溝通,例如虛假陳述、操弄、勾結或威脅。作者分析 Vending-Bench Arena 中 20 次一年期模擬、13 個前沿模型所產生的 2,583 封代理間郵件,設計三階段分類管線:LLM 評審套用 12 類分類法;確定性驗證器比對模擬器狀態核實事實主張;再審視推理軌跡判定意圖。結果顯示 12.6% 的郵件被判定失準,出現於全部 20 次模擬與 74.7% 的代理執行個體,其中約 65% 為可驗證的虛假事實主張。失準具互惠性:收到失準郵件使回覆失準的勝算提高 1.65 倍;低庫存狀態提高 1.58 倍;但失準率隨模擬時間遞減。能力較強的模型並未更常剝削較弱對手,失準率與能力排名無關。值得注意的是,失準郵件內的轉移承諾反而更常被兌現(56.9% 對 31.5%),且多數虛假主張發生在代理未先行查核工具的情境,顯示問題在於未把驗證視為斷言前的步驟。限制包括單一標註者驗證、全為 LLM 對 LLM 的設定,以及觀察性關聯不證明因果。此研究顯示競爭性多代理環境中的失準溝通無需刻意誘導即可湧現,並與營運壓力及對手行為相關,對前兆感知的監控設計具實務意涵。

links.title: The Quality of Claude AI-authored Python Tests Is Not Weaker Than Human-authored Tests

evidence: Abstract: 'Using one-sided non-inferiority bounds, we find that the tests written by recent Claude models (Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and later) are no weaker than the two human-written corpora.'
§3.1 Dataset: 'Data, plus scripts to reproduce the tables and figures here, is available at https://github.com/doug-leith/claude-python-test-quality'.

§4.1.2 Table 2: historical-revert EFFECTIVE rates 96.6%/97.7%/95.4% (Extractor/Django/Pandas) with overlapping Wilson CIs; bootstrap bounds rule out Extractor being worse by more than 3.3% (vs Django) and 1.4% (vs Pandas).

§5: rubric scored by AI agents, but 'The defects in all tests categorised as having critical flaws are verified by human manual analysis'; §10.2 Figures 5-6 give verbatim agent instructions and a three-panelist critical-severity review.

§8.1/§8.2: Django/Pandas AI-taint check (recomputing with disclosed AI tests excluded 'changes the reported scores by less than 0.1%'); Extractor 'developed from scratch in a private environment, and has never been published' to rule out training-data contamination.
§8.3.1 Limitations: 'We make no claim that these findings generalise to other coding languages or AI models (e.g. GPT Codex)' — one language, one model family.
§4.2.1: mutation tooling pinned (cosmic-ray v8.4.6, PIT-derived operator set per Laurent et al. 2017); §4.2.3 candidly notes kill rate has 'no validated absolute scale'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical study of Claude-written Python tests vs human baselines is squarely relevant to the LLM (2.5), Agents & Tool Use (2.5: coding agent, autonomous agentic development), Code & Programming (2.0) and evaluation (1.8) preferences, though it lacks Japanese-NLP, reasoning/CoT, and alignment content, so preference relevance is solid but partial. Research quality is high: four cross-validating protocols (historical-revert, per-commit mutation, coverage mutation, seven-axis rubric), bootstrap one-sided 95% non-inferiority bounds, contamination checks on both the human baselines (disclosed-AI exclusion shifts scores <0.1%, §8.1) and training-data memorization (Extractor never published, §8.2), human verification plus a three-agent panel for critical flags. Novel elements: first matched per-test head-to-head, and a corpus built by fully agentic development where 78% of test-writing episodes were agent-initiated. Weakened by AI-agent-based rubric scoring (bias risk, partially mitigated), small critical-defect counts the authors themselves flag, and explicitly narrow scope (one language, one model family, §8.3.1). Reproducibility is good (public data/scripts, verbatim agent instructions, pinned tool versions) but Extractor's source 'has never been published', limiting full replication of corpus creation.

primary_link.title: The Quality of Claude AI-authored Python Tests Is Not Weaker Than Human-authored Tests

recommendations.summary: We evaluate the quality of Claude AI-written Python tests against human-written Python tests from two established open-source projects Django and Pandas. Hundreds of tests per corpus are scored under one identical protocol. Using one-sided non-inferiority bounds, we find that the tests written by recent Claude models (Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and later) are no weaker than the two human-written corpora. In this study: (i) the AI-written corpus is tests from real tools, not synthetic tests generated in iso
recommendations.summary_zh: AI 產生的測試是否可靠，直接影響 AI 輔助開發能否安全擴展。作者將 Claude 撰寫的 Python 測試與 Django、Pandas 兩個成熟開源專案的人類測試，在相同協定下逐一比對評分，規模為每個語料庫數百個測試。評估採用四種互補方法：歷史回退測試（還原測試所屬 commit 修掉的真實 bug，檢查測試是否失敗）、逐 commit 的 AST 變異測試、以覆蓋率引導的變異測試，以及七軸質性設計評分（意圖一致性、斷言強度、耦合、反模式等）。AI 語料主要來自 Extractor——由 Claude Sonnet 4.6 從零打造的真實工具（78% 測試是代理自主決定撰寫），並擴及 Quay 與 AWX 中 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 共同署名的測試。結果顯示 AI 測試不遜於人類：EFFECTIVE 率 96.6% 對 97.7%/95.4%，擊殺率信賴區間重疊，單側非劣性界線僅排除劣於對照組數個百分點；關鍵缺陷率僅 2.0%、3.7% 與 2.9%。限制為僅涵蓋 Python 與單一模型家族、缺陷基率低使統計力受限，且 AI 測試缺乏獨立審查流程。此研究反駁以往悲觀的 AI 測試生成文獻，且逐測試評分可直接定位需修正的個別測試，深具實務價值。

links.title: Q-First: Most of Attention Needs Only the Query in Disaggregated LLM Decoding

evidence: Section 1 ('What this paper does not claim'): 'No speedup is measured... what it buys needs two devices and a decode loop'; overlap demonstrated only via Appendix D simulation whose finish-time number 'is not a speedup this paper claims'.
Section 2: protocol verified end to end on a trained checkpoint to 4.2e-3 relative, runs on stock flash-attention kernel returning log-sum-exp; no custom operator or changed tensor shape.
Section 5: mergeable-aggregate identity verified with 200 random four-way cache splits agreeing to 1.4e-7.

Section 7: family A arms within 0.0011 bits/byte of control vs measured 3-seed resolution 0.0117; same runs resolve sub-layer exchange at 56x and shared-query arm at 91x; shared-query +0.1003 exceeds pre-registered +0.05 refutation threshold at every seed.

Section 6: converting a trained checkpoint fine-tunes W_q only (9.5%/9.1%), residual +0.0142 (Qwen3-0.6B) and +0.0088 (Qwen3-4B), reproduced across 2 seeds to 0.0003; stated as an upper bound since 'equal steps is not equal difficulty'.
Section 10: all figures are validation with checkpoint and learning rate selected on it; held-out test split moves gaps <=0.0094 (<=0.0020 in family A); 24 runs = 51 GPU-hours, each run 2.0-2.7h.
Section 12 Limitations: one model family, one scale, one corpus, 3 seeds at 3% compute-optimal; arrangement 'is verified, not built'; family gap -0.0623 reported but unexplained.

Reproducibility statement: all numbers generated from run records by script (unmeasured numbers raise build errors), pre-registrations under protocols/ with stated verdict thresholds; code at github.com/fan-wenjie/qfirst.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM inference-efficiency paper: a decode protocol for disaggregated serving in which the cache-side device receives only the query, enabling KV-sweep/feed-forward overlap without changing the graph. Strongly matches LLM, Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and Transformer Architecture preferences. The observation is framed with an exact re-bracketing identity (conjugation of shifted vs ordinary stacks, verified bit-identical), which is a genuinely neat reframing distinct from parallel blocks (GPT-J/PaLM) and from prior query-routing work it cites. Rigor is unusually high for a systems-adjacent paper: 8 arms x 3 seeds with all seeds printed, pre-registered refutation gates (+0.05 threshold exceeded at every seed by the shared-query arm), paired-difference statistics with a measured resolution band (0.0117), held-out test-split and overlapping-window checks, and identical measured parameter counts/arithmetic. However, the decisive practical claim is untested: no speedup, latency, or throughput is measured anywhere ('What this paper does not claim', Section 1; Section 12), overlap is only illustrated via a hand-checked 12-request simulation (Appendix D) that explicitly disclaims a speedup. Training evidence is one model family (Qwen3-0.6B from scratch), one corpus (WikiText-103, 372M tokens), 3% of compute-optimal; the null result 'moving the read point is free' is carefully bounded but is a null at small budget, and the conversion residual (+0.0142) is an upper bound at one budget on one corpus. Generalizability is limited accordingly, though the core identity is architecture-agnostic and forward-only probes on hybrid checkpoints are included. Reproducibility is strong: code released, every number generated from run records by script, pre-registrations under protocols/, cheap 51 GPU-hour campaign. Net: a methodologically honest, well-verified decomposition whose deployment value remains unmeasured.

primary_link.title: Q-First: Most of Attention Needs Only the Query in Disaggregated LLM Decoding

recommendations.summary: Disaggregated LLM serving puts the KV-cache sweep on memory-optimised hardware and the projections and feed-forward on compute-optimised hardware, then inherits from the decoder block a dependency neither device wants: attention runs first and the feed-forward consumes its output, so within one sequence each side idles while the other works. The usual repair costs one resident KV cache per extra sequence in flight, which is what motivated separating the devices at all. We remove the dependency i
recommendations.summary_zh: 解耦式解碼把 KV cache 掃描放在記憶體最佳化硬體,把投影與前饋網路放在算力最佳化硬體,但解碼器區塊內注意力先行,導致單一序列內兩側互相等待,通常只能靠增加並行序列掩蓋。本文觀察:上下文長度為 j 時已有 j-1 個位置快取,注意力的掃描其實只需要 query;只要讓前饋層先執行、query 提早存在,兩側即可並行,當前 key/value 之後再寫入,無人等待。作者以代數證明此重排等同於把層邊界畫在半個子層之外,是經建構性驗證的恆等變換;裝置回傳可合併的 softmax 統計量,cache 可任意切分、任序合併,兩張普通加速器即可依權重種類分工。訓練實驗以 Qwen3-0.6B 從頭訓練三個種子:提早讀取 query 等改動與對照組差異在 0.0011 bits per byte 內,遠低於種子解析度 0.0117;但自網路輸入投影所有層的 query 會增加 0.1003,超過預先註冊的否證門檻,顯示自由度僅限一個前饋層範圍。既有 checkpoint 僅微調 Wq(約 9.5% 參數)即可遷移,殘餘成本上界為 +0.0142 bits per byte。限制:未量測加速比,僅單一模型家族、規模與語料,收斂結果為上界而非實測;此分解為解耦式推論提供了近乎零成本的排程自由度。

evidence: Section 1.1 (Contributions): states detection boundary max{p+q, 2p+q−α}<1 (Theorem 4.1), discovery boundary p<α and p+q<1 (Theorem 4.2), and impossibility of classification within coordinatewise pivot-based rules (Theorem 4.3).

Section 3.2, Algorithm 1: SPOT scans tail thresholds τ(u)=1−n^{−u}, estimates an mFDR proxy T̂_n(u), and selects a data-driven threshold; Theorem 4.5 establishes adaptive boundary optimality without knowledge of p, q, α.

Section 5.2 and Figures 6–7: empirical phase-transition slices (200 Monte Carlo trials, n∈{10^2,10^3,10^4}) and heatmaps (500 trials, n=10^4) align with the theoretical discovery boundary {p<α, p+q<1}.
Section 6.1: LLM experiments use OPT-1.3B on the C4 news-like subset (1000 documents, n=400 generated tokens, context m=5) at temperatures {0.3,0.5,0.7,1}; baseline is AOL from Zhao et al. [61].
Table 1: at T=1, SPOT-oracle achieves IoU 0.347–0.376 and TPR 0.389–0.462 versus AOL's IoU 0.176–0.238 and TPR 0.254–0.301 across random/adversarial/translation edits under FPR ≤ 0.05.
Table 2: relative RMSE of the surviving-fraction estimator grows from ~0.25 at T=1 to ~3.4–4.1 at T=0.3, which the paper uses to explain SPOT-plugin degradation at low temperature (Section 6.2).
Section 1.3: 'The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/SHL20/WatermarkLocalization'; Appendices C–D document simulation pipelines, edit mechanisms, and tuning grids.

Section 7 (Discussion): acknowledges the fraction-estimation bottleneck, the batch-based design, that classification impossibility is restricted to coordinatewise rules, and that semantic/sentence-level watermarks remain open.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistical theory paper on token-level localization of LLM watermarks in human-edited (mixed-source) text. It is squarely in scope: it concerns LLMs (text authentication/detection) and AI-safety-adjacent robustness, not a pure domain application. Core contributions are new and substantive: a token-level multiple-testing formulation (Section 3.1), sharp detection boundary max{p+q, 2p+q−α}<1 (Theorem 4.1), discovery boundary p<α and p+q<1 showing discovery strictly harder than detection (Theorem 4.2), impossibility of classification within coordinatewise pivot-based rules (Theorem 4.3), and an adaptive thresholding method SPOT proven boundary-optimal (Theorem 4.5) and near-optimal in discovery power (Theorem 4.6). Rigor is high: full proofs in Appendix B, explicit assumptions (perfect pseudorandomness, geometric mixing, dominant–core–light vocabulary), and honestly stated scope restrictions (coordinatewise rules, Gumbel-max watermark). Evidence is solid but somewhat narrow: simulations (200–500 trials, multiple n and α) match predicted phase transitions (Section 5, Figures 6–7, 9), and OPT-1.3B/C4 experiments compare SPOT to the AOL baseline under FPR control across temperatures and edit types (Section 6, Table 1), with only one model, one watermark scheme, and one localization baseline (SeedBS excluded, Remark D.1). The paper candidly reports the plug-in fraction estimator's failure at low temperature (Table 2, relative RMSE ~3.4–4.1 at T=0.3). Generalizability is moderate: theory is Gumbel-max-specific, decomposition validated only on OPT-1.3B (Figure 3), and semantic/block-level watermarks are left open (Section 7). Code is publicly available (Section 1.3), with detailed parameter grids in Appendices C–D, supporting reproducibility.

In practice, however, the final text may be mixed-source, with watermark evidence surviving at only a subset of token positions after rewriting, insertion, deletion, or paraphrasing. Although prior work has studied global detection of watermark signals, when such signals can be localized remains unclear. We formulate watermark localization as a token-level multiple-testing problem based on pivo
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討當 LLM 生成的文字經人為改寫、插入或刪除後,如何在統計上找出哪些位置仍保留浮水印訊號。作者以樞紐統計量為基礎,將定位形式化為 token 層級的多重檢定,並為每個位置引入潛在存活指標。在以三個指數 (p, q, α) 刻畫訊號稀疏度、下一個 token 分佈集中度與有效詞彙成長的漸進架構下,論文導出三個推論目標的相變邊界:全域偵測可行需 max{p+q, 2p+q−α}<1;發現(定位至少一個位置且偽發現率趨零)需更嚴格的 p<α 且 p+q<1,證明定位本質上比偵測更難;而在逐位置座標式規則類別中,一致的完整分類於整個參數區域均不可行。作者進而提出 SPOT 方法:掃描尾部門檻、利用存活浮水印比例的資料驅動估計自適應選取閾值,不需知道任何指數或時變分佈即可達到最佳發現邊界,並在同類均質規則中具有近最佳發現力。模擬驗證了理論相變;OPT-1.3B 實驗顯示在隨機替換、插入、刪除與往返翻譯等編輯下,SPOT 的 IoU 與 TPR 多數情境優於基線 AOL,唯低溫生成下存活比例估計準確度下降成為瓶頸。理論限制於座標式規則與 token 級 Gumbel-max 浮水印。此工作為混合來源文字的浮水印定位建立了嚴謹的統計極限理論與自適應方法。

primary_link.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning

recommendations.summary: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation f
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）的一個安全性缺陷：當系統提示詞賦予模型不同角色或性格特質時，即使使用者請求不變，模型的安全決策（拒絕或遵從）仍可能大幅變動，此現象稱為特質誘發的安全變異。作者提出拒絕率指標與新指標：特質誘發偏差（TID）衡量整體拒絕率偏離無特質基準的程度，特質誘發翻轉率（TFR）則衡量同一請求在不同特質下決策改變的比例。透過表示層分析，他們發現特質會沿著低維度子空間擾動模型對有害請求的安全表徵。為解決此問題，作者提出特質不變性安全微調（TIST）框架，並實例化為特質子空間中和（TraSN），僅在辨識出的特質子空間內約束模型行為與無特質時一致。實驗顯示TraSN能降低TID與TFR、提升有害請求的拒絕率，同時維持良性請求的合規性與整體能力。局限在於僅涵蓋特定模型與特質組合，且依賴線性表徵與LLM評判。此研究凸顯特質在LLM安全性的重要性，並提供具體緩解方法，有助於提升模型在實際應用中的穩定性與可信度。

evidence: Abstract: 'Procedural anchoring accounts for 65.7% of skill cases, versus 4.5% for explicit knowledge injection, showing that skills stabilize action rather than inject missing facts.'

Section 5.5 / Table 4: actual-use precision falls from 29.6% to 3.3% as pool size grows 5→100 while averaged downstream success stays 36.4%–39.3%; Arm 3 recall remains 54.3–73.6% at k=100.
Section 3.2 / Appendix A.1: GPT-5.3-Codex 'no longer available under the same evaluation access when RQ4 was conducted', GPT-5.4 substituted; RQ4 interpreted strictly as within-pairing comparison.

Appendix A.8 / Table 12: lightweight compact-procedural baselines on 26 Terminal-Bench-2 tasks — Raw 50.0%, short plan 47.7%, test-first template 59.2%, Workflow Memory 62.3%, Skill 79.2% — controlling for 'any compact hint' explanations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for the highest-weighted preferences: an empirical study of LLM agent skills (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, retrieval/evaluation) using GPT-5.3-Codex/Gemini pairings, Terminal-Bench, and SkillsBench. Novelty is solid but not exceptional: the contribution is an analysis methodology (paired raw/workflow/skill triples) and a 12-mode taxonomy rather than a new method, though the finding that exact ground-truth skill invocation is neither necessary nor sufficient is genuinely informative. Rigor is strong: controlled composition grids, lightweight baselines (short-plan 47.7%, test-first 59.2% vs Skill 79.2% in Appendix Table 12), bootstrap CIs on paired deltas, human validation of the taxonomy (κ=0.952), and honest handling of the GPT-5.4 substitution in RQ4. Evidence is extensive (Tables 1, 4, 9-16) but mechanism attribution rests on an LLM judge with only ~3% human-coded coverage, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility benefits from full prompts (Appendix B), seeds, and metric definitions, but no explicit code/data release URL appears in the text and frontier-model access complicates replication.

primary_link.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't

recommendations.summary: Skills have emerged as a practical and effective approach for enhancing LLM agents at inference time through structured packages of knowledge. However, existing evaluations largely measure whether skills improve aggregated task success, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: \emph{\textbf{When do skills help, why do they work, and where do they fail?}} Through controlled experiments across various benchmarks, agent harnesses and LLMs, we isolate the effects of representation, outcome
recommendations.summary_zh: 技能已成為在推論階段強化 LLM 代理的實用做法,但既有評估多半只看任務成功率的總量,無法回答技能何時有幫助、為何有效、在哪裡失效。本文透過跨基準、代理框架與模型的對照實驗,分離表徵方式、結果標註、檢索難度與跨框架穩健性的效應,並結合配對軌跡分析:歸一化 8,135 筆試驗紀錄,對 240 條軌跡開放編碼,保留 238 個有效標籤,歸納出三大類、十二種技能使用模式的分類法。主要發現有三。第一,技能主要透過程序錨定發揮作用(佔 65.7%),而非注入缺失知識(僅 4.5%),在同源軌跡的配對比較中比 Workflow Memory 高出 6.06 個百分點,並減少環境設定、輸出格式與服務生命週期等執行層失誤。第二,檢索是獨立瓶頸:技能池從 5 擴大到 100 時,實際使用精確度從 29.6% 跌至 3.3%,語義易混淆的干擾項尤其損害離線辨識,但下游成功率相對穩定,顯示精確呼叫標準答案技能既非充分也非必要。第三,技能在假設脆弱、情境不相容或未經調整套用時失效,並引入誤用或忽略技能的新失敗面。限制包括只涵蓋終端與工具使用型基準、僅測試少數代理模型組合,分類法來自約 3% 的抽樣標註。此研究將技能評估從總量成功導向機制層次,對自演化代理的設計具指導意義。

Section 4.2 / Table 1: Evo-Harness best on all five benchmarks vs No Evolve and five baselines (e.g., TerminalBench-2 73.03 vs XSkill 66.29; CL-Bench 34.02 vs No Evolve 29.54).

Section 4.3 / Table 2: gains across five solvers (+3.7/+4.5/+3.8 for Claude Opus variants vs +1.1 Kimi-K2.5, +0.8 GPT-OSS on CL-Bench), with negative delta -2.5 for Opus 4.6 on EDS category, indicating unstable transfers.
Table 3 (Section 4.4): component ablations - Topic Only 33.70 vs General Only 30.28 on CL-Bench, reversed on SWE-bench Lite (66.67 vs 64.33), full method best (34.02/67.00).
Table 4 (Section 4.6): Self-Generated feedback drops below No-Evolve (27.96 vs 29.54 CL-Bench; 61.67 vs 63.67 SWE-bench Lite), supporting grounded-feedback claims.
Section 4.5 / Figure 5: Train-Split Transfer 73.4 vs Online-Updated 75.0 vs No-Evolve 68.8 on SWE-bench Lite with cross-model (Sonnet-evolved, Opus-solving) transfer.
Limitations: scope restricted to single-agent, text-based environments with natural-language harnesses; executable code skills not covered.
Appendix I.1 and I.3: ~$100K total API cost, results averaged over three runs, fixed seed 42; no significance tests or variance reported.
Appendix H: pipeline code and evolved skill libraries 'will release upon publication'; abstract code link is a placeholder, and evaluation relies on proprietary Claude models via AWS Bedrock.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper: self-evolving frozen LLM agents that compile one-shot execution contexts into general/topic skill harnesses, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, memory, and prompting preferences. Strengths: five diverse agent benchmarks with five solver models, five experience-based baselines re-run under one protocol, and unusually thorough diagnostic ablations (component ablation Table 3, feedback-level Table 4 showing Self-Generated feedback underperforms No-Evolve, solver-evolver pairing Fig. 6, train-split transfer Fig. 5), plus honest limitations. Weaknesses: the reflect-and-curate mechanism is an incremental refinement of known memory/skill/harness methods (AWM, Dynamic Cheatsheet, Evo-Memory, ACE, XSkill); no statistical significance testing or variance reporting despite small task sets (80 WebArena, 89 TerminalBench tasks) where a few points equal only a handful of tasks; several category deltas are negative (EDS -2.5 for Opus 4.6) showing instability; dependence on closed frontier models via Bedrock with ~$100K API cost; code release only promised upon publication with a placeholder link in the abstract, limiting reproducibility today. Quantitative claims are internally consistent across tables and supported by matched fail-to-pass case analysis, though descriptive rather than causal (acknowledged in Appendix D).

primary_link.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents

recommendations.summary: Learning from experience is critical for developing capable, self-improving large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods typically extract knowledge from accumulated trajectories via reflection, memory, rules, or skills. However, agents in realistic environments continuously encounter novel tasks, often offering only a one-shot opportunity to improve. These executions yield rich but highly noisy contexts, entangling broadly useful lessons with task-specific artifacts. Critically, prior wo
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 代理在真實環境中不斷遇到新任務，每次執行往往只有一次改進機會，產生的情境又高度雜訊。本論文提出「線上框架學習」（online harness learning）設定：凍結的代理透過持續更新一個外部結構化框架（技能庫）而非模型參數，在連續任務流中自我改進。所提 Evo-Harness 的核心是「情境到框架的技能編譯」：solver 在失敗或收到負面回饋後反思執行情境產生候選記憶，evolver 再對其篩選、合併、修訂，編譯為跨任務的 general 技能與局部 topic 技能兩層指引，供後續任務選取注入。在 TerminalBench2、SWE-bench Lite、CL-Bench、τ-bench、WebArena-Infinity 五個基準上，以 Claude Opus 4.6 為 solver，Evo-Harness 全面優於不進化基線與 AWM、Dynamic Cheatsheet、Evo-Memory、ACE、XSkill 等方法，例如 TerminalBench-2 從 62.92 升至 73.03。消融顯示 general 與 topic 技能的相對重要性取決於任務；有根據的環境回饋至關重要（自評回饋反而有害）；訓練分割學到的技能可跨任務與跨模型轉移，但線上更新表現最佳。限制為僅涵蓋單代理、文字型環境與自然語言技能。此研究把技能框架視為可分析的對象，為代理的即時學習提供系統性理解。

evidence: Abstract: 'AgentDojo exfiltration fell from 75-100% to 0% across all four domains; APC blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases' and 'utility was 8.6 and 13.9 percentage points lower in the two settings'.
Sec. 6.2, Table 4: 'Complete X reduces data stealing from 100% to 0%. Direct harm drops to 60.4%: the remaining cases are single-action attacks within scope that require parameter-level validation.'

Sec. 6.4, Table 7: 'Pair-weighted aggregate deltas across the 949 task-injection pairs are -13.9 pp under the strict condition and -8.6 pp under the interactive condition' (3 runs, std devs reported).
Sec. 7.4 Limitations: 'all benchmarks are synthetic, and no production-deployment data is presented' and 'the theorems are not machine-checked; mechanized proofs are future work.'
Sec. 6.4: compromised-model evaluation 'appends the ground-truth attack tool call after the first legitimate tool call, simulating full model compromise' - a simulation, not live model compromise.
Sec. 6.4 matched-protocol comparison: Progent 'reported here without a corresponding artifact in our repository, since redistributing it is outside our control.'
Appendix I: 'available at https://github.com/xmuruaga/bounded-agents' (implementation, evaluation harnesses, domain configurations).

Appendix D: latency measured on 'Intel Core i5-1245U ... mobile-class processor' with disclosed load sensitivity ('0.083-0.091 ms p50 ... 0.345-0.427 ms p99' under load), 0.24 ms p99 under no-load protocol.

Sec. 6.5: 'We design twenty-three attacks by an adversary with full knowledge of the model' - self-designed adaptive attacks, 23/24 attack variants blocked, session splitting admitted as documented limitation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-AI security contribution squarely matching priority topics (agents & tool use, AI safety, evaluation/red-teaming): a session-scoped authorization model (APC) with composition closure enforced outside the LLM runtime, targeting prompt-injection-driven tool misuse. Novelty is solid but not maximal: composition restriction is a coarse-grained action-type variant of information-flow control and separation-of-duty (acknowledged in Sec. 8), and adjacent systems (CaMeL, Progent, SEAgent) are credited; the per-hop blast-radius monotonicity and compromised-model evaluation methodology are the most original elements. Rigor is above average: explicit threat model (Sec. 3), conditionally-stated theorems with assumptions (Thm. 4.6, 4.8, Prop. 4.9), residual-failure taxonomy (Table 9), matched-protocol Progent comparison with an equivalence threshold, and candid limitation analysis (Sec. 7.4: synthetic benchmarks only, self-designed adaptive attacks, unmechanized proofs). Evidence is multi-benchmark (3,154 instances: InjecAgent 1,054; ASB 400; AgentDojo 949 utility / 609 compromised; 99 chain scenarios) with baselines and reported utility cost (-8.6 pp interactive, Table 7), though the 'compromise' condition is simulated ground-truth call injection rather than real model compromise, and the Progent-side figures lack a committed artifact. Reproducibility is strong: code, harnesses, domain configs, and latency run files are released (Appendix I, Appendix D) with model versions pinned. Score reflects high topical fit with real but bounded novelty and synthetic-only external validation.

primary_link.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems

At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文主張提示注入的安全性後果本質上是授權架構問題，而非單純的模型穩健性問題。LLM 代理人會代使用者呼叫工具、存取雲端服務或委派子代理人，但傳統存取控制以個別請求獨立評估，無法防範代理人在權限內組合多個被允許的動作以達成禁止的結果（如先讀取機密文件再外寄郵件外洩資料）。作者提出 Agentic Principal Chain（APC）模型：以工作階段為範圍的授權狀態，隨委派鏈傳遞並逐跳縮減範圍與預算，由模型外部的 PDP/PEP 基礎設施以六項授權條件強制執行，核心原語為組合封閉（禁止特定動作類型組合）與意圖綁定。論文證明爆炸半徑單調性與組合健全性兩項形式性質。在涵蓋 InjecAgent、AgentDojo、ASB 共 3,154 個評測實例中，受損模型評測下所有四個 AgentDojo 網域的資料外洩攻擊成功率從 75–100% 降為 0%，544 個 InjecAgent 資料竊取案例全數被阻擋，互動式設定的效用代價為 −8.6 個百分點。限制在於範圍內單一動作誤用與參數層攻擊仍需互補機制，且組合狀態不跨工作階段。此研究顯示授權架構可在模型行為之外提供可證明的安全保證。

links.title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation

Section 3 Definition 1 and Theorem 1 introduce the similarity equilibrium concept and high-similarity welfare bound.
Appendix B describes LLM parameters, OpenRouter queries, temperature 1, and sample size of 10 per decision.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, multi-agent cooperation, chain-of-thought reasoning, prompting, and evaluation; not Japanese LLM/NLP-specific. primary_link.title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation

recommendations.summary: As LLM-based agents with user-instructed goals are becoming widely deployed, they increasingly encounter each other in strategic interactions, and face challenges of finding mutually beneficial outcomes. Prior literature has argued that cooperation problems such as the Prisoner's Dilemma are resolvable in settings where agents know they follow very similar decision making patterns, as for example in monocultural AI ecosystems. Following that line of work, this paper introduces the first framewor
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個新興但關鍵的議題：當大型語言模型（LLM）代理在策略互動中，得知自己與對手的決策過程相似時，是否能促進合作。作者提出了一個評估框架，在各種合作困境（如囚徒困境、公共財遊戲等）中，提供不同程度的相似性分數給模型，並觀察其行為變化。主要發現是，相似性訊號對合作的影響因模型而異，多數模型會隨著相似度提高而增加合作率，但有些模型（如GPT）則不受影響。研究也發現，相似性分數的計算來源（基準測試）對合作影響不大，且模型傾向高估與其他模型的相似性。作者提出了一個行為賽局理論模型，能捕捉LLM在相似性訊號下的推理，並證明在高相似度下，均衡可接近最佳社會福利。此研究對AI代理的安全部署具有重要意義，但也揭示了相似性訊號可能被操縱的風險，需謹慎設計與應用。
recommendations.title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation
recommendations.title_zh: 大型語言模型會照顧同類嗎？相似性訊號可誘發合作

links.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

evidence: Abstract: 'AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success'; 8x fewer poisoned admissions than execution success.
Section 4.2 / Table 2: AdmitOR macro accuracy 58.35 vs 54.82 majority vote and 53.89 ground truth; paired bootstrap gain +3.53 [+0.87,+6.75], +3.49 after removing 85 anomalous items.
Section 4.3: preregistered K3 fails; realized FDR 15.9% (22/138), 95% upper bound 22.0%, threshold sweep flat at 14.7-16.5%.
Appendix B: preregistered criteria K1-K4 fixed before unblinding; panel pinned to DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Pyomo/HiGHS and gurobipy stacks.
Appendix C / Table 4: audit of all 22 disagreements attributes 15 to text missing decisive data, 5 to truncated precision, 2 to label errors, 0 to gate defects; audit is authors' own (Section 4.3).
Section 4.1 / Appendix C Table 6: host reproduction within 2.6 macro points; ComplexOR instance labeled 200 re-verified as 250, retained as error under preregistered protocol.
Section 5: acknowledged limitations - shared extractor E=1 invisible to consensus, coverage loss (recall 0.601), conditional guarantee on Assumption 1, single host backbone.
Abstract: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR'; Appendix C reports run ledger, call-level logs, and released case packets.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM-agent methodology: a label-free admission gate for experience-learning skill libraries built from LLM-generated code across three model families (DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 per Appendix B), touching agents, reasoning consensus, and evaluation. Although instantiated on operations-research modeling, the core contribution is language-model methodology (cross-family behavioral consensus over resampled value-function traces plus finite-sample FDR calibration), not a pure domain application. Rigor is strong: preregistered criteria K1-K4 (Appendix B), collect-once/replay-many judge isolation, paired stratified bootstrap, sealed-vault labels, proofs for Propositions 1-2, and honest reporting of the failed transfer criterion (realized FDR 15.9% vs 10% budget, Section 4.3). Evidence is concrete (precision 0.927 vs 0.871/0.726, Abstract; macro 58.35 vs 54.82 with CI [+0.87,+6.75], Table 2) but gains are modest, ComplexOR has n=18, the 22-case audit is authors' own, and the calibration set is 150 synthetic instances. Generalizability is limited by reliance on solver-exact candidates and value functions, single extractor E=1, single host backbone, and a demonstrated transfer failure. Reproducibility is good: public code/data, verbatim prompts, model pins, run ledger, and released audit packets. Novelty is solid as the first FDR-calibrated label-free admission mechanism, though it composes known conformal selection and self-consistency ideas.

primary_link.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

recommendations.summary: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate buil
recommendations.summary_zh: 經驗學習型代理人透過儲存已驗證技能來改進 LLM 最佳化建模，但真實工單串流不提供標準答案，而放行所有可執行模型會污染知識庫——在 300 題無標籤串流上約四分之一准入有毒。作者提出 AdmitOR 准入閘門：由三個模型家族在不同提示策略與求解器堆疊下產生候選，於從萃取參數域重取樣的多個實例上執行，以跨家族最大團彙整值函數軌跡的一致性，再以校準閾值回傳接受、棄權或上報，目標為名目 5% 的錯誤發現率並附有限樣本認證預算 2α。採用「一次性收集、多次重放」協定，四種評審重放相同日誌：AdmitOR 將准入精確率提升至 0.927（多數決 0.871、執行成功 0.726），並以最小的知識庫在五個公開基準上取得最高宏觀準確率 58.4，增益經配對自助法驗證。關鍵負面結果是校準的轉移假設在野外串流失效：實測錯誤發現率為 15.9%，審計將多數失敗歸因於基準題目文字未完整編碼其標註實例（如列印資料缺漏或精度不足），至少 10.9% 的准入題目無法由文字作答，並提出資料層冗餘作為必要條件。此研究首次以明確校準的錯誤發現率為目標設計無標籤准入機制，並劃定其適用邊界。

links.title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs

evidence: §2.2: DeepSeek-V3.2 judge validated against 100 human-annotated traces with κ=0.64–0.84 for four labels; two labels with κ<0.3 excluded from the scheme

§4.2: logistic regression on N=125,487, pseudo-R²=0.51, held-out PR-AUC 0.44 and ROC-AUC 0.98; overthinking OR=2.34 (p<0.01) is the strongest predictor while group assumption is not significant overall
Appendix F.1: overthinking effect remains significant after controlling for log reasoning length (length-independent OR=2.41, p=.003), addressing the verbosity confound
§5: BiasTrace prompt correlations with biased outcomes r=0.08–0.41 vs baselines r=0.01–0.19, generalizing to GPT-OSS-120B which was not used in scheme development
§6 Table 3: Maj-BiasTrace majority voting reduces bias (Llama3-8B: 13.36%→7.36%) and improves accuracy (66.27%→77.27%) versus Maj-All across four models from two families
Appendix I.1: structure-only prompt variant achieves r=0.46 vs full rubric r=0.73 on held-out n=87, indicating substantial gains come from task formulation rather than the behavioural rubric alone
Appendix E.1: pilot final κ=1.00 computed on the same 12 samples used to refine guidelines, a acknowledged circularity; hold-out human test set is only n=86
Limitations: English-only, open-source model families only, categories validated on BBQ structured QA, no claim of CoT faithfulness, and COMPAS demonstration limited to 500 samples
§2 and Appendix I: code and annotated dataset released (varsharamineni/BiasTrace), full judge/evaluation prompts and sampling parameters provided in Tables B.1, H.1, I.1–I.7
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences: an LLM reasoning (CoT) and bias/safety evaluation paper using LLM-as-a-judge, prompt-based methods, and inference-time mitigation on Qwen3, GPT-OSS, Llama, and DeepSeek models. Novelty is solid: BiasTrace annotates reasoning behaviours (overthinking, group assumption, out-of-context knowledge) beyond explicit biased language, with the counterintuitive finding that overthinking, not group assumption, is the strongest bias predictor. Rigor is above average: judge validated against human labels with κ reported and low-κ labels excluded, N=125,487 logistic regression with controls, a length-confound ablation, held-out generalization to GPT-OSS-120B, and mitigation tested on two unseen model families. Weaknesses: small human ground truth (n=86 test, pilot κ=1.00 computed on the same 12 samples used for refinement), very low base bias rate (0.72%) making PR-AUC 0.44 modest, correlations modest in absolute terms (r=0.38 on COMPAS), correlational rather than causal claims, structure-only ablation showing much of the gain comes from prompt format (r=0.46 vs 0.73), and scope limited to English and BBQ-style multiple choice. Code and annotated data are released with detailed prompts and sampling parameters, supporting good reproducibility.

primary_link.title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs

recommendations.summary: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 的社會偏見常透過隱性的推理過程產生,但既有研究多聚焦於最終輸出或明顯的偏見語言,忽略推理中細微行為的影響。本文提出 BiasTrace,一套細粒度標註方案,將推理軌跡中的行為連結到偏見結果,涵蓋偏見特定行為(如對族群的不當假設、偏見自覺)、後設認知反思、使用脈絡外知識,以及過度思考等類別。作者以經人類標註驗證的 LLM 評審(DeepSeek-V3.2)規模化標註,對 Qwen3-8B/14B 與 GPT-OSS-120B 在 BBQ 資料集上產生約 25 萬條推理軌跡進行標註。預測分析顯示,過度思考是最強的偏見結果預測因子(勝算比 2.34,在模糊情境下更強),而最接近傳統量測的族群假設反而未達顯著;高風險行為組合使偏見率提升逾 40 倍。將這些行為納入評估提示後,與偏見結果的相關性明顯優於基線方法,並在 COMPAS 公平性任務上有效標記影響群體公平的樣本(相關 r=0.38)。作者進一步示範推論時緩解:以 BiasTrace 篩除可能偏見的推理樣本後再進行多數投票,在四個模型上同時提升準確率並降低偏見率。限制包括僅涵蓋開源模型與英文、CoT 不保證忠實反映內部計算,且分類法發展自結構化問答情境,未必適用自由形式任務。此工作凸顯看似中性的推理模式也可能導致偏見,值得監測與介入。

Table 3 reports GPT-5.5 at 70.4% Dashboard APIs and 51.0% SEL APIs, with unanswerable policy queries as low as 2.4%

primary_link.title: VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies

recommendations.summary: Agents deployed in enterprise settings must reason across structured APIs and document collections, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. We introduce VAKRA (e\textbf{V}aluating \textbf{A}PI and \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{R}etrieval \textbf{A}gents), a benchmark of over $8{,}000$ executable APIs across $62$ domains with tasks spanning three settings of increasing difficulty: diverse API interaction styles, multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and multi-source rea
recommendations.summary_zh: 企業環境中的 AI 代理需同時處理結構化 API 與文件檢索，但既有基準多將這些能力分開評估。本文提出 VAKRA 基準，涵蓋 62 個領域、超過 8,000 個可執行 API，並設計三種難度遞增的任務：多樣 API 互動風格、結構化 API 上的多跳推理，以及結合自然語言工具使用政策的多來源推理。正確性透過重新執行預測的工具呼叫來驗證，並容許多種有效路徑。作者以固定 ReAct 架構評估多個前沿與開放權重模型，發現最佳模型在單跳端點任務僅達 70.4%，組合式 API 上降至 50–51%，隨推理深度增加效能衰退超過 50%，政策約束問題上甚至低至 2.4%。軌跡分析顯示失敗集中於語言中介推理，如實體消歧與跨來源接地，而非工具呼叫機制。此基準填補了複合式推理與政策遵循的評估缺口，對企業代理的可靠性研究具重要意義。

links.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/attention architecture paper with careful epistemic labels and machine-checked proof cores, but empirical support is single-group/small-sample and many key claims are conditional or conjectural; novelty is constrained by formalizing previously introduced PLDR-LLM/PLGA.

primary_link.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference

recommendations.summary: The Large Language Model from Power Law Decoder Representations (PLDR-LLM) and its attention, Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), replace the fixed bilinear form of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) with a learned, input-generated bilinear operator G_{LM}, built from a positive tensor A_{LM} by elementwise power laws. The architecture is fully specified, verified against pinned reference releases; claims are labeled theorem, conditional theorem, measurement, or conjecture. Unconditionally: PLGA contains SDPA exactly at G_{LM}=I; A_{LM} and A_P are strictly entrywise positive, with Perron-Frobenius structure on A_{LM}; the DAG regularizer has the NOTEARS walk-counting form and positivity obstructs exact acyclicity; and, under nonresonance (satisfied by standard rotary frequencies), a commutant criterion identifies which operators preserve relative-position dependence. An inference-collapse theorem: exact input invariance of deductive outputs collapses inference to generalized SDPA with a constant operator. Measured invariance: relative fluctuations of 10^{-6} and below; perturbation bounds quantify but do not certify cached inference; the assembled proxy misses the decoding margin. A conditional three-stage mechanism (rotary twirl, concentration, row-map contraction) is measured on a released checkpoint. Blockwise training and scoring under the global Gram are stated with explicit target exposure; on tested samples, block and sequential scoring select identical answers and agree on the published TruthfulQA probability-mass metric within 5times 10^{-5} per item. Self-organized criticality enters as a phenomenological framework with an intrinsic order parameter; open claims become falsifiable conjectures. Selected proof cores are machine-checked in Lean 4.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出冪律圖注意力（PLGA），將 Transformer 的純量點積注意力（SDPA）推廣為由輸入產生的學習式雙線性算子。作者首先嚴格定義架構，證明 PLGA 在算子為單位矩陣時精確包含 SDPA，並分析其 Perron–Frobenius 結構、DAG 正則化與旋轉位置編碼的換位子特性。核心經驗發現是訓練後的演繹輸出在推論時幾乎與輸入無關，可被快取為常數算子，但此不變性僅為測量假設而非定理；文中給出條件式崩潰定理與擾動界限，並檢驗其是否足以保證解碼位元一致性。作者亦提出自組織臨界性（SOC）作為訓練現象的詮釋架構，將臨界訓練與泛化連結，但強調此僅為現象學框架。本文的價值在於提供 PLGA 的完整數學描述，並明確區分定理、條件式定理與經驗觀察，同時坦言其侷限：不變性機制尚待嚴格推導，且實證僅來自單一研究團隊的少數訓練結果。
recommendations.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
recommendations.title_zh: 冪律圖注意力：純量點積注意力的精確推廣，以及推論時的經驗性崩潰

links.title: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons

evidence: Abstract: 'reduces the average attack success rate to at most 2.0% while incurring a utility drop of only 0.5% to 5.3% on MT-Bench, the smallest among all defenses. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Tripwire-65C4'

Method > Statistically Rigorous Identification Funnel: per-neuron Welch t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at alpha=0.05, utility-specificity filter excluding neurons with rho > tau_rho (default 0.5), and AUROC (Mann-Whitney) ranking with top-N budget
Experiment > Table 1: inference-mode TripWire (Large) achieves ASR 1.1%/0.5%/2.0%/0.8% with MT-Bench 4.68/6.48/7.36/8.14 vs TraceRouter 2.2%/1.2%/1.9%/4.9% with MT-Bench 4.19/5.59/5.92/7.35

Experiment > Table 1: edit-mode TripWire (Large) on Llama-2-7B has MT-Bench 4.31 and over-refusal 15.0%, below DELMAN's 4.53 MT-Bench, partially contradicting the abstract's 'smallest utility drop among all defenses' claim

Ablation Study > Table 2: probe-based selection (z=2.5) on Llama3.1 selects 17,234 neurons at MT-Bench 3.15 and 22.5% refusal, vs TripWire top-2500 with 2,500 neurons at MT-Bench 4.85 and 31.3% refusal

Experiment > Experimental Setup: four models (Llama-2-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-32B), attacks GCG/AmpleGCG/AutoDAN/Jailbreak-R1 on 520 AdvBench prompts, with GPT-5.4 as safety and utility judge

Method > Proposition 1: bias-patch (zero weight row, set bias to harmful-conditional mean) is proven mathematically identical to the always-on inference-time clamp; Ablation Study reports near-identical ASR/MT-Bench for both forms, consistent with the equivalence
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM safety paper on jailbreak defense via neuron-level intervention, touching LLMs, AI safety, alignment, interpretability, and red-team evaluation. Core idea (identify safety neurons, intervene) builds on NeuroStrike/SafeNeuron/TraceRouter/DELMAN; the statistical funnel (Welch t-test + BH-FDR + utility-specificity filter), trigger-style clamp rather than erasure, and provably equivalent bias-patch edit are useful but incremental contributions. Experiments are broad: 4 models, 4 attacks, 4 baselines, 2 neuron budgets, 2 deployment modes, plus a probe-based ablation (Table 2) that directly supports the FDR/specificity design. Weaknesses: no limitations section, no adaptive attacker, detector trained/evaluated on the same 200-prompt sets, no variance or seeds, LLM-judge-only ASR/utility scoring, and the abstract's 'smallest utility drop among all defenses' claim is contradicted in the edit form (Table 1: TripWire edit Llama-2 MT-Bench 4.31 vs DELMAN 4.53). Code released anonymously and method well-specified with equations, thresholds (alpha=0.05, tau_rho=0.5) and identification costs (79-92s).

primary_link.title: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons

recommendations.summary: Neuron- and path-level interventions offer the finest-grained route to defending large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, yet existing methods fall short of this promise, i.e., they often compromise model utility significantly. Specifically, one line of work suppresses toxic neurons to erase harmful semantics, but since such semantics are distributed across the network, blocking every pathway forces a large intervention footprint. An alternative line of research focus on identify
recommendations.summary_zh: 針對越獄攻擊的神經元級防禦常面臨安全與效用的取捨:抹除式方法須封鎖散布全網路的危害語義,足跡龐大;基於外部分類器的安全神經元篩選難以區分安全專屬與一般重要神經元;且多數干預常駐生效,即使無攻擊也擾動正常請求。本文提出 Tripwire,一個免訓練防禦。首先以統計嚴謹的篩選漏斗識別安全專屬神經元:方向過濾、逐神經元 Welch t 檢定並以 Benjamini–Hochberg 控制偽發現率,再加上效用專屬性過濾排除同樣強烈作用於一般任務的神經元,最後依 AUROC 排序選取前 N 個。接著以觸發式鉗制將選定神經元固定在其有害條件平均激活值,持續注入「當前輸入有害」的內部訊號,觸發模型在對齊階段習得的拒答行為。此鉗制有兩種理論上等價的部署模式:由輕量偵測器門控的推論期干預,以及離線的偏置補丁權重編輯。在 Llama-2-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B/32B 上對抗 GCG、AmpleGCG、AutoDAN、Jailbreak-R1 四種攻擊,Tripwire 在 top-2500 神經元預算下將平均攻擊成功率壓至約 2% 以下,MT-Bench 效用下降僅 0.5%–5.3%,為所有防禦中最小;消融實驗顯示其篩選法優於探針法,後者需 3–5 倍神經元且效用損失可達 52.3%。安全神經元集中於中上層,印證危害偵測由高層語義表徵中介。此方法證明精確識別結合觸發式干預可實現低成本的實用神經元級防護。

links.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction

evidence: Abstract: QUASAR achieves lowest held-out KL among competitive QAT methods at 2/3/4 bits, reducing KL by ≥10% at 3–4 bits and 29% at 2 bits, and +3.5–4.3 pts average accuracy at 2 bits.

Section 5, Theorem 1 and Corollary 1: the loss-aware reconstruction error is the only reconstruction-dependent term in the QAT convergence bound and, under a PL condition, bounds the final quantized model's loss.
Section 4.1.1: saliency is the diagonal Fisher proxy reused from AdamW's second moment with no extra memory; Section 4.1 notes the method reduces to Denoising QAT when F={1} and h≡1.
Section 6.5, Table 5: ablations show scale search is the main driver (−34.7% KL alone) versus initialization-only application (−1.6%), and Adam weighting matches a separate Fisher estimate.
Section 6.5, Table 6: wall-clock breakdown shows QUASAR adds only +1.4% training step time over Standard QAT.
Section 6.3, Table 3: at INT2 adaptation, QUASAR reaches 29.6 avg math accuracy, 10.9 pts above the strongest QAT baseline, and is the only INT2 arm above zero on HMMT'25.
Section 6.1: fidelity evaluation uses only 128 held-out samples for KL/top-1, and the INT2 LLM-judge study (Figure 6, Table 8) uses 128 WildChat prompts with bootstrap CIs.
Appendix A.2: INT2 comparison repeated under plain SGD confirms the ordering is not an AdamW artifact; Appendix A.3 shows H-weighting beats H²-weighting in all six comparisons.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM efficiency paper (quantization-aware training for Qwen3/Llama) squarely within scope, with a clean theoretical story (reconstruction error as the only reconstruction-dependent term in the QAT convergence bound), strong baselines (LSQ, Denoising QAT, BitDistiller, GPTQ, AWQ), thorough ablations, overhead measurement, and consistent quantitative gains (INT2 avg accuracy +3.5–4.3 pts; math adaptation +10.9 pts). Novelty is incremental: the method reduces to Denoising QAT under fixed range/uniform saliency (Section 4.1), combining GPTQ-style loss-aware objectives with Adam second-moment saliency and closed-form least-squares fits. Weaknesses: theory analyzes SGD while main experiments use AdamW (though Appendix A.2 validates ordering under SGD), PL/curvature assumptions are strong, fidelity metrics use only 128 held-out samples and the judge study 128 prompts, models are modest scale (4B–9B), and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction

recommendations.summary: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT computes the loss and surrogate gradients using a lossy reconstruction of latent full-precision weights, while applying updates to the latent weights themselves. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods mitigat
recommendations.summary_zh: 量化感知訓練讓模型在低位元精度下學習,但其最佳化存在結構性錯配:前向傳播與損失使用有損的重構權重,最佳化器卻更新潛在的全精度權重,導致訓練軌跡次佳與較高的損失下限。二階後訓練量化方法會最小化損失感知重構誤差,但對凍結模型計算一次需數小時,難以在訓練中反覆執行。本文提出 QUASAR,在訓練迴圈內持續進行輕量的損失感知重構:以平方梯度之指數移動平均作為線上顯著性估計(可直接重用 AdamW 的第二動量),搜尋一組候選裁剪範圍以改變整數碼分配,並對每種分配以顯著性加權最小平方法的閉式解擬合反量化參數,選出重構誤差最小者。理論上,作者將 QAT 收斂界分解為初始化、迷你批次雜訊與損失感知重構誤差三項,其中僅最後一項依賴重構映射,且在 PL 條件下控制最終量化模型的損失。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3 與 Llama-3.1,在 INT2/3/4 與 NVFP4 的量化感知蒸餾中,QUASAR 於所有設定達到最低的 held-out KL:3、4 位元至少降低 10%,2 位元降低 29%;2 位元時八項任務平均準確率較強基線高 3.5–4.3 個百分點;數學適應實驗中在五個數學基準上領先至少 10.9 分,訓練步時間僅增加約 1.5%,無推論開銷。理論分析基於 SGD 而主實驗使用 AdamW,作者已另以 SGD 實驗佐證結論一致。此工作顯示重構本身即是 QAT 品質的直接槓桿。

evidence: Abstract: 'providing diverse documents is highly beneficial, improving answer correctness by 17%–47%'; duplicate redundancy and LLM paraphrasing 'does not significantly improve answer correctness'

Table 2: Diverse at k=5 significantly above baseline (McNemar p<0.01) for all four generators; §4.2 reports gains 0.240 (1B), 0.173 (3B), 0.152 (8B), 0.112 (12B), decreasing with model scale

§4.3 / Table 4: on the 252-query screened set (answer string absent), Diverse rises 0.496→0.647 vs 0.417 baseline while Duplicate/Paraphrase never differ significantly
§3.2: screened queryset removes contiguous string matches and stemmed-window near matches of the gold answer

Table 6: genre stratification shows encyclopedia 0.701–0.846 vs social media 0.372–0.619 pooled correctness (χ² p ≤ 2.8e-17), indicating genre quality is a confound the diversity interpretation does not fully isolate
§3.3–3.4: generators are Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Gemma-3-12B-IT; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct serves as both paraphrase generator and LLM judge

Closing section: 'Code and results are provided in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rag-redunancy-C8BC'; §3.1 states 2,756 de-duplication clusters built from 6,541 questions, main analysis on 1,900 five-genre queries
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/RAG methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (RAG & Knowledge, LLMs, prompting/in-context evidence, QA evaluation) — not a pure domain application. Strengths: unusually careful controlled design (duplicate vs paraphrase vs diverse evidence sets, k=0–5 sweep), parametric prior controlled via fictional facts with near-zero closed-book accuracy (0.017–0.040, Table 2), answerability verification, question de-duplication, a screened queryset removing string/near answer matches (§3.2, §4.3), metric validation of the LLM judge against exact match/F1/recall (§3.4), and paired McNemar tests at p<0.01 on identical 1,900-query sets. Key finding — diverse genre-spanning documents raise correctness 0.112–0.240 while duplicates/paraphrases do not (Tables 2–3), surviving answer-string screening (Table 4) — is well supported within the design. Weaknesses: novelty is incremental, combining known perturbation paradigms (CUE-R, GroupQA, Schuster et al.) with new controls; the decisive confound is not fully disentangled — diverse sets guarantee genre mixing and Finding 4 shows encyclopedia docs vastly outperform social media (0.701–0.846 vs 0.372–0.619), so gains may partly reflect guaranteed inclusion of easier genres rather than diversity per se (no same-genre diverse or all-encyclopedia control); the judge (Qwen2.5-32B) is also the paraphrase generator, and single-source paraphrases score significantly below baseline, handicapping that condition; headline claims rest on a synthetic fictional dataset with hand-constructed (not real-retriever) evidence sets and only open models up to 12B, with the diverse gain shrinking as scale grows (0.240→0.112), limiting generalizability to frontier models and real retrieval noise. Reproducibility is good: code/results in an anonymous repo, all prompts shown, model versions and decoding parameters specified, public FictionalQA source.

primary_link.title: How retriever redundancy and diversity impact RAG effectiveness

This paper investigates how redundancy and diversity from the retrieved document set impact the generator in terms of answer correctness.
  Previous work has provided a mix of findings: some showing that redundancy improves generation by reinforcing relevant information, others that LLM-based paraphrasing of the sa
recommendations.summary_zh: 在 RAG 系統中,檢索器通常逐篇文件依與查詢的相關性排序,但生成器是把檢索到的文件整體作為輸入;冗餘與多樣性對答案正確性的影響因此尚無定論。既有研究常未控制混淆因素,例如文件是否確實含答案,或模型參數化知識的干擾。本文以 FictionalQA——一個關於虛構事件、確保模型無法從預訓練知識作答的合成問答資料集——進行嚴格控制實驗,比較三種證據集:重複(同一文件複製 k 份)、改寫(LLM 改寫同一文件的 k 個版本)與多樣(來自五種文體、各含相關資訊的不同文件),並以篩選後的查詢集排除任何明確含答案字串或近似重述的文件。結果顯示:純冗餘或改寫對答案正確性幾乎無顯著改善;而多樣文件帶來大幅增益,隨 k 增加單調上升,相對提升正確率 17%–47%,且此增益在排除明確答案字串後依然成立,證明源自文體多樣性本身而非更精確的答案表述。消融分析進一步顯示文體本身影響正確率:百科式文件最高,社群媒體最低。限制包括設定為短答題、使用合成資料與固定提示,實際檢索器的產出分佈未完全模擬。此研究建議 RAG 的檢索與重排應明確選擇多樣、獨立的文件,而非填入措辭近似的排名最前段落,對多樣性感知檢索的研究方向具啟發。

links.title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics

evidence: Abstract: APTER improves mathematics and medical macro-averages over base models by up to 15.86 and 8.04 points across three Qwen generations; code and rubric datasets released at github.com/AntDT-APTER/APTER.git
Table 1 (§4.2.1): Qwen3-8B AIME24 23.33→49.15 (+25.82); Qwen2.5-7B HealthBench 31.95→49.91 (+17.96); MedQA/MedMCQA gains much smaller, consistent with open-ended rubric design claims

Table 2 (§4.2.2): Block B rubric reward AIME24 41.63 vs ORM 37.75; Block C query-level 50.54 vs generic criteria 47.84 on HealthBench; Block D expert-grounded 41.63 vs framework-free 32.98; Block E refined rubrics add 2.36–4.96 points

§4.1: 'Main medical runs... select checkpoints on HealthBench-500, a fixed random subset of 500 HealthBench examples' while Table 1 reports the full 5,000-item set — checkpoint selection overlaps the reported test set
§A.5 'Randomness and number of runs': 'Each model–domain–method entry has one independent random-seed run... We therefore do not report across-run standard deviations'

§3.3.3 and Algorithm 1: Ada-IFT increments persistent criterion counters when step failure rate ≥ ρ_step and triggers targeted SFT at τ_trig, distinguishing it from difficulty-triggered interleaving (ReLIFT) cited in §2
Figure 4 (§4.2.2): criterion failure-rate AUC reductions of 32%, 19%, 32% on three randomly selected criteria only — limited statistical support for the repair mechanism

Appendix B and Tables 4–7: full prompt templates, criteria hierarchies (103 math leaf criteria, 50 medical criteria), and refiner statistics (avg rubrics 4.82→4.09) support reproducibility; training judges are proprietary Qwen3.7-Plus and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (§4.1, Table 6)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core-LLM post-training paper (rubric-grounded RL rewards plus criterion-triggered SFT repair) squarely matching the highest-weight preferences: LLMs, reasoning/CoT, alignment & RLHF, and LLM-as-judge evaluation; the medical QA half is a testbed for the language methodology, not a pure domain application, so it stays in scope. Novelty is moderate-to-good: rubric-as-reward and interleaved RL-SFT both exist, but retaining expert criterion IDs to aggregate failures across queries and trigger targeted repair (Ada-IFT, §3.3.3, Algorithm 1) is a genuine, well-motivated twist. Rigor is solid but not airtight: five controlled ablation blocks (Table 2) isolate reward type, granularity, provenance, and refinement, and full hyperparameters are given (Table 6), yet each entry uses a single random-seed run with no variance (§A.5), checkpoint selection uses a fixed 500-item subset of the reported HealthBench set (§4.1), and all judges are proprietary Qwen models with no human-verified final-output evaluation beyond a 4-case calibration study (Appendix C.1). Evidence strength tracks the ablations and main tables (e.g., rubric reward 41.63 vs ORM 37.75 on AIME24; expert-grounded 41.63 vs framework-free 32.98), but the Ada-IFT repair-dynamics evidence rests on only three 'randomly selected' criteria (Fig. 4). Generalizability is demonstrated across two domains and three Qwen generations, but only one model family and expert-framework construction costs (physicians, doctoral students, §A.4) may limit transfer. Reproducibility is above average: code/rubric release claimed (Abstract), complete configs, prompt templates (Appendix B), and released criteria hierarchies (Tables 4-5), tempered by proprietary judge models and unverifiable expert artifacts.

primary_link.title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics

recommendations.summary: As large language models enter professional domains, they must satisfy domain constraints, include critical evidence, and provide complete reasoning rather than merely produce fluent responses. Existing post-training methods often rely on holistic preferences or outcome-level verification, while recent rubric-based methods usually generate rubrics independently for each query. In specialized domains, such unconstrained rubrics may omit critical requirements and vary across samples, hindering the
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 進入醫療、數學競賽等專業領域後,需滿足領域約束、涵蓋關鍵證據並提供完整推理,而現有後訓練方法多依賴整體偏好或結果級驗證;近年評分準則法又常為每個查詢獨立產生準則,易遺漏關鍵要求且難以跨樣本診斷持續性能力缺陷。本文提出 APTER 框架:首先由領域專家建立可重用的準則框架(數學 7 個子領域、103 個葉準則;醫療 50 個準則),為每個查詢路由相關準則並實例化為可執行的查詢級評分項,保留準則 ID 以供跨查詢聚合。其次,自適應後訓練將評分判定同時作為最佳化與診斷訊號,支援 Rubric RL、基於評分的 SFT 與 Ada-IFT:後者以準則層級失敗率統計識別持續性缺陷,當計數器達到觸發門檻時暫停 RL、針對該準則執行定向 SFT 修復,再回到 RL。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B 與 Qwen3.5-9B 三代模型上,APTER 使數學宏平均較基準提升 6.13–15.86 分(如 Qwen3-8B 的 AIME 24 提升 25.82 分),醫療提升 5.19–8.04 分(HealthBench 提升最高 17.96 分)。消融顯示評分獎勵優於結果驗證、查詢級準則優於通用準則、專家扎根優於無框架準則,Auditor–Refiner 精煉階段亦帶來一致增益。限制包括準則框架在單次訓練期間固定、每個設定僅單一隨機種子運行,且依賴 LLM 評審的可靠性。此框架將領域評估與定向改進串接,使後訓練更貼合專業需求。
