Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect in
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 FaithformBench 基準，用以評估自動形式化（AF）系統將自然語言推理步驟轉譯為 Lean 形式陳述時的忠實度。有別於仰賴人工標註或 LLM 評判的既有方法，此方法自動產生微擾步驟，使其成為無效推論，並分別衡量「有效性保持」與「無效性保持」，藉此偵測錯誤誘導與靜默修正兩種失敗模式。作者以 ProcessBench 的四個數學資料集為基礎，建構 12,784 組原始與微擾推理步驟，並評估四個微調 AF 模型（Goedel、Herald、Kimina、Stepfun）及四個通用 LLM（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen Plus）。結果顯示微調模型普遍存在「諂媚」行為，會靜默修正錯誤輸入；且有效性保持能力越佳者，靜默修正傾向也越高。通用模型則表現出較低的靜默修正率。此方法無法偵測語意漂移，且仰賴證明器效能，因此建議作為輔助診斷工具。
recommendations.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
recommendations.title_zh: FaithformBench：數學鏈式思考自動形式化的忠實度基準測試

links.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts

evidence: Section 3.2 defines the Mixture of Role-Subtask LoRA Experts with prototype-based semantic router.
Section 3.3 defines hierarchical GRPO with two-layer credit assignment and Proposition 3.1.
Section 4 Experiment reports SRDD and SciCode results across Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemma-4-31B.
Appendix I Implementation Details provides hyperparameters, LoRA rank 8, Ks=4, B=4, M=4, and learning rates.
Appendix J Detailed Experimental Analysis includes budget-accounted trained comparisons and execution-verified evaluation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: LLM-based multi-agent systems, Mixture of LoRA experts, hierarchical GRPO/RL, transformer parameter-efficient adaptation, and code generation. Novelty is moderate: combines existing DAG-based MAS, MoE-LoRA, and GRPO with a dual role/subtask factorization and two-layer credit assignment, but is incremental over recent MoE-GRPO and multi-agent RL work. Rigor and evidence are moderate: extensive ablations, OOD tests, budget accounting, formal variance-reduction analysis, and an execution-verified evaluation, but most results are single-seed, trained comparisons are confined to held-out test splits, and evaluation is limited to code-generation benchmarks. Reproducibility is high due to detailed hyperparameters, algorithm pseudocode, and code availability.

primary_link.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts

recommendations.summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for complex, long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods mainly rely on coarse prompt-level differentiation without parameter adaptation for diverse subtasks, resulting in insufficient inter-agent heterogeneity and limited specialized capability that bottleneck performance on tasks with complex requirements. To address this, we introduce a Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts (M
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 MoRSE，旨在解決大型語言模型多代理系統在複雜長期任務中，因僅依賴提示層級角色區分而導致的代理間異質性不足與專精能力受限問題。MoRSE 從任務結構與參數兩個層級同時強化代理特化：首先，透過任務導向的多代理框架，將任務分解為具依賴性的有向無環圖子任務，並為每個代理賦予明確的 (角色, 子任務) 責任。其次，採用動態的 (角色, 子任務) LoRA 專家混合模組，搭配原型式語意路由器，以低成本實現參數層級的特化。為穩定地共同最佳化專家與路由器，作者提出具雙層信用分配的階層式群體相對策略最佳化，隔離專家與路由器的更新，降低梯度變異。實驗於程式碼生成基準上驗證，MoRSE 在整體任務與逐步指標上均優於基線，且學到的特化可泛化至未見任務類別。
recommendations.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts
recommendations.title_zh: MoRSE：具備角色-子任務專家混合之任務導向多代理系統

links.title: Knowing When to Stop: Bayesian Optimal Stopping for LLM Evaluations

evidence: Abstract: 'removes 57%-97% of planned trials across nine validation settings, with overall conclusions equivalent to the full run'
Section 3.1: 'the mean absolute score deviation between full-run and truncated estimates was 0.006 on a normalised [0,1] scale, with a mean efficiency gain of 81.1%'
Section 3.2: 'The estimate is mu-hat = +0.0003 with a 97% HDI of [-0.002, +0.003] - entirely contained within the ROPE of +/-0.02, yielding a clear accept-null verdict'
Section 4: 'represents a single experimental configuration - broader replication across evaluation contexts, scale sizes, and grouping structures would strengthen confidence'
Appendix B.6: 'empirical coverage of approximately 80% at 94% nominal for the hierarchical binary model under moderate heterogeneity'; Beta-Binomial produced '120-9,206x more MCMC divergences'
Appendix B.10: ordinal CI coverage '0/15 (low), 12/15 (mid), and 1/15 (high)' attributed to modal-vs-mean estimand mismatch
Appendix B.11: conservatism validation shows c=1 permits premature stopping at 120 trials with overestimate (0.027 vs true 0.0065) while c=5 delays to 910 trials with accurate estimate
Section 2: package 'publicly available as a GitHub repository' integrating with inspect_ai; Code availability section confirms code and shadow-mode datasets released
Related Work (Section 1.4): distinct from IRT/CAT item selection and inference-time stopping (BEACON, Pandora's Box) by 'automated, real-time stopping decisions during evaluation runs'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological paper on LLM evaluation efficiency, squarely within the LLM and evaluation preference space: it introduces optstop, a hierarchical-Bayesian precision-based early-stopping framework integrated with inspect_ai. Preference relevance is high (LLM evaluation, benchmarks, uncertainty quantification) though it does not touch Japanese LLMs, prompting, RAG, or agent systems. Novelty is moderate: it combines established sequential-analysis and Bayesian stopping ideas (Wald, HDI+ROPE, IRT-based adaptive testing, HiBayES) in a genuinely distinct niche - stopping during evaluation runs without calibrated item banks - but the statistical machinery is standard. Rigor is strong: a 3x3 shadow-mode validation matrix, item-paired equivalence testing, hierarchical meta-analysis, prior sensitivity, model-comparison simulation, presentation-order robustness, and honest limitations (Section 4, B.8.9). Evidence is solid but bounded: 57-97% trial savings with mean score deviation 0.006 (Section 3.1) and pooled truncation effect +0.0003 within ROPE (Section 3.2), all from a single experimental configuration (200 items x 10 epochs, few models/benchmarks); per-cell tests left three cells undecided, nominal coverage ~80% vs 94% (B.6), and ordinal modal-vs-mean estimand mismatch produces coverage failures (B.10). Generalizability is asserted but only partially demonstrated. Reproducibility is excellent: open-source package with fixed seed, MCMC determinism checks, and released validation code/data (Code availability, B.5).

primary_link.title: Knowing When to Stop: Bayesian Optimal Stopping for LLM Evaluations

recommendations.summary: LLM evaluations often use fixed sampling budgets, testing every item the same number of times even after estimates are precise. We introduce optstop, a precision-based adaptive stopping framework that treats evaluation as a sequential measurement problem: keep sampling where uncertainty remains high, and stop where estimates are precise or stable enough. The framework builds on hierarchical Bayesian inference, supports binary, ordinal, and continuous outcomes, and keeps every benchmark item elig
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 評估通常採固定取樣預算,即使估計已足夠精確,仍對每個測試項目重複相同次數,造成大量運算浪費。本文提出 optstop,一個以精確度為準的自適應停止框架,將評估視為循序量測問題:在不確定性高處持續取樣,在估計足夠精確或穩定處停止。框架奠基於階層式貝葉斯推論,支援二元、序數與連續分數,讓所有項目始終可被取樣,且不需預先校準的題庫;另針對低表現情境加入非對稱保守機制,避免在罕見成功事件出現前過早停止。作者以 3×3 實驗矩陣(三種推論路徑×三種表現水準,各 200 題、10 epochs)在影子模式下驗證:九個設定均觸發早期停止,移除 57% 至 97% 的預定試驗,平均節省 81.1%,截斷估計與完整運行的分數偏差平均僅 0.006,並經階層式貝葉斯薈萃分析確認統計等價、排名保持不變。效率增益依路徑而異:連續分數最高,序數次之,二元最低。限制包括僅驗證單一實驗配置、需假設組內可交換性與隨機化題目順序,以及接近 0% 或 100% 表現時區間覆蓋可能不足。此研究顯示評估運算可依不確定性而非固定重複次數來分配,將節省的資源重新導向能力邊界等真正不確定的區域,對大規模安全評估極具實務價值。
recommendations.title: Knowing When to Stop: Bayesian Optimal Stopping for LLM Evaluations
recommendations.title_zh: 知道何時停止:LLM 評估的貝葉斯最佳停止框架 optstop

links.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments

evidence: Abstract and Section 3: introduces Social Gym with 21 multi-agent social games and an Elo tournament, plus SPaRTan, a training-free play-reflect-transfer loop.
Section 3.4 and Figure 2: reports per-game and overall Elo/win rate for seven LLMs; GPT-5-mini tops at 1110 Elo, Qwen2.5-3B last at 926.
Table 1 and Section 5.1: GPT-5-mini within-game iterated reflection shows non-monotonic alt-side gains peaking at R3, while main-side tradeoffs vary by game.
Section 5.1 and Figure 3: cross-game transfer shows alt-side injection median +7 pp and main-side negative effects, excluding a saturated Chameleon target.
Section 5.3 and Appendix M: Qwen3-32B replication is largely null except Prisoner's Dilemma and Resistance action-channel setups.
Limitations: acknowledges n=30 per condition with roughly +/-18 pp binomial 95% CIs and no placebo-playbook control.
Appendix A: states code, game implementations, prompts, and experiment pipeline are released under MIT license.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, multi-agent social reasoning, AI-safety-related deception/ToM, and evaluation. Proposes a broad verifiable game benchmark (Social Gym) and training-free self-play reflection-transfer method (SPaRTan). Strengths include 21 games, Elo/Bradley-Terry with bootstrap CIs, cross-game and cross-model transfer experiments, open-weights replication, and code/prompt release. Rigor is moderate: many ablations, but per-condition n=30 yields wide CIs, no placebo-playbook control, and several effects are within noise or null.

primary_link.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments

recommendations.summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent social settings where they must cooperate, negotiate, and adapt to other agents. Measuring and improving these social skills is hard because, unlike math or logic, social interaction offers no objective ground truth: evaluations fall back on LLM judges, which are costly, subjective, and noisy, and models get no reliable signal to learn from. To address both, we first introduce Social Gym, an environment of 21 multi-agent social games (e.g., Wer
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 Social Gym 環境，內含 21 種多代理社交遊戲（如狼人殺、抵抗組織、間諜危機），以規則決定的勝負提供可驗證的評測基準，並以 Elo 錦標賽建立跨遊戲排行榜。實驗顯示 GPT-5-mini 位居榜首，但沒有單一模型在所有遊戲或角色中皆表現優異，凸顯社交推理的多面向性。作者進一步提出 SPaRTan 方法，一種免訓練的自我改善迴圈：模型先進行自我對弈，再反思自身軌跡與結果，產出可遷移的策略手冊，並將其注入後續遊戲的系統提示中。結果顯示 GPT-5-mini 產生的策略手冊能提升不對稱遊戲中較弱勢角色的表現，並可遷移至其他遊戲或較小的模型，但對開放權重模型 Qwen3-32B 的效果有限。此研究提供可重現、可驗證的基礎，以測量與改善 LLM 的社交推理，並為未來結合可驗證獎勵的強化學習鋪路。
recommendations.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
recommendations.title_zh: Social Gym 與 SPaRTan：透過多代理遊戲錦標賽評測與改善大型語言模型的社交推理能力

links.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So

evidence: Section 3.1 reports rotating attention values toward the read-out is 64x more damaging than matched random rotation at 10 degrees and 84x at 20 degrees, with asymmetry collapsing to about 1x when cross-token averaging is removed.
Section 3.2 reports orthogonal Procrustes across the commit span yields R^2_rot=0.38, 64% new content, and residual norm growth of 1.74x.
Section 6.2 and Table 4 report dense-device convergence of 7/8 seeds versus 2/8 for the frameless step, with LAMBADA 0.257 and perplexity 19.3.
Section 9.4 explicitly limits the work to a single architecture family, one scale, one corpus, and small seed counts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to transformer interpretability, attention mechanisms, and language model representation geometry. The paper offers mechanistic measurements of off-axis residual computation and interventions, with matched controls and quantitative results. However, evidence is limited to one GPT-2-class scale, one corpus, and small seed counts; generalizability is explicitly limited, and reproducibility is moderately supported by detailed setup but no code/availability claims.

primary_link.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So

recommendations.summary: A transformer's answer lives on one axis: the direction its unembedding reads. Its intermediate states largely do not, and that off-axis position is usually treated as an obstacle to interpretation. We show it is functional. A 12-layer model computes in two phases. Through the first, every sublayer writes into a subspace held near-orthogonal to the read-out, attention 75 to 96 degrees off it at every depth. Moving attention's values onto the read-out is 64 to 84 times more damaging than a matche
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討 Transformer 模型的中間表徵為何偏離最終詞彙讀出軸，並主張此偏軸位置具有功能性。作者以 GPT-2 small 等級的 12 層模型在 OpenWebText 上訓練，發現注意力層的寫入始終與讀出軸保持約 75 至 96 度的夾角，而這偏軸子空間能隔離跨 token 的混合，避免平均掉詞彙預測；將注意力值旋轉至讀出軸的破壞力是隨機旋轉的 64 至 84 倍，且傷害完全來自跨 token 路徑。模型在最後幾層以加法方式而非旋轉方式寫入答案，且答案約在第 9 層才浮現。作者進一步證明可透過在階段邊界插入固定旋轉來指定此幾何結構，使訓練收斂率從 5/9 提升至 9/9（稀疏旋轉），且不影響下游品質；該框架自由度可自由選擇，甚至可在訓練前指定。研究限制包括單一架構、單一規模與單一語料庫，且收斂率統計僅基於少數種子。此結果顯示部分內部表徵實為自由規範，可被設計而非僅能被發現，對可解釋性研究具有重要意義。
recommendations.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So
recommendations.title_zh: 偏軸、刻意為之：Transformer 在哪裡計算概念，以及為何如此

links.title: The Recall Trap: A Recall-Maximizing Retriever Configuration Reduces Issue Resolution in Fixed-Budget Code Context

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): dedup-ON raises file recall (0.878 vs 0.806 gold-file presence) yet dedup-OFF resolves more, gpt-5.6-sol +7.6pp (39.2% to 46.8%, n=500, McNemar exact p=0.0003).

Section 1 (Page 2): 'We position this not as the discovery of a new phenomenon but as a controlled, causal, code-repair case study of a known objective-mismatch and relevance-diversity tradeoff'; Levy et al. (2025) named as nearest prior mechanism with cleaner isolation.

Section 5.1 (Pages 10-11): Qwen3.6-27B pre-registered open-weights replication +3.6pp, p=0.0133, cluster-bootstrap CI [+0.9,+4.9], all twelve LORO folds positive; DeepSeek significant only on raw estimand (conditional p=0.49), reported as supportive producibility-channel evidence.

Section 4.5 (Page 8): confirmatory family of five primary p-values with Holm-Bonferroni correction; secondary analyses labeled exploratory; underpowered nulls reported as inconclusive with MDE at 80% power.

Section 5.3 (Page 12): BM25 lexical retriever reverses the effect (-3.2pp, cluster CI [-5.8,-0.3]) with significant cross-retriever interaction (fusion minus BM25 +10.8pp, CI [+5.3,+16.4]); authors disclaim a clean paradigm boundary from one BM25 configuration.

Section 5.4 (Pages 13-14): random-chunk-per-file control (3.0% vs argmax 6.6% vs depth 12.4%) refutes argmax-selection alternative but does not separate within-file depth from file-count change; acknowledged as future identification work.
Section 5.5 (Page 14): powered null under unrestricted-Read agentic harness (sonnet-5, -1.4pp, p=0.45, MDE 4.5pp); a prior +18.2pp agentic arm retired for a model confound (sonnet vs opus).
Section 5.10 (Pages 16-17): pre-registered multilingual pooled test +2.59pp, McNemar p=0.056, below realized MDE ~3.6pp; reported as a mapped boundary, no cell survives Holm correction.

Appendix B (Pages 21-22): provenance classes distinguishing Class-1 pre-registered commits from Class-2 design notes; DENSE-1 disclosed as specified after the primary result; original gpt headline run's responses not logged, funnel supplied by a pre-registered logged replication (Section 5.7).
Appendix A (Page 21): full artifact at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21879550 with SHA-256 pinned archive, served packs, predictions, grading reports, per-instance manifest, and pre-registration ledger.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for the curator's preferences: an LLM/RAG-for-code-agents methodology study (LLM solvers, retrieval-augmented context packs, SWE-bench issue resolution, agent boundary conditions), not a pure domain application or out-of-scope area. Research quality is unusually strong: paired McNemar with repository-clustered bootstrap and leave-one-repo-out (Section 5.1), Holm-Bonferroni over a defined confirmatory family (Section 4.5), corrected product decomposition of attempt vs quality channels (Section 5.2), random-chunk control refuting argmax-selection bias (Section 5.4), powered nulls reported with MDEs (Section 6.2), and honest withdrawal of confounded analyses (Sections 5.5-5.6, Appendix D). The headline +7.6pp (p=0.0003, n=500) is corroborated by a pre-registered open-weights replication (+3.6pp, p=0.0133, survives clustering) and a logged replication (+6.4pp). Novelty is modest and candidly so: the paper self-positions as a controlled code-repair instance of the known breadth/depth objective-mismatch tradeoff, conceding Levy et al. 2025 as the cleaner causal prior, RGFL as prior art for right-file-wrong-lines, and ContextBench as the correlational sibling (Sections 1, 3.1-3.5; Appendix D entries 4-5). Generalizability is deliberately narrow: one benchmark, one 12-slot budget, two embedding retrievers, single-file-dominated Python workloads; the effect reverses under BM25 (Section 5.3), is absent in agentic regimes (Section 5.5), and the pre-registered multilingual test is non-significant (+2.6pp, p=0.056, Section 5.10). Reproducibility is excellent: Zenodo DOI with SHA-256, served packs, harnesses, per-instance manifest, and commit-hashed pre-registration ledger (Appendices A-B). Overall: a rigorously executed, honestly scoped case study whose scientific surprise is limited by explicit prior art.

primary_link.title: The Recall Trap: A Recall-Maximizing Retriever Configuration Reduces Issue Resolution in Fixed-Budget Code Context

recommendations.summary: Retrieval components for code assistants are tuned against retrieval metrics: a configuration that raises recall@k is adopted, and downstream task success is assumed to follow. We report a controlled case study in code repair, not a new phenomenon but a deployed-flag, execution-graded instance of the known relevance-diversity and objective-mismatch tradeoff (Levy et al., 2025). On SWE-bench Verified we inject a retriever's hits as a fixed 12-slot context pack with no search tools and toggle one
recommendations.summary_zh: 檢索元件常以 recall@k 等檢索指標調校,並假設下游任務表現隨之提升。本文在 SWE-bench Verified 上進行受控個案研究:將檢索結果注入固定 12 個槽位的上下文包,在無搜尋工具的單次(single-shot)修補情境中,只切換「每檔案僅保留一個區塊」的去重旗標。此旗標是召回最大化的設定(黃金檔案出現在 87.8% 的服務包中),但將其關閉、以檔案廣度換取檔內深度,反而提高解決率:gpt-5.6-sol 從 39.2% 升至 46.8%(+7.6 個百分點,McNemar p=0.0003),並有預註冊、可獨立重跑的開源權重複現(Qwen3.6-27B,+3.6 個百分點);效果橫跨約 5 倍的解決能力跨度,並經儲存庫叢集推論檢驗。機制上,增益追蹤檔內黃金錨點劑量,且隨槽位預算增大而增強(K=4 的 +4.8 個百分點至 K=40 的 +9.2);但效果在 BM25 詞彙檢索器上反轉(−3.2 個百分點,跨範式交互作用顯著),在可自由 Read 的代理模式下則偵測不到;四語言的 SWE-PolyBench 合併結果正向但不顯著(+2.6 個百分點,p=0.056),屬已標繪的邊界。限制包括僅測試兩種嵌入檢索器、單一基準與 12 槽位預算、複合處理難以完全分離,深度包約多 5–6% tokens。實務啟示:在緊俏的固定預算下不應依檔案硬去重,並應針對任務而非旗標所調校的指標進行 A/B 測試。

summary: 本期收錄 100 篇論文與 25 篇技術文章，研究焦點集中在 AI 代理的評測、安全與協作，涵蓋代理式編碼、越獄與說服攻擊、多語策略保留、知識編輯與推理擴展等方向；技術文章則聚焦企業級部署、本地 LLM 建置與 RAG 引用等實務議題，提供研究與落地兼備的閱讀脈絡。
title: AI 研究與技術週報：代理智慧、模型安全與落地實務
